Controlled interventions show that useful recurrence follows the location of representation supervision, while REPA alignment produces a smaller extrapolation benefit. These results make representation-supervised recurrence a practical route to improving diffusion generation through additional inference depth.

</details>


### [288] [Diagnose-to-Generate: Eliminating Structural Distortions in Flow Models via Patch-Level Grounded Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17882)
*Yifan Li,Lishuai Gao,Tong Zhang,Qilong Huang,Chen Zhao,Zhuoliang Kang,Jie Hu,Yujie Zhong,Fenghe Tang,S Kevin Zhou,Xiaoming Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Diagnose-to-Generate (D2G) 对齐框架，将视觉诊断与生成优化分离，通过区域级空间奖励与轨迹保持采样提升流模型的结构保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式图像生成器虽语义合成能力强，但仍会产生局部结构畸变（如手部与肢体畸形）。现有后训练方法通常优化全局标量奖励，空间信用分配弱，在修正局部缺陷时可能破坏本已完好的区域。

Method: 框架分两步：一是诊断，构建区域标注数据集 Achilles-600K，并训练 ARGUS（监督冷启动 + Region-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization）预测异常类别与边界框；二是生成，将诊断结果转为置信度加权的空间奖励，用于 Patch-level Flow-GRPO。同时提出 Trajectory-Preserving Stochastic Sampling (TPSS)，早期用确定性 ODE 轨迹锚定去噪，仅在后期引入随机性，以限制组内空间漂移并保留局部探索。

Result: 在 FLUX.1-dev 与 SD3.5 上，结构保真度提升，同时 FID 与 CLIP 分数保持稳定。在 HumanRefiner、零样本 GPT-4.1 以及盲测人类评估下均取得一致增益，表明改进不局限于训练奖励模型。

Conclusion: 将诊断与生成优化解耦、并以区域级空间奖励驱动对齐，可有效修正局部结构畸变而不损害整体质量；TPSS 缓解了全局随机探索导致的补丁级相对优势空间不一致问题。

Abstract: Flow-based image generators achieve strong semantic synthesis but still produce localized structural distortions, such as malformed hands and limbs. Existing post-training methods typically optimize global scalar rewards, which provide weak spatial credit assignment and may alter well-formed regions while correcting local defects. We present \textit{Diagnose-to-Generate (D2G)}, a grounded alignment framework that separates visual diagnosis from generative optimization. We construct \textbf{Achilles-600K}, a region-annotated dataset for structural anomalies, and train \textbf{ARGUS} through supervised cold-start and Region-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization to predict anomaly categories and bounding boxes. These diagnoses are converted into confidence-weighted spatial rewards for our \textbf{Patch-level Flow-GRPO}. We further identify that global stochastic exploration can shift semantic regions across group rollouts, making patch-wise relative advantages spatially inconsistent. Our \textbf{Trajectory-Preserving Stochastic Sampling (TPSS)} anchors early denoising with deterministic ODE trajectories and introduces stochasticity only at later steps, thereby limiting intra-group spatial drift while retaining local exploration. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev and SD3.5 show improved structural fidelity with preserved FID and CLIP scores. Consistent gains under HumanRefiner, zero-shot GPT-4.1, and blinded human evaluation further demonstrate that the improvements extend beyond the training reward model.

</details>


### [289] [Visual Dependence Does Not Imply Answerability: A Systematic Analysis of Answerability Signals in Frozen InstructBLIP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17902)
*Minjun Kim,Hyunmin Song,Changwon Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在冻结的InstructBLIP上系统评估多种可回答性信号，发现其区分能力普遍很弱（AUROC仅0.50–0.54），无一可作为可靠的可回答性代理指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉问答模型在视觉证据不足时仍会给出看似合理的答案。已有工作提出了不可回答视觉问题的基准与弃答机制，但尚不清楚：来自冻结视觉语言模型的哪些信号能可靠地在未见的图文对上指示可回答性。

Method: 在UNK-VQA的分层10K子集上，使用冻结的InstructBLIP，系统评估六类可回答性信号：预测不确定性、跨模态对齐、视觉定位、视觉依赖性、内部表示与学习探针；并检验探针容量、多信号融合、理由感知监督、冻结后交叉验证、选择性作答与失败模式分析。

Result: 可回答性判别整体偏弱，测试AUROC大多落在0.50–0.54。CLIP对齐给出最高点估计，但在配对自助法下未显著优于生成置信度。针对性移除问题相关视觉证据引起的置信度变化显著大于同尺寸随机掩码，但干预敏感性几乎不提供可回答性判别力。增大探针容量、组合多信号、加入理由感知监督均无稳健提升；冻结后交叉验证同样弱。选择性作答分析显示在低风险准则下可用覆盖率有限。失败模式分析表明各信号的相对效用随扰动机制而变。

Conclusion: 在UNK-VQA子集与冻结InstructBLIP设定下，视觉依赖性、不确定性、语义对齐与静态表示都不是稳健的独立可回答性代理。研究强调需区分“模型对视觉证据的依赖”与“该证据是否足以支撑答案”。

Abstract: Visual question answering models often produce plausible responses even when the available visual evidence is insufficient to support a valid answer. Although prior work has introduced benchmarks and abstention mechanisms for unanswerable visual questions, it remains unclear which signals derived from a frozen vision-language model reliably indicate answerability on unseen image-question pairs. We systematically evaluate answerability signals on a stratified 10K subset of UNK-VQA using frozen InstructBLIP, covering predictive uncertainty, cross-modal alignment, visual grounding, visual dependence, internal representations, and learned probes. Answerability discrimination remains weak, with test AUROC largely confined to 0.50-0.54. CLIP alignment yields the highest point estimate but does not significantly outperform generation confidence under paired bootstrap analysis. Targeted removal of question-relevant visual evidence causes substantially larger changes in answer confidence than same-size random masking, yet intervention sensitivity provides essentially no answerability discrimination. Increasing probe capacity, combining multiple signals, and adding reason-aware supervision do not provide robust improvements, while post-freeze cross-validation yields similarly weak discrimination. Selective-answering analysis shows limited usable coverage under low-risk operating criteria. Failure-mode analysis shows that the relative utility of individual signals varies across perturbation mechanisms. Taken together, these results show that, on our UNK-VQA subset with frozen InstructBLIP, visual dependence, uncertainty, semantic alignment, and static representations are not robust standalone proxies for answerability. Our findings emphasize the need to distinguish a model's reliance on visual evidence from whether that evidence is sufficient to support an answer.

</details>


### [290] [DriveWLA: Unifying Future Dynamics and Scene Semantics through World-Language-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17903)
*Shuzheng Wang,Haoxuan Li,Shengzhen Li,Chenxi Wu,Yajing Sun,Lu Hou,Wenyu Liu,Xinggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DriveWLA 提出统一的 World-Language-Action 模型（基于 Mixture-of-Transformers），联合建模语义理解、未来场景演化与轨迹生成，在开环与闭环评测中均取得优异性能，并具备强零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在世界模型的语义理解与未来场景演化方面表现优异，但如何有效整合两者能力来生成自动驾驶轨迹仍然具有挑战性。

Method: 基于 Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）构建统一 World-Language-Action 模型，包含三个专家：World Expert（未来预测）、Language Expert（语义理解）、Action Expert（轨迹生成）；引入 Cross-Expert Attention 实现跨专家可控信息流并对齐语义与动态表征；采用 Flow-GRPO 强化学习后训练精调 Action Expert，以突破模仿学习限制。

Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 上取得 92.3 PDMS，在 NAVSIM v2 上取得 90.1 EPDMS，在基于 VLM 与世界模型的规划器中表现突出；无需特定微调即可零样本泛化到 HUGSIM、nuScenes 和 Bench2Drive。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了统一 World-Language-Action 建模的有效性，DriveWLA 可作为面向自动驾驶的可泛化通用框架。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in semantic understanding and future scene evolution for autonomous driving. However, effectively integrating both capabilities for trajectory generation remains challenging. In this work, we propose DriveWLA, a unified World-Language-Action model based on Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) that jointly models semantic understanding, future scene dynamics, and trajectory generation. DriveWLA consists of three experts: a World Expert for future prediction, a Language Expert for semantic understanding, and an Action Expert for trajectory generation. We further introduce Cross-Expert Attention, which enables controlled information flow across experts while aligning semantic and dynamic representations. To improve trajectory generation beyond imitation learning, we apply Flow-GRPO reinforcement learning post-training to refine the Action Expert. Extensive experiments show that DriveWLA achieves superior performance in both open-loop and closed-loop evaluation. DriveWLA achieves 92.3 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, demonstrating strong performance among VLM-based and world-model-based planners. Without specific fine-tuning, DriveWLA further demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization to HUGSIM, nuScenes, and Bench2Drive. These results validate the effectiveness of our unified World-Language-Action modeling, establishing DriveWLA as a generalizable framework for autonomous driving.

</details>


### [291] [LinMorph: Learning to Morph Weights for Efficient Video DiT Linearization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17914)
*Lingyi Long,Congyue Zhao,Xiaoou Li,Yanmin Qian,Tao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LinMorph将视频DiT线性化重构为可学习的softmax-to-linear权重变换问题，通过共享的跨参数态射实现更优初始化，加快恢复并提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频DiT线性化方法主要把注意力替换带来的质量损失当作恢复问题处理，但真正的瓶颈在上游的初始化环节。随机初始化丢弃了预训练知识，而人工权重复用依赖僵化且不完整的源-目标对应关系，均无法有效迁移知识。

Method: LinMorph将线性化建模为可学习的softmax到线性权重变换：学习一个跨参数态射，使每个目标Gated DeltaNet参数联合地从预训练的query、key、value和output投影中抽取，包括没有直接softmax对应项的参数量。该态射跨层共享，通过局部教师对齐学习，同时从各自预训练权重生成层特定初始化。所得权重实体化为独立GDN模块进行渐进蒸馏与联合恢复。由于在权重空间而非token空间操作，可在短时低分辨率片段上学习并直接复用到大视频尺度。

Result: 在多个预训练视频DiT上，LinMorph相比随机初始化和启发式权重复用实现了显著更快的恢复速度和更好的最终生成质量。

Conclusion: 高效线性化不仅取决于转换模型如何被恢复，更关键地取决于预训练知识在恢复之前如何被迁移。

Abstract: Post-hoc linearization is an attractive way to accelerate pretrained Video Diffusion Transformers (Video DiTs), yet existing methods largely treat the quality loss induced by attention replacement as a recovery problem. We show that a more fundamental bottleneck lies upstream: \emph{initialization}. Random initialization discards pretrained knowledge, whereas manual weight reuse transfers it through rigid and incomplete source--target correspondences. We introduce \textbf{LinMorph}, which recasts Video DiT linearization as a learnable softmax-to-linear weight transformation problem. Instead of copying predefined counterparts, LinMorph learns a cross-parameter morphism that lets each target Gated DeltaNet (GDN) parameter draw jointly from pretrained query, key, value, and output projections, including for parameters with no direct softmax counterpart. A single morphism is shared across layers and learned through local teacher alignment, while producing layer-specific initializations from their respective pretrained weights. The resulting weights are then materialized as independent GDN modules for progressive distillation and joint recovery.Since the morphism operates in weight space rather than token space, it can be learned on short, low-resolution clips and directly reused at larger video scales. Across pretrained Video DiTs, LinMorph enables markedly faster recovery and better final generation quality than random initialization and heuristic weight reuse. Results show that efficient linearization depends not only on how a converted model is recovered, but critically on how pretrained knowledge is transferred before recovery. Project page: https://lonelyling.github.io/LinMorph.

</details>


### [292] [CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17926)
*Xiaoxue Wu,Xinyu Gao,Fang Yu,Yu Qiao,Xinyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CineMem，一种面向自回归多镜头视频生成的注意力对齐细粒度记忆检索框架，通过在线聚类 KV 缓存与查询级检索机制，在有限记忆预算下近似全记忆访问，提升跨镜头长程一致性，并引入 VLM 辅助的评测指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成依赖记忆检索建模长程依赖，在多镜头场景中尤为关键：模型需在镜头切换带来的巨大视觉变化与持续的语义连贯之间取得平衡。现有方法在帧级进行记忆检索，且所有查询 token 共享同一历史上下文，忽视了异构的信息需求，导致检索冗余与历史记忆利用率低。

Method: 提出 CineMem：1）通过注意力分析揭示内在记忆访问模式，据此设计在线聚类 KV 缓存，对全部历史 token 进行语义感知的记忆分组，实现更精确检索；2）引入查询级检索机制，在固定检索预算下提供更广的历史信息访问，提升长期记忆利用率。二者结合使多镜头生成器在受限记忆预算下近似全记忆访问。

Result: 大量实验验证了该框架的有效性，尤其在重访场景下能保持跨镜头切换的长程一致性；同时提出的任务专属、VLM 辅助指标可实现忠实的跨镜头一致性评估。

Conclusion: CineMem 通过细粒度、查询自适应的记忆检索，有效解决了多镜头视频生成中的记忆冗余与利用不足问题，在保持长程语义连贯方面表现优异，并为该任务提供了一套新的评测方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive video generation relies on memory retrieval to model long-range dependencies. This capability becomes particularly critical for multi-shot generation, where models must reconcile substantial visual changes across shot transitions with persistent semantic continuity. Existing methods tend to perform memory retrieval at the frame level and share the same historical context across all query tokens, overlooking the heterogeneous information needs and leading to redundant retrieval and inefficient use of historical memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. Specifically, guided by intrinsic memory-access patterns revealed through attention analysis, we propose an online-clustered KV cache as a memory organization strategy over all historical tokens, enabling semantic-aware memory grouping and more precise retrieval. In addition, we introduce a query-level retrieval mechanism that provides broader access to historical information under a fixed retrieval budget, thereby improving long-term memory utilization. Together, these designs enable the multi-shot video generator to preserve long-range consistency across shot transitions, particularly in revisitation scenarios, while approximating full-memory access under a constrained memory budget. To facilitate evaluation, we further introduce a suite of task-specific, VLM-assisted metrics for faithful inter-shot consistency assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

</details>


### [293] [HierarchiRetina: A Diabetic Retinopathy Screening and Grading Cascade with Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Lesion Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17933)
*Md Asif Uddin,Niloy Farhan,Rafeed Rahman,Md. Golam Rabiul Alam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HierarchiRetina 提出筛查-分割-分级级联框架，含异构专家混合分割、可分级性分离与病灶门控交叉注意力分级，并强调端到端评测、阶段归因与掩码消融。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化糖尿病视网膜病变系统多采用单一黑箱网络一次性分级，存在三个缺口：(i) 病灶尺寸与对比度差异大，分割器却对所有病灶使用相同模块；(ii) 不可分级图像常被排除或当作额外类别，且病灶感知的分级器很少验证病灶是否真正驱动分级结果；(iii) 分阶段系统通常只在到达该阶段的图像上报告性能，忽略了误差传播的度量。

Method: 提出 HierarchiRetina 级联系统：HSMoE-AUNet 为 U-Net，其跳跃连接、瓶颈和解码块均为异构专家的稀疏混合，并按病灶匹配专家类型、数量与损失；SwinHRUNetPP 为双编码器血管分割器，采用视野受限损失；LG-DRG 将可分级性与有序严重度分离，并通过门控交叉注意力让病灶掩码查询图像；最后采用端到端评测，将筛查漏检计为错误并追溯每个错误所属阶段。

Result: 汇总 Dice 从 0.184（微动脉瘤）到 0.579（渗出物），血管 Dice 为 0.731。在六个数据集共 58,689 张留出图像上，端到端二次加权 kappa 为 0.804，转诊敏感度 0.832（特异度 0.947），筛查门控造成 66% 的错误。消融实验中，即使交叉注意力门初始为开启状态，分级仍忽略掩码。在全部 4,105 张官方 DDR 测试图像上，六分类准确率 85.6%，高于所找到的最佳已发表六分类结果（83.8%）。

Conclusion: 分阶段筛查系统在临床部署前应进行端到端评测，并辅以阶段归因与掩码消融，以暴露误差传播并检验病灶信息是否真正被分级利用。

Abstract: Clinical screening for diabetic retinopathy proceeds in stages, yet most automated systems grade fundus images with a single black-box network. Three gaps remain: (i) lesions differ widely in size and contrast, but segmenters typically apply the same blocks to all; (ii) ungradable images are usually excluded or treated as an extra class, and lesion-aware graders seldom test whether lesions drive the grade; (iii) staged systems often report each stage only on the images reaching it, leaving propagated errors unmeasured. HierarchiRetina, a screening, segmentation and grading cascade with inspectable stage outputs, addresses each gap. First, HSMoE-AUNet is a U-Net whose skip, bottleneck and decoder blocks are sparse mixtures of heterogeneous experts, with lesion-matched types, counts and losses; SwinHRUNetPP, a dual-encoder vessel segmenter, uses a field-of-view-restricted loss. Second, LG-DRG separates gradability from ordinal severity and lets lesion masks query the image through gated cross-attention. Third, an end-to-end evaluation counts screening misses as errors and traces each error to its stage. Pooled Dice ranged from 0.184 (microaneurysms) to 0.579 (exudates); vessel Dice was 0.731. On 58,689 held-out images from six datasets, end-to-end quadratic weighted kappa was 0.804, with referral sensitivity 0.832 at specificity 0.947, and the screening gate caused 66% of errors. In ablations, the grade ignored the masks, even with the cross-attention gate started open. On all 4,105 official DDR test images, six-class accuracy was 85.6%, above the best published six-class result we found (83.8%). Staged screening systems should be evaluated end-to-end, with stage attribution and mask ablation, before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [294] [PUGS: Physics-Guided Uncertainty Modeling for Underwater Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17936)
*Tingjun Li,Yuxi Wang,Guoqiang Zhong,Zhaoxiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PUGS提出一种物理引导的不确定性模型，用于水下动态3D高斯泼溅重建，通过将每个高斯的运动建模为概率分布，弥合水下成像物理歧义带来的确定性变形假设失效问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态3DGS方法多采用确定性变形场，假设每个高斯沿明确几何轨迹运动。但水下环境中光散射、折射、海洋雪与低可见度导致显著物理歧义，使该假设失效，需要引入不确定性建模。

Method: 将每个高斯运动参数化为包含期望变形与物理不确定性的概率分布；采用随机变形优化，通过局部重参数化采样高斯轨迹以探索多种物理可行解；提出不确定性随机退火与双路径自一致性蒸馏目标，将随机探索转化为保持时间一致性的确定性重建。

Result: 在水下动态数据集和物理感知基准上取得更优渲染质量、时间一致性与重建鲁棒性；在UVEB上相比最强基线提升1.16 dB PSNR，在DRUVA上提升3.99 dB。

Conclusion: PUGS通过学习水下成像固有不确定性并将其作为动态建模的物理信号，有效克服确定性变形假设的局限，实现高质量、时序一致且鲁棒的水下动态3DGS重建。

Abstract: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient framework for dynamic scene reconstruction. Most existing approaches model scene dynamics with deterministic deformation fields, assuming each Gaussian follows a distinct geometric trajectory over time. This assumption breaks down underwater, where light scattering, refraction, marine snow and low visibility create substantial physical ambiguity in captured images. We present PUGS, a physics-guided uncertainty model for underwater dynamic 3DGS. PUGS learns inherent uncertainty induced by underwater image formation and leverages it as a physical signal for dynamic scene modeling. Rather than estimating a single deterministic displacement, it parameterizes each Gaussian's motion as a probability distribution with expected deformation and physical uncertainty. We adopt stochastic deformation optimization to sample Gaussian trajectories via local reparameterization, exploring multiple physically plausible solutions during training. We further propose uncertainty stochastic annealing and a dual-path self-consistency distillation objective, converting stochastic exploration to deterministic reconstruction while preserving temporal coherence. Extensive experiments on underwater dynamic datasets and physics-aware benchmarks demonstrate superior rendering quality, temporal consistency and reconstruction robustness. Our method achieves 1.16 dB PSNR gain over the strongest baseline on UVEB and 3.99 dB on DRUVA.

</details>


### [295] [MERIT: Multimodal Evidence Reasoning over Image Tables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17937)
*Haoyang Jiang,Zhuotong Fan,Mingyang Yi,Ju Fan,Lanqing Hu,Xiao Zan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出MERIT，一个针对表格图像的多模态证据推理三阶段框架，将序列化表格作为可选辅助输入，缓解视觉证据获取瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格推理通常假设输入是干净的文本表格，但实际中表格被序列化为文本时会破坏单元格内容、扭曲结构关系并丢失视觉线索，导致模型基于不完整证据推理。表格图像虽保留这些信息，却要求模型同时具备准确感知和基于相关单元格的推理能力。

Method: MERIT分三阶段：(1)通过重建、定位和颜色条件监督进行表格专用编码器适配以改善视觉证据获取；(2)基于适配表示，用验证过的轨迹进行监督微调，教模型显式选择证据并推理；(3)用强化学习精炼策略，对证据正确性、计算、最终答案和输出格式分别设奖励。

Result: 在表格问答和事实验证任务上评估方法，并分析视觉输入与各训练组件的贡献，同时考察对具有不同表格结构和视觉呈现的其他数据集的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过提供中间步骤反馈，MERIT针对仅靠最终答案监督无法区分的检索与计算错误进行优化，验证了以表格图像为核心、序列化表格为可选辅助的多模态推理框架的有效性。

Abstract: Table reasoning with language models typically assumes access to clean textual tables. In practice, tables are often serialized into text, which can corrupt cell contents, distort structural relationships, and discard visual cues, leaving the model to reason over incomplete evidence. In contrast, table images retain this information, but using it requires both accurate perception and reasoning grounded in the relevant cells. To address this, we propose MERIT (Multimodal Evidence Reasoning over Image Tables), a three-stage framework for learning to reason over table images, with serialized tables serving as optional auxiliary inputs (if provided). Our analysis identifies visual evidence acquisition as a bottleneck, motivating table-specific encoder adaptation through reconstruction, localization, and color-conditioned supervision. Building on the adapted representations, supervised fine-tuning teaches explicit evidence selection and reasoning using verified trajectories. Finally, reinforcement learning refines the policy with separate rewards for evidence correctness, calculation, final answers, and output format. By providing feedback on intermediate steps, the framework targets retrieval and computational errors that final-answer supervision alone does not distinguish. We evaluate the approach on table question answering and fact verification, analyze the contributions of visual inputs and training components, and assess generalization to additional datasets with different table structures and visual presentations.

</details>


### [296] [AI-Enhanced Hyperspectral Imaging for Intraoperative Detection of Low-Grade Glioma: A Clinical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17944)
*Siri Willems,Ishika Jain,Jens De Winne,Siri Luthman,Hamed Zivari Adab,Roeland Vandebriel,Anna Alperovich,Xiaohan Zhang,Ben Stoffelen,Tom De Schepper,Lien Solie,Steven De Vleeschouwer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该临床研究针对低级别胶质瘤(LGG)，利用高光谱成像(HSI)区分健康与肿瘤组织，并与常规RGB成像进行配对比较。3D CNN模型取得最高中位ROC-AUC 74.5%，优于光谱XGBoost(67.9%)和RGB模型(64.0%)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像引导神经导航技术(术中MRI、超声)成本高、灵敏度有限且操作复杂，亟需更高效的术中肿瘤检测系统。既有术中脑HSI研究多聚焦高级别胶质瘤或混合级别队列，而低级别胶质瘤(LGG)在白光显微镜下与正常脑组织极为相似，检测困难，因此本研究专门针对LGG。

Method: 开展临床研究，对健康组织与肿瘤组织的谱差异进行表征；在匹配的组织位置和相同的患者级数据划分下，对基于HSI与基于RGB的分类进行配对比较；评估多种分类模型，包括融合光谱与空间特征的3D CNN、仅用光谱的XGBoost以及基于RGB的模型。

Result: 肿瘤区域表现出持续较低的反射率，可能与血红蛋白浓度和氧合差异有关。3D CNN取得最高中位ROC-AUC 74.5%，光谱XGBoost为67.9%，RGB模型为64.0%。

Conclusion: 结果支持进一步研究HSI用于低级别胶质瘤分类，并在该队列中量化了其相对常规RGB成像的性能优势。

Abstract: Current image-guided neuronavigation techniques, such as intraoperative MRI and ultrasound, are limited by high costs, limited sensitivity and operational complexity. There is a clear need for more efficient systems to enhance intra-operative tumor detection and improve patient outcomes for intrinsic brain tumor resection. Whereas previous intraoperative brain HSI studies have predominantly investigated high-grade gliomas, glioblastomas, or mixed-grade cohorts, this clinical study focuses specifically on low-grade gliomas (LGGs). LGGs strongly resemble normal brain under white light conditions on the operative microscope. This study characterizes spectral differences between healthy and tumor tissue and provides a paired comparison of HSI- and RGB-based classification at matched tissue locations and under identical patient-level data splits. Tumor regions showed consistently lower reflectance, which may be associated with differences in hemoglobin concentration and oxygenation. A range of classification models was evaluated. The 3D CNN, which integrates spectral and spatial features, achieved the highest median ROC-AUC of 74.5%, compared with 67.9% for the spectral-only XGBoost model and 64.0% for the RGB-based model. These results support further investigation of HSI for low-grade glioma classification and quantify its performance relative to conventional RGB imaging in this cohort.

</details>


### [297] [FETALFusion: Resolution-Aware State-Space Modeling for Multi-Domain Fetal Head Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17951)
*Ammar Bhilwarawala,Mainak Bandyopadhyay*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FETALFusion，一种双路径CNN-Mamba编解码器，用于跨采集方式的胎儿头部超声分割。在471张测试图像上，其Dice达0.963、HD95为2.10 mm，优于U-Mamba等十个对比方法；但残差编码器方法（如ImageNet预训练ResNet-34 U-Net，HD95 1.75 mm）表现更佳。消融显示增益主要来自关键点形状先验与域门控，状态空间分支贡献不显著。预测掩膜计算的HC与临床参考ICC达0.9986。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D超声头围（HC）是胎儿生长的常规标志物，其自动化依赖分割边界在单张扫描上的可靠性，而非仅平均表现。现有方法在跨采集方式（经腹与经会阴）泛化及边界精度上仍有不足，且缺乏对性能来源的严谨归因。作者希望构建一个无需测试时增强和域标签即可跨采集方式工作的分割模型，并通过与运行间变异校准来明确各模块的真实贡献。

Method: 提出FETALFusion，双路径CNN-Mamba编解码器：仅在两个最高分辨率阶段应用四方向状态空间扫描；瓶颈特征经域特定通道门控，测试时取平均；引入弱关键点形状先验。在经腹（HC-18）与经会阴（PSFHS）图像上联合训练，与十种方法在471张测试图像上比较，固定单一训练计划，按原生分辨率下的表面距离评分，并进行消融与多次训练运行校准。

Result: FETALFusion无测试时增强、无域标签下达到Dice 0.963、HD95 2.10 mm，在五项指标上均优于U-Mamba（HD95降低0.31 mm，Holm校正p < 10⁻⁴），该优势在测试时增强与两次独立训练下保持，并在均值上优于U-Net、Attention U-Net与TransUNet。残差编码器可缩小差距：ResNet-34 UNet++超过FETALFusion，ImageNet初始化ResNet-34 U-Net整体最佳（HD95 1.75 mm）。消融结果一致，经运行间变异校准后，增益主要归因于关键点形状先验及经会阴图像上的域门控，而移除状态空间分支对精度无显著影响。预测掩膜计算的HC与临床参考ICC为0.9986。

Conclusion: FETALFusion在胎儿头部跨采集方式分割上取得高精度，并可提供与临床高度一致的HC测量。但较简单的残差编码器方案（尤其ImageNet预训练ResNet-34 U-Net）整体更优，表明所提架构的收益有限；消融进一步显示Mamba状态空间分支贡献不显著，真正有效的组件是关键点形状先验与域门控。研究强调需以运行间变异为基准进行严谨归因。

Abstract: Head circumference (HC) measured from 2D ultrasound is a routine marker of fetal growth, and automating it needs segmentations whose boundaries hold up on individual scans, not only on average. We present FETALFusion, a dual-path CNN-Mamba encoder-decoder for fetal head segmentation across acquisition types. It applies four-directional state-space scans only at the two highest-resolution stages, routes bottleneck features through domain-specific channel gates that are averaged at test time, and adds a weak landmark shape prior. We train jointly on transabdominal (HC-18) and transperineal (PSFHS) images and compare ten methods on a held-out test set of 471 images, each trained under one schedule and scored by surface distances at native resolution. FETALFusion reaches a Dice score of 0.963 and an HD95 of 2.10 mm without test-time augmentation or a domain label. It improves on U-Mamba on all five reported metrics (HD95 reduced by 0.31 mm; Holm-corrected ($p < 10^{-4}$), a lead that holds under test-time augmentation and across two independent training runs, and in the mean on U-Net, Attention U-Net and TransUNet. Residual encoders close the gap: a ResNet-34 UNet++ exceeds FETALFusion, and an ImageNet initialised ResNet-34 U-Net is best overall (HD95 1.75 mm). The ablation agrees. Calibrated against run-to-run variation, it attributes FETALFusion's measurable gains to the landmark shape prior and, on transperineal images, to the domain gates, while removing the state-space branch does not measurably change accuracy. HC from the predicted masks agrees with the clinical reference at an intraclass correlation of 0.9986.

</details>


### [298] [dMRI-F: A Foundation Model for Generalizable Diffusion MRI Analysis from Sparse Acquisitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17968)
*Xi Zhu,Yijie Li,Xiaofan Wang,Wei Zhang,Huafu Chen,Ce Zhu,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: dMRI-F是一个扩散磁共振基础模型，仅需6个体积输入即可统一数据增强与下游任务，在9个独立数据集上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量dMRI需密集采集，导致扫描时间长且受硬件限制，常难以实现；同时dMRI需要专用计算方法支持分割、配准、合成等多样分析任务，缺乏统一且低成本的通用框架。

Method: dMRI-F采用q空间掩码重建任务进行预训练，从仅6个体积预测密集采样的多壳数据，从而学习可泛化的dMRI潜在特征表示，作为适配多种下游任务的核心基础。下游任务包括脑区分割、脑配准和跨模态合成。

Result: 在9个独立采集的数据集上，dMRI-F优于最先进方法，在采集方式、人群和任务上均表现出稳健的泛化能力。

Conclusion: dMRI-F是一个通用框架，能够从低成本、稀疏采集数据中实现多样的dMRI应用，展现出良好的通用性与应用潜力。

Abstract: Diffusion MRI (dMRI) probes water diffusion within the brain, providing unique information about tissue microstructure and white matter connectivity. High-quality dMRI enables advanced and accurate analyses but demands dense acquisitions, resulting in long scan times and hardware constraints that are often infeasible. Further, dMRI requires dedicated computational methods to support diverse analysis tasks (e.g., parcellation, registration, and synthesis) for both neuroscientific and clinical applications. Here, we present dMRI-F, a foundation model that unifies dMRI data enhancement and downstream tasks across diverse acquisitions and populations, while requiring only minimal acquisition input. dMRI-F is pre-trained with a q-space masked reconstruction task: predicting densely sampled multi-shell data from only six volumes. It learns generalizable latent feature representations of dMRI data, which serve as a core foundation for adapting to diverse downstream tasks, including brain parcellation, brain registration, and cross-modal synthesis. Across nine independently acquired datasets, we demonstrate that dMRI-F outperforms state-of-the-art methods with robust generalization across acquisitions, populations, and tasks. Our results demonstrate dMRI-F's versatility as a general-purpose framework that enables diverse dMRI applications from low-cost, sparse acquisitions.

</details>


### [299] [Web Scale on a Budget: Tail-Aware Retrieval Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17986)
*Boaz Meivar,Shai Avidan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于采样秩的评估方法，利用检索难度服从二项分布这一缩放规律，仅用5%的图库样本（索引量减少20倍）即可准确估计百万级图库的检索指标，在大规模基准上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实例检索评估通常依赖大规模图库（如ILIAS的1亿干扰图片）以保证评判能力，但这带来极高代价：数百GPU小时和约200GB描述符开销，且每个方法或消融实验都要重复付出。作者质疑"忠实评估必须依赖网络级规模"这一假设，希望降低索引成本。

Method: 作者指出评估本身服从缩放规律：能超过正样本的干扰图片数量随图库规模呈二项分布。由此定义"每查询检索难度"（per-query retrieval hardness），这一量与图库规模无关，可在任意规模上导出检索指标，并能从小规模随机样本中估计。该方法借鉴推荐系统和生物特征识别中已有的采样秩机制，但首次将其适配到视觉检索，并使其成为可按查询、可估计的形式。

Result: 在ILIAS和INSTRE的真实1亿规模及GLDv2完整75.9万干扰池上验证：在仅5%样本下，各主干网络的尾部感知（EVT）估计均收敛到大尺度mAP，误差约0.01（平均绝对误差0.005），覆盖五种主干、三个基准和两个干扰池；而推荐系统计数基线普遍高估（+0.037至+0.068）。相比直接在子集上报告指标（+0.08至+0.13），本方法提升约一个数量级。

Conclusion: 大规模图库索引的开销在很大程度上可以避免。通过采样秩与每查询检索难度估计，可实现更快、更便宜、更环保的检索评估，作者开源了代码与每查询难度数据。

Abstract: A common practice in instance retrieval is to grow the gallery size to improve a benchmark's discrimination capability. One prominent example is ILIAS, which adds up to 100 million distractor images. The prevailing assumption is that faithful evaluation demands web scale, and that indexing all 100M images through the backbone is the unavoidable price of a comparable number. That price is steep: hundreds of GPU-hours and ~200 GB of descriptors per model, paid again for every method or ablation. We show the web-scale indexing price is largely avoidable: evaluation itself obeys a scaling law. The number of distractors that outrank a positive is Binomial in the gallery size. We define the per-query retrieval hardness, a gallery-scale agnostic quantity that yields a retrieval metric at any scale, and demonstrate it can be derived from a small random sample. The underlying sampled-rank machinery is long established in recommender-system and biometric evaluation, but to our knowledge has never been adapted to visual retrieval. We make the law per-query and estimable, and validate it at true 100M scale on ILIAS and INSTRE, and on the full 759k-distractor Google Landmarks v2 pool. Concretely, within a 5% sample (a flat 20x less indexing), every backbone's tail-aware (EVT) estimate has converged onto the large-scale mAP, to within ~0.01 (mean absolute error 0.005), across five backbones, three benchmarks, and two distractor pools (mAP@1000 at 100M on ILIAS/INSTRE; the official mAP@100 at the full 759k pool on GLDv2); the recommender-systems count baseline over-predicts everywhere (+0.037 to +0.068). This is an order of magnitude better than naively reporting the metric on the same subset (+0.08 to +0.13). We release code and the per-query hardness to facilitate faster, cheaper, and greener retrieval evaluation.

</details>


### [300] [PolUR: Polarization Aware Multimodal Degradation Perception for Underwater Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17991)
*Wenshuo Zhang,Xiangyue Zhang,Junlin Li,Wenjie Tian,Yubo Zheng,Hongli Xu,Jingyu Ru,Xinde Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PolUR——一个统一的、由多模态语言驱动的框架，联合利用偏振与RGB信息，通过结构化语义指令识别退化类型与严重程度，并在退化感知语义特征引导下增强联合恢复表征，以提升混合退化下的恢复鲁棒性；同时构建MixPolar基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从退化水下观测中恢复高质量图像对水下探索至关重要。偏振观测在清水条件下恢复目标辐亮度方面展现出作为互补物理线索的潜力，但现有方法尚未联合建模原始强度信息与偏振线索，难以在理解混合退化（色偏、雾化、低光）的基础上驱动图像恢复。

Method: 提出PolUR：统一的、语言驱动的多模态框架，联合使用偏振与RGB信息，通过结构化语义指令识别退化类型与严重程度，并在退化感知语义特征指导下增强联合恢复表征。同时构建MixPolar基准，包含呈现真实世界退化的水下图像及其对应退化描述，支持退化感知、图像恢复及下游任务性能的系统评估。

Result: 大量实验表明，PolUR有效整合偏振与RGB信息，在退化感知与图像恢复上取得有竞争力的性能，并展现出泛化能力以及对下游任务的实用性。

Conclusion: PolUR通过联合偏振与RGB的多模态语言驱动建模，克服了现有方法未联合建模强度与偏振线索的局限，提升了混合退化下的恢复鲁棒性，MixPolar基准为相关评估提供了系统化支撑。

Abstract: Recovering high-quality images from degraded underwater observations is crucial for underwater exploration. Polarization observations show promise as an effective source of complementary physical cues for recovering target radiance under clear-water conditions. However, existing methods have yet to jointly model raw intensity information and polarization cues to enable image restoration driven by an understanding of mixed degradations (color casts, haze, and low light). To overcome these limitations, we propose PolUR, a unified multimodal language-driven framework that jointly uses polarization and RGB information to identify degradation types and severity levels through structured semantic instructions and enhances joint restoration representations under the guidance of degradation-aware semantic features to improve restoration robustness under mixed degradations. We further construct a new benchmark named MixPolar, which contains underwater images exhibiting real-world degradations and their corresponding degradation descriptions. MixPolar supports systematic evaluation of degradation perception, image restoration, and performance on downstream tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PolUR effectively integrates polarization and RGB information, achieving competitive performance in degradation perception and image restoration, while also demonstrating generalization capability and utility for downstream tasks.

</details>


### [301] [Uncertainty-Aware Semi-Supervised Framework with Supervised Contrastive Learning for Sugarcane Leaf Disease Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17996)
*Shalini Dangi,Divya Teja,Omkar Kabde,Shahid Shafi Dar,Nagendra Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 U-SSDNet，一种基于不确定性感知 Mean-Teacher 的半监督甘蔗叶病害检测网络，在少量标注样本下即可接近全监督性能，并优于现有监督与半监督方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 甘蔗叶病害严重影响作物产量与品质，及时准确检测对可持续农业至关重要。传统深度学习方法依赖大量标注数据，标注成本高且困难，主要挑战包括：类内差异大（不同生长期症状多样）、类间相似性强（病健组织区分细微）、噪声标签影响模型可靠性。

Method: 提出 U-SSDNet 不确定性感知 Mean-Teacher 半监督学习网络，充分利用无标注数据。具体包括：采用离散小波变换预处理增强病斑可见性并降低类内差异；利用 KL 散度优化伪标签以减轻确认偏差；引入监督对比学习提升特征判别性，改善类别间分离。

Result: 在甘蔗叶病害数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在仅需远少于标注样本的情况下，性能接近全监督模型，并持续优于当前最先进的监督与半监督方法。

Conclusion: U-SSDNet 通过结合小波变换预处理、KL 散度伪标签优化与监督对比学习，有效缓解了标注不足、类内差异、类间相似及噪声标签等问题，为作物病害检测提供了高效可靠的半监督解决方案。

Abstract: Sugarcane leaf diseases severely impact crop yield and quality, making accurate and timely detection critical for sustainable agriculture. Conventional deep learning models for plant disease detection depend on large annotated datasets, which are expensive to obtain and challenging to prepare due to challenges commonly observed across crop disease detection tasks, including (i) high intra-class variation caused by diverse symptom expressions across growth stages, (ii) subtle inter-class similarities between diseased and healthy tissues, and (iii) the risk of noisy labels degrading model reliability. To handle these challenges, we presented an Uncertainty-aware Mean-Teacher based Semi-Supervised Learning Disease Detection Network (U-SSDNet) that leverages unlabeled data while maintaining robustness. First, discrete wavelet transform preprocessing is applied to enhance lesion visibility and reduce intra- class variation. Subsequently, the KL divergence is employed to refine the pseudo-labels and reduce the impact of confirmation bias. At the same time, supervised contrastive learning is applied to make the features more distin- guishable and improve the separation among different classes. Experimental evaluations on sugarcane leaf disease datasets, considered a representative case study, demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves performance close to that of fully supervised models while requiring far fewer annotated samples and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and semi-supervised approaches.

</details>


### [302] [Surface Reconstruction from Range Scans Under Visibility Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18005)
*Gabriel Lenain,Edmond Boyer,Jean Ponce*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将曲面重建表述为沿每条采集射线的稳健回归问题，利用1-Lipschitz MLP表示曲面并用球体追踪计算首次命中，借助Huber损失实现无需法向、离面点和eikonal损失的稳健重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 距离扫描重建在噪声和离群点存在时具有挑战性，需要在观测保真度与对测量误差的敏感性之间取得平衡。现有大多数神经方法丢弃了传感器位置和可见性信息，转而依赖几何先验或正则项来弥补这一损失。

Method: 方法核心是将曲面重建表述为稳健回归：对每条采集射线，将预测的首次曲面交点深度回归到其测量深度，并对传感器与观测点之间的预测交点施加惩罚。曲面用1-Lipschitz多层感知机的零水平集表示，从而可用线性收敛的球体追踪计算首次命中，并采用稳健的Huber损失进行回归。该方法不需要有向法向、离面采样点或eikonal损失。

Result: 在不同噪声与离群点污染水平的合成与真实数据上，与当前最先进方法比较显示：在干净数据上性能相当，在即使中等程度污染下保真度和稳健性也大幅提升。分析进一步确认了保真度与稳健性之间的权衡：更强的拟合能力提升干净情况下的数据保真度，但会增加对真实采集固有测量误差的敏感性，通常在中等容量时出现最佳平衡点。

Conclusion: 通过将曲面重建视为沿射线的稳健回归并显式利用传感器可见性信息，本文方法无需法向、离面点和eikonal损失即可实现竞争性性能，并在噪声与离群点下显著提升稳健性，同时揭示了拟合容量与稳健性之间的权衡。

Abstract: Surface reconstruction from range scans is challenging in the presence of noise and outliers, as fidelity to observations must be balanced against sensitivity to measurement errors. Yet, most neural approaches discard the sensor positions and corresponding visibility information, compensating for this loss with geometric priors or regularization terms. We instead formulate surface reconstruction as robust regression of the predicted first surface intersection along each acquisition ray against its measured depth, which penalizes predicted surface intersections within the segment between the sensor and the observed point. We represent the surface as the zero set of a 1-Lipschitz multi-layer perceptron, allowing the use of linearly convergent sphere tracing to compute the first hit, and use a robust Huber loss for regression. Our formulation requires neither oriented normals, sampled off-surface points, nor an eikonal loss. Comparisons with the state of the art on synthetic and real data with varying levels of noise and outlier contamination demonstrate competitive performance on clean data and much improved fidelity and robustness under even moderate corruption. Our analysis further confirms a trade-off between fidelity and robustness: greater fitting capacity improves data fidelity in the clean case but increases sensitivity to the measurement errors inherent in real acquisitions, with a sweet spot typically emerging at intermediate capacity.

</details>


### [303] [Dynamic Interpolation for Training-Time Prediction Reshaping in Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18018)
*Peirui Zhu,Shijie Hao,Jingxi Liao,Richang Hong,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出仅用于训练的动态插值模块 DITM，通过亮度感知插值重塑监督式低光图像增强的训练动态，在不增加推理成本的前提下提升保真度与感知质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光图像增强中光照不足、噪声放大与结构退化强耦合，现有方法或依赖复杂网络架构（增加模型复杂度与部署负担），或依赖经验调参的目标函数（损失权重需人工调试）。论文从训练动态视角重新审视监督式 LLIE。

Method: 观察到亮度相关误差收敛较早，而残余噪声与结构伪影在训练后期优化不足。提出 DITM：不引入额外可学习参数，采用亮度感知插值，将模型预测与"按真值平均亮度对预测重缩放得到的均值亮度对齐图像"进行组合，从而降低全局亮度差异的相对主导地位，使残余局部误差在反向传播中更具影响。DITM 仅用于训练，推理时完全移除。

Result: 在多个基准数据集以及 CNN、Transformer、Mamba 三类 LLIE 骨干网络上进行大量实验，DITM 一致地提升了保真度与感知质量，同时保持推理时架构不变，且不引入额外推理计算。

Conclusion: DITM 是一种即插即用、零推理开销的训练期模块，通过重塑训练动态实现伪影抑制与细节恢复，可广泛兼容不同 LLIE 骨干，对实际部署友好。

Abstract: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is an important image/video processing problem for reliable visual systems under poor illumination, yet it remains challenging due to the strong coupling among insufficient illumination, noise amplification, and structural degradation. Existing methods typically rely on sophisticated network architectures or engineered objective functions. While effective, the former increases model complexity and deployment burden, whereas the latter relies on empirically tuned loss weights. We revisit supervised LLIE from a training-dynamics perspective and observe that brightness-related errors tend to converge early, while residual noise and structural artifacts often remain insufficiently optimized in later stages. To address this issue, we propose a Dynamic Interpolation Training-only Module (DITM), which introduces no additional learnable parameters and adaptively reshapes the model prediction for supervised feed-forward LLIE training. Specifically, DITM employs brightness-aware interpolation, in which the model prediction is combined with a mean brightness-aligned image constructed by rescaling the model prediction according to the mean brightness of the ground-truth image. By reducing the relative dominance of global brightness discrepancy, DITM makes residual local errors more influential during backpropagation after global luminance has largely stabilized, thereby facilitating artifact suppression and fine-detail restoration in later training stages. DITM is used only during training and is fully removed at inference, introducing no additional inference cost. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets and CNN-, Transformer-, and Mamba-based LLIE backbones show that DITM consistently improves fidelity and perceptual quality while preserving the inference-time architecture and introducing no additional inference-time computation.

</details>


### [304] [FlowSim: Rendering-Free Closed-Loop Simulation for Evaluating End-to-End Driving Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18030)
*Hanfeng Wu,Alvaro Marcos-Ramiro,Michael Schmidt,Christoph Stiller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowSim 提出一种无需渲染的闭环仿真范式，直接从潜表示预测潜表示，绕过图像渲染与感知重编码，在保持下游行为的同时显著提速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端驾驶系统的闭环评估通常需要生成传感器观测并再次经过感知编码器处理，计算开销大，且模拟与真实传感器观测之间存在 sim2real 差距。作者由此提出根本性问题：图像空间仿真对于 E2E 驾驶系统的闭环评估是否必要。

Method: 提出 FlowSim，一种渲染无关的仿真范式：基于上一时刻的潜表示与目标帧的符号化场景条件，直接预测内部潜表示；预测的潜表示交由原本冻结的下游模块处理，从而省去图像渲染和感知重编码。方法引入显式的跨帧智能体关联以提升潜状态转移预测与推演稳定性，并采用可变时域仿真，从同一真实锚点进行长时域预测而不累积中间推演误差。

Result: 在 nuScenes 与 NavSim 上的实验表明，FlowSim 在保持下游行为方面具有竞争力，在源到参考一致性上往往超过图像空间仿真，适用于不同仿真时域以及稠密和稀疏潜表示。由于直接预测潜表示，FlowSim 的两种实例每步仿真仅需 0.04–0.06 秒，明显快于所对比的图像空间仿真方法。

Conclusion: FlowSim 可作为传统图像空间仿真方法的一种高效且实用的替代方案，说明图像空间仿真并非 E2E 驾驶系统闭环评估的必要条件。

Abstract: Closed-loop evaluation of end-to-end (E2E) driving systems typically relies on generating sensor observations and re-processing them through the perception encoder, introducing substantial computational cost and a sim2real gap between simulated and real sensor observations. In this paper, we ask a more fundamental question: is image-space simulation necessary for closed-loop evaluation of E2E driving systems? We propose FlowSim, a rendering-free simulation paradigm that predicts the internal latent representation directly from a previous latent and target-frame symbolic scene conditions. The predicted latent is then processed by the original frozen downstream modules, eliminating image rendering and perception re-encoding. Explicit cross-frame agent association improves latent transition prediction and rollout stability, while variable-horizon simulation enables long-horizon prediction from a common real anchor without accumulating intermediate rollout errors. Experiments on nuScenes and NavSim demonstrate that FlowSim preserves downstream behavior competitively with, and often exceeds image-space simulation in source-to-reference agreement across variable simulation horizons and both dense and sparse latent representations. By predicting the latent directly, both instantiations of FlowSim simulate each step in 0.04--0.06s, substantially faster than the image-space simulation methods they are compared against. These results establish FlowSim as an efficient and practical alternative to conventional image-space simulation methods.

</details>


### [305] [COMPASS: Contextual Moment Prior Alignment for Generalizable AIGI Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18034)
*Zhan Yang,Tiancheng Shen,Weijie Lyu,Shuo Chen,Bernard Ghanem,Yibo Yang,Ming-Hsuan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出COMPASS框架，通过引入目标语义代理集估计激活统计量，将激活协方差融入预训练权重的子空间分解，实现数据感知的子空间适配，在AIGI与deepfake检测的多项泛化评测上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用化AIGI与deepfake检测面临“不对称现象”：适配有限的训练分布会损害视觉基础模型（VFM）的可迁移表示。现有子空间适配方法通过冻结高幅值主成分、适配残差子空间来缓解该问题，但其基于幅值的分解与数据无关，未显式考虑目标相关语义，可能导致语义错位。

Method: 提出COMPASS（COntextual Moment Prior Alignment for Subspace Separation），一个数据感知的子空间适配框架。它使用一个小的无标签语义代理集（Semantic Proxy Set）估计目标激活统计；将激活协方差纳入预训练权重的分解中，把目标相关表示保留为稳定的语义参照，同时由残差适配器学习伪造相关变化。代理校准无需基于梯度的优化。

Result: 在跨数据集、跨方法、跨数据集-方法联合以及开放世界跨生成器等多种评测中展现出强泛化能力，在Deepfake与AIGI检测基准上均达到当前最优性能。

Conclusion: 以数据感知的目标激活协方差替代与数据无关的幅值分解，可有效缓解语义错位、保护VFM可迁移表示，从而显著提升AIGI与deepfake检测的泛化性。

Abstract: Generalizable AI-generated image (AIGI) and deepfake detection remain challenging due to the asymmetry phenomenon, where adaptation to limited training distributions can degrade the transferable representations of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). Recent subspace adaptation methods mitigate this issue by freezing high-magnitude principal components while adapting the residual subspace. However, such magnitude-based decomposition is data-agnostic and does not explicitly account for target-relevant semantics, potentially leading to semantic misalignment. We propose COMPASS (COntextual Moment Prior Alignment for Subspace Separation), a data-aware subspace adaptation framework that uses a small unlabeled Semantic Proxy Set to estimate target activation statistics. COMPASS incorporates activation covariance into the decomposition of pre-trained weights, preserving target-relevant representations as a stable semantic reference while the residual adapter learns forgery-related variations. The proxy calibration requires no gradient-based optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong generalization across cross-dataset, cross-method, joint cross-dataset-method, and open-world cross-generator evaluations, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both Deepfake and AIGI detection benchmarks.

</details>


### [306] [Scaling Vision Transformers Without Training: Prune-and-Merge Token Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18039)
*Vatsal,Soumil Malhotra,Priyanshu Chahal,Sanjeev Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的 Prune-and-Merge ViT 框架，结合类注意力剪枝与相似度合并来降低 ViT 计算开销，并引入 RAD 与 PFR 两个指标评估鲁棒性，实验表明其在保持精度与预测稳定性上优于现有 token 缩减方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT 因 token 间的二次交互而计算成本高昂；现有免训练 token 缩减方法虽提升效率，但其鲁棒性尚未被充分探究。

Method: 提出免训练框架 Prune-and-Merge ViT，可直接用于现成模型，将基于类注意力的剪枝与基于相似度的合并相结合，在减少冗余的同时保留语义信息；并引入相对精度下降（RAD）与预测翻转率（PFR）两项鲁棒性评估指标。

Result: 在预训练的 ViT 和 DeiT 上，该方法在降低计算量的同时保持鲁棒性，且精度优于现有 token 缩减方法。

Conclusion: 分析表明，混合式 token 缩减不会引入类幻觉行为，并能在常见图像变换下保持预测稳定性。

Abstract: Vision Transformers achieve strong performance but incur high computational costs from quadratic token interactions. Training-free token reduction methods improve efficiency, but their robustness remains underexplored. We propose Prune-and Merge ViT, a training-free framework for off-the-shelf models. It combines class attention-based pruning with similarity-based merging to reduce redundancy while preserving semantic information. To evaluate robustness we introduce two metrics. Relative Accuracy Drop (RAD) measures relative accuracy degradation under transformations, and Prediction Flip Rate (PFR) quantifies prediction consistency. On pretrained ViT and DeiT, Prune-and-Merge reduces computation competitively while maintaining robustness and better accuracy than existing token reduction methods. Our analysis suggests that hybrid token reduction does not introduce hallucination-like behavior and preserves prediction stability for common image transformations.

</details>


### [307] [LensErase: A Foundation Model for Erase Anything](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18072)
*Yunuo Chen,Xiuyu Wu,Qinhong Yang,Jinjing Zhao,Yanchen Dong,Sirui Zhang,Dong Chen,Fangyun Wei,Lei Shi,Ji Li,Dongdong Chen,Guo Lu,Yan Lu,Baining Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LensErase 是一个基于掩码的通用“擦除任意内容”基础模型，通过大规模数据集、预训练适配、Mask-Aware RoPE、多阶段微调与推理优化，在多个基准上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像擦除方法难以覆盖广泛真实场景，如多样物体、视觉文本、水印、视觉特效、多物体移除，以及不同尺度、长宽比和分辨率。作者希望构建一个通用的擦除基础模型，统一支持这些多样擦除需求。

Method: 1) 构建 LensErase-100M 大规模数据集，包含 1.0107 亿组源图-掩码-目标图样本；2) 基于文本到图像模型 Lens 进行预训练，将其生成先验适配到基于掩码的擦除任务；3) 提出 Mask-Aware RoPE，将掩码信息通过 3D 旋转位置编码直接注入源图 token，避免额外掩码 token 序列；4) 通过监督微调和基于契约引导、区域感知奖励的强化学习进行精调；5) 推理时使用 TraceFusion 保持有效编辑区域外的高保真内容。

Result: 在六个公开基准和提出的 LensErase-Bench 上，LensErase 在参考型客观指标和无参考 VLM 评估下均取得显著提升。

Conclusion: LensErase 有望作为擦除相关应用与系统的基础模型。

Abstract: We introduce LensErase, a general-purpose mask-based Erase Anything foundation model designed to cover a broad spectrum of real-world erase scenarios. LensErase supports diverse objects, visual text, watermarks, associated visual effects, multiple-object removal, and a wide range of object scales, aspect ratios, and image resolutions. First, to enable such broad coverage, we construct LensErase-100M, a large-scale dataset containing 101.07 million paired source-mask-target examples spanning diverse erase scenarios. Second, we pretrain LensErase from the text-to-image model Lens, adapting its strong generative prior to mask-based erasing. To efficiently incorporate the source image and erase mask, we propose Mask-Aware RoPE, a 3D rotary positional encoding that directly injects mask information into the source-image tokens without introducing a separate mask token sequence. Finally, we refine the model through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with contract-guided, region-aware rewards, and apply TraceFusion at inference to preserve high-fidelity content outside the effective edit region. Across six public benchmarks and the proposed LensErase-Bench, LensErase achieves substantial improvements under both reference-based objective metrics and reference-free VLM evaluation. We hope LensErase can serve as a foundational model for erase-related applications and systems.

</details>


### [308] [APT: Feedback-Driven Agentic Post-Training for Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18097)
*Sirui Zhang,Fangyun Wei,Dong Chen,Jinjing Zhao,Yitong Wang,Yunuo Chen,Baining Guo,Zheng-Jun Zha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出APT（Agentic Post-Training）全自动框架，利用三个智能体协同，根据基础模型不断进化的能力画像自适应地进行后训练，形成类递归自我改进的反馈闭环，实现模型、基准与架构无关的自动化提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型的后训练流程通常依赖人工筛选的训练数据和固定的训练分布，难以针对模型自身特点进行适配，导致效率与效果受限。

Method: APT协调三个智能体：从用户需求构建评估集、诊断模型特定优势与失败模式、生成强调薄弱能力的自适应提示分布的强化学习数据。通过反复评估、诊断并更新生成器，让当前模型行为塑造下一轮训练任务；针对无用户指定评估场景的通用设定，还设计了评估框架以生成广泛多样的评估集。

Result: 在多种基础模型、基准和生成架构上的实验表明，APT具有模型无关、基准无关、架构无关且完全自动化的特性。

Conclusion: APT为文本到图像模型提供了一种可自适应、全自动化的后训练范式，通过智能体驱动的反馈闭环实现持续改进，具有良好的通用性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Post-training is crucial for improving text-to-image models, yet existing pipelines typically rely on manually curated training data and fixed training distributions. We introduce APT (Agentic Post-Training), a fully automated framework that adaptively post-trains a base model according to its evolving capability profile. APT coordinates three agents to construct evaluation sets from user requirements, diagnose model-specific strengths and failure modes, and generate reinforcement learning data with an adaptive prompt distribution that emphasizes underperforming capabilities. By repeatedly evaluating, diagnosing, and updating the generator, APT lets the current model's behavior shape its next training tasks, forming a feedback loop inspired by recursive self-improvement. For general-purpose settings without user-specified evaluation scenarios, we further develop an evaluation harness that enables broad and diverse evaluation set generation. Experiments across multiple base models, benchmarks, and generation architectures demonstrate that APT is model-agnostic, benchmark-agnostic, architecture-agnostic, and fully automated.

</details>


### [309] [H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18125)
*Or Ronai,Vladimir Kulikov,Tomer Michaeli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 H-DDCM，用隐式随机哈达玛字典替代高斯码本，实现可扩展的无训练生成式压缩，兼顾图像与视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于码本的无训练扩散压缩方法（如 Turbo-DDCM）在超低码率下感知质量好，但密集高斯码本在内存和计算上开销大，难以扩展到现代图像/视频生成器的高维潜空间，且组合式比特流编码在此规模下计算沉重。

Method: 用隐式随机哈达玛字典替代高斯码本，借助快速沃尔什-哈达玛变换在 O(d log d) 计算与 O(d) 内存下隐式合成全维字典，无需显式存储；提出免表的字典序编码方案使高维组合编码实用化；并将框架适配到自回归视频流模型，设计流式压缩方案，周期性将近期重建帧重新编码为新的 KV-cache 前缀，在不额外传输比特的情况下保持跨段时序上下文。

Result: 在图像与视频基准上，H-DDCM 取得有竞争力的率-失真-感知性能，同时显著降低基于码本的无训练生成式压缩的内存与计算开销；支持单 GPU 上的长时、接近实时的生成式视频压缩。

Conclusion: H-DDCM 通过隐式哈达玛字典与高效编码，提升了无训练生成式压缩的可扩展性，并成功扩展到长视频流式压缩场景。

Abstract: Training-free diffusion-based compression methods repurpose the generative priors of a diffusion or a flow model to compress data without retraining them as task-specific codecs. Recent codebook-based approaches such as Turbo-DDCM achieve strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, but their reliance on dense Gaussian codebooks remains costly in both memory and computation, and scales poorly with the large latent dimensions of modern image and video generators. Their combinatorial bitstream encoding further becomes computationally heavy at this scale. We introduce H-DDCM, a scalable generative compression framework that replaces Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform allows for implicitly synthesizing full-dimensional dictionaries with $O(d \log d)$ compute for projection and reconstruction and $O(d)$ memory, without materializing the full-dimensional dictionary. We further introduce an efficient table-free lexicographic coding scheme that makes combinatorial encoding practical at larger dimensions. Beyond images, we adapt the framework to an autoregressive video flow model and develop a streaming compression scheme that periodically re-encodes recently reconstructed frames into a fresh KV-cache prefix, preserving temporal context across segments at no additional transmitted bits. This enables long-form, close to real-time generative video compression on a single GPU. Across image and video benchmarks, H-DDCM achieves competitive rate-distortion-perception performance while substantially reducing the memory and computational overhead of codebook-based training-free generative compression.

</details>


### [310] [Human-Inspired Asymmetric Collaboration for Dual-Student Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18133)
*Huiyi Ren,Ziming Fang,Jiaming Cai,Rui Xu,Haojie Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Human-Inspired Asymmetric Collaboration (HAC)闭环双学生框架，通过强化学习引导的难度校准与几何保持约束，在弱-强增强下实现自适应难度调节，提升半监督医学图像分割的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在半监督医学图像分割（SSMIS）中，双学生学习通过引入弱增强与强增强视图来丰富预测多样性。但强增强不足会导致学生同质化，过强则会破坏解剖证据并使协同不稳定，因此需要动态调节增强难度以维持弱-强学习的平衡。

Method: 提出HAC框架，包含两个模块：（1）Reinforcement-guided Difficulty Calibration (RDC)：将强增强控制建模为窗口级强化学习过程，利用增强历史、实际扰动和训练响应，动态调整增强幅度、操作数量与幅度范围；（2）Gramian Geometry Preservation Constraint (G2PC)：通过全局体积与成对面积约束保持早期三支几何结构，防止共享监督导致两学生同质化。

Result: 在LA、Pancreas和BraTS-2019数据集上的综合评估验证了HAC的分割有效性以及具备能力感知的难度校准能力。

Conclusion: 受人类反馈调节式教学启发，HAC通过自适应难度校准与几何保持，实现闭环双学生协同，有效缓解强增强带来的同质化与不稳定问题，提升半监督医学图像分割性能。

Abstract: Dual-student learning enriches predictive diversity in SSMIS by introducing a strongly augmented view alongside a weakly augmented view. Insufficient strong augmentation may homogenize the students, whereas excessive augmentation can corrupt anatomical evidence and destabilize collaboration. This challenge echoes feedback-regulated human instruction, where learners receive differentiated tasks and the task difficulty is continually adjusted according to their evolving responses. Inspired by these, we propose Human-Inspired Asymmetric Collaboration (HAC), a closed-loop dual-student framework that maintains weak--strong learning through adaptive difficulty calibration and geometry preservation. Specifically, Reinforcement-guided Difficulty Calibration (RDC) formulates strong-augmentation control as a window-level reinforcement learning process, using augmentation history, realized perturbations, and training responses to dynamically adjust the augmentation magnitude, operation number, and magnitude range. Meanwhile, the Gramian Geometry Preservation Constraint (G2PC) preserves the early-stage three-branch geometry through global volume and pairwise area constraints, preventing shared supervision from homogenizing the two students. Comprehensive evaluations across LA, Pancreas, and BraTS-2019 validate both the segmentation effectiveness and capability-aware difficulty calibration of HAC.

</details>


### [311] [FlowCred: Hierarchical Credit Assignment and Functional Coordination for Joint Text-to-Video Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18142)
*Mingxuan Zhu,Yanwei Huang,Shiyuan Liu,Xinzhi Zhang,Shujie Li,Yuanxing Zhang,Lu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowCred 是一个面向文本到视频（T2V）联合后训练的两级框架，通过分层信用分配与功能协调，缓解提示策略与生成器从同一终端奖励优化带来的歧义，在多个基准上稳定优于匹配的联合训练基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示优化与生成器后训练是提升 T2V 生成的两条互补路径，近期系统倾向联合训练两者。但从同一终端奖励同时优化提示策略与视频生成器会引入两类歧义：提示质量与随机生成过程相互混淆；两个模块可能产生重叠的局部改进，导致信用归属不清、优化效率下降。因此需要一个能够区分二者贡献的联合后训练框架。

Method: FlowCred 采用两级设计。其一，分层信用分配：利用匹配的提示-种子 rollout 网格，在共享随机性下将提示层面的信用与提示条件下的生成器残差分离。其二，功能协调：在实际生成轨迹的状态上探测当前策略的替代提示，为提示优化提供生成器感知的证据，同时选择性衰减那些已由条件变化所支撑的生成器更新。

Result: 在多个 T2V 基准上，FlowCred 持续优于匹配的联合训练基线。在 LTX-2.5 上，相对严格匹配的联合训练对照组，T2V-CompBench 从 61.47 提升至 64.46，StoryEval 从 55.58 提升至 58.08，且未增加解码视频或奖励模型调用预算。因子分析与实际更新分析显示提示塑形与生成器路由具有互补贡献，人类评估以及跨骨干和更新器家族的迁移结果进一步提供支持证据。

Conclusion: FlowCred 通过分层信用分配与功能协调有效解耦了提示优化与生成器后训练的贡献，在不增加计算预算的前提下提升了 T2V 生成质量，并展现出跨模型与更新器家族的泛化能力，为联合后训练提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Prompt optimization and generator post-training are two complementary ways to improve text-to-video (T2V) generation, and recent systems increasingly train both modules jointly. However, optimizing a prompt policy and a video generator from the same terminal reward creates two ambiguities: prompt quality is confounded with stochastic generation, and the two modules may realize overlapping local improvements. We introduce FlowCred, a two-level framework for joint T2V post-training. First, hierarchical credit assignment uses matched prompt-seed rollout grids to separate prompt-level credit from prompt-conditioned generator residuals under shared randomness. Second, functional coordination probes alternative current-policy prompts at states from actual generation trajectories, providing generator-aware evidence for prompt optimization while selectively attenuating generator updates already supported by conditioning changes. Across multiple T2V benchmarks, FlowCred consistently improves matched joint-training baselines. On LTX-2.5, FlowCred improves a strictly matched joint-training control from 61.47 to 64.46 on T2V-CompBench and from 55.58 to 58.08 on StoryEval, without increasing decoded-video or reward-model-call budgets. Factorial and realized-update analyses show complementary contributions from prompt shaping and generator routing, while human evaluation and transfer across backbones and updater families provide further supporting evidence.

</details>


### [312] [Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Zero-Shot Human-Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18161)
*Oriol Rabasseda,Zenjie Li,Kamal Nasrollahi,Sergio Escalera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究多模态大模型（MLLMs）在人物交互（HOI）识别与检测中的零样本能力，提出结合外部检测器与零样本多模态推理的流程、统一提示策略分类体系与logit到交互分数的转换方法，并提出两种视觉提示策略，在HICO、HICO-DET、V-COCO上取得最优零样本性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统HOI方法依赖大量标注数据和固定交互类别体系，难以适应动态的真实场景；而MLLMs具备灵活的零样本推理能力，但其在HOI领域的潜力尚未被探索，因此需要系统性地研究并建立公平的评测框架。

Method: 提出一个将外部目标检测器（用于实体定位）与零样本多模态推理（用于交互理解）相结合的流程；构建零样本评测基准，包括统一的提示策略分类体系和将token级logits转化为交互分数的方法，以在标准指标下与专用HOI模型公平比较；为标准HOI数据集构建新的问答标注；并提出两种视觉提示策略：Objects as Context与Black Other Objects。

Result: 在HICO上达到53.50 mAP，在HICO-DET上达到23.69 mAP，在HICO、HICO-DET和V-COCO上均取得当前最优的零样本性能。

Conclusion: 该工作为MLLMs在HOI领域提供了原则性的基准框架，为新的模型与数据集开辟了道路，并实现了灵活的开放世界交互理解。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong zero-shot reasoning across diverse domains, but their potential for Human-Object Interaction (HOI) remains unexplored. Unlike traditional HOI approaches that rely on extensive labeled datasets and fixed interaction taxonomies, MLLMs offer flexible reasoning, making them well-suited for dynamic, real-world scenarios. In this work, we present the first systematic study of MLLMs for HOI recognition and detection within a pipeline that combines an external object detector for entity localization with zero-shot multimodal reasoning for interaction understanding. We introduce a benchmark framework for principled zero-shot evaluation, consisting of (i) a unified taxonomy of zero-shot prompting strategies, and (ii) a methodology that transforms token-level logits into interaction scores, enabling fair comparison with specialized HOI models under standard metrics. To support prompt-based evaluation, we additionally construct new question-answer annotations for standard HOI datasets, transforming them into a format suitable for MLLMs. Building on this, we propose two visual prompting strategies, namely Objects as Context and Black Other Objects, that guide MLLMs to target objects while preserving scene context. Experiments on HICO, HICO-DET, and V-COCO demonstrate state-of-the-art zero-shot performance, achieving 53.50 mAP on HICO and 23.69 mAP on HICO-DET. Overall, our work provides a principled benchmarking framework for MLLMs in HOI, opening the door to new models and datasets and enabling flexible open-world interaction understanding.

</details>


### [313] [VARI: Robust Text-to-Video Generation via Group-Structured Intent Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18189)
*Mingxuan Zhu,Hohei Chan,Shiyuan Liu,Yuanxing Zhang,Lu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VARI 将同一视觉意图的多种等价提示表述视为一个共享监督单元，通过组一致蒸馏与形式对比流 DPO，提升文本到视频模型对提示改写的一致性与可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 T2V 模型对提示措辞的微小但保义的变化非常敏感，可能导致语义实现和整体质量大幅波动。已有的提示改写方法只是修改推理输入，而常规后训练每次只基于一种提示表述构造监督，二者都未显式优化模型在等价表述间的可靠性。

Method: 提出 VARI（Verified Alignment over Representations of Intent）组结构框架：把自动验证过的、表达同一视觉意图的多种提示形式作为共享监督单元；构建匹配的“形式—种子” rollout 池，将每个视频与所有形式交叉打分，并应用与措辞无关的结构化意图审计以识别有效实现和硬语义失败。其中 Group-Consistent Distillation（GCD）让每个已验证形式对齐可互换的有效实现；Form-Contrastive Flow-DPO（FC-DPO）从审计得到的正负配对中学习组级偏好，并优先使用同种子、不同形式的对比。

Result: 在 HunyuanVideo-1.5 上，VARI 在 T2V-CompBench、VBench 和 StoryEval 上取得所评估方法中的最高分；在 T2V-CompBench 与 VBench 的提示形式扩展上，最弱形式对齐分别比最强提示级基线提升 2.45 和 3.55 分，跨形式性能下降分别减少 30.5% 和 32.2%，同时保持视觉质量。人工评估、自然描述对照、提示增强实验、多样性分析以及在 LTX-2.3 上的迁移实验进一步支持其鲁棒性与可迁移性，且 VARI 不需要额外的推理时模块。

Conclusion: VARI 通过把等价提示表述组织为共享监督单元并联合优化组一致性与组级偏好，显著提升了 T2V 生成对提示改写的鲁棒性，缩小跨形式性能差距，且不增加推理开销，具有良好的可迁移性。

Abstract: Modern text-to-video (T2V) models generate visually compelling videos, yet meaning-preserving changes in prompt wording can substantially alter semantic realization and overall quality. Existing prompt rewriting modifies the inference input, whereas conventional post-training constructs supervision from one prompt formulation at a time; neither explicitly optimizes reliability across equivalent forms. We introduce VARI (Verified Alignment over Representations of Intent), a group-structured framework that treats automatically verified formulations of the same visual intent as a shared supervision unit. VARI builds matched form-seed rollout pools, cross-scores each video against all forms, and applies a wording-independent structured intent audit to identify valid realizations and hard semantic failures. Group-Consistent Distillation (GCD) aligns every verified form with interchangeable valid realizations, while Form-Contrastive Flow-DPO (FC-DPO) learns group-level preferences from audited positive-negative pairs, prioritizing same-seed, different-form contrasts. On HunyuanVideo-1.5, VARI attains the highest T2V-CompBench, VBench, and StoryEval scores among the evaluated methods. On prompt-form extensions of T2V-CompBench and VBench, it improves weakest-form alignment over the strongest prompt-level baselines by 2.45 and 3.55 points and reduces cross-form drop by 30.5% and 32.2%, respectively, while preserving visual quality. Human evaluation, natural-caption controls, prompt-enhancement experiments, diversity analyses, and transfer to LTX-2.3 further support the robustness and transferability of these gains, while VARI requires no additional inference-time module.

</details>


### [314] [Closing the Estimation Gap: Training-Free Transductive Inference for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18209)
*Changyi Li,Zeyu Yang,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过oracle分析揭示CD-FSAR的核心瓶颈在于从稀缺支持样本估计原型与决策边界的"估计差距"，并提出无需训练、不改动主干网络的转导式推理框架TRACE（含CTPR与TCR两阶段），在五个目标数据集上持续提升基线，部分场景提升超6个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨域小样本动作识别（CD-FSAR）虽在表示学习上取得进展，但推理仍依赖极少支持样本估计的原型。作者通过oracle分析（固定表示、用真值查询标签构建oracle原型与决策边界）发现5-way 1-shot准确率可提升7–20个百分点，说明表示本身已含判别信息，真正的瓶颈是"原型与边界估计"的不足。因此作者希望在不修改主干网络的前提下，改进回合级（episode-level）估计。

Method: 提出TRACE，一种免训练的转导式推理框架，包含两个互补阶段：（1）置信度阈值化转导原型精炼（CTPR），利用高置信度预测的查询样本精炼基于支持集的原型；（2）转导分类器精炼（TCR），用精炼后的原型初始化轻量级回合内分类器，并通过鼓励在所有查询上产生高置信、类平衡的预测来进一步适配。两阶段共同改进原型与边界估计，从而更好利用未标注查询中的信息。

Result: 在HMDB51、UCF101、SSv2、Diving48、RareAct五个目标数据集的1-shot与5-shot设置下，TRACE均稳定提升强CD-FSAR基线，其中HMDB51 1-shot提升超过6个百分点，并弥补了oracle估计差距中的大部分。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在极端支持样本稀缺条件下，改进测试时估计（test-time estimation）是表示学习之外一种强大且广泛适用的补充手段，为CD-FSAR提供了新的改进方向。

Abstract: Cross-domain few-shot action recognition (CD-FSAR) aims to recognise unseen action classes in a target domain from a handful of labelled videos. Despite advances in representation learning, CD-FSAR inference still relies on prototypes estimated from extremely limited support examples. To assess this bottleneck, we perform an oracle analysis with the representation fixed. Constructing oracle prototypes and decision boundaries from ground-truth query labels improves 5-way 1-shot accuracy by 7--20 percentage points across five target datasets. This reveals a substantial estimation gap: the representation contains useful discriminative information, but prototypes and boundaries estimated from scarce supports fail to capture each episode's true class structure. Motivated by this, we propose TRACE, a training-free transductive inference framework that improves episode-level estimation without modifying the backbone. TRACE comprises two complementary stages. Confidence-Thresholded Transductive Prototype Refinement (CTPR) refines support-based prototypes using confidently predicted queries. The refined prototypes initialise a lightweight per-episode classifier, which Transductive Classifier Refinement (TCR) further adapts by encouraging confident, class-balanced predictions over all queries. Together, the two stages improve prototype and boundary estimation, enabling better use of information in the unlabelled queries. Across five target datasets (HMDB51, UCF101, SSv2, Diving48, and RareAct) in both 1-shot and 5-shot settings, TRACE consistently improves a strong CD-FSAR baseline, including gains of more than six percentage points on HMDB51 1-shot, while recovering much of the oracle-estimated gap. These results suggest that improving test-time estimation is a powerful, broadly applicable complement to representation learning for CD-FSAR under extreme support scarcity.

</details>


### [315] [Heading Hierarchy Reconstruction for Complex and Long Documents with Level-Wise Multimodal Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18238)
*Qian Chen,Xianyin Zhang,Lifan Guo,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于VLM的框架，利用逐级多模态记忆增量重建文档标题层级，并发布CLDoc-HHRBench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在文档解析和OCR中可准确提取页面级元素，但RAG等下游任务需要文档级一致结构。逐页预测标题层级缺乏文档级一致性，而输入分辨率和上下文长度限制使VLM无法联合处理数十至数百页的文档。

Method: 提出基于VLM的框架，使用逐级多模态记忆增量重建标题层级。记忆通过锚点保留已处理页面的紧凑子集，支持灵活锚点选择；本文选择每级最近的节点，使VLM可观察各级标题的视觉、文本和布局模式。同时构建CLDoc-HHRBench基准，含250个文档、11,212页，由专家验证标注。

Result: 在CLDoc-HHRBench及三个现有基准上的实验证明了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 逐级多模态记忆机制可有效缓解长文档处理约束，实现一致的文档级标题层级重建，并提供了新的评测基准。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been widely adopted for document parsing and optical character recognition (OCR), as they can accurately extract page-level elements. However, downstream applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) also require coherent document-level structure. Although these models indicate heading levels using different numbers of preceding ``\#'' symbols, page-by-page prediction often lacks document-level consistency. In practice, input-resolution and context-length constraints make it infeasible for a VLM to jointly process all page images in documents containing tens or hundreds of pages. To address this limitation, we propose a VLM-based framework that incrementally reconstructs heading hierarchies with a \emph{level-wise multimodal memory}. The memory retains a compact subset of all previously processed pages, selected by anchors. Our framework supports flexible anchor selection, and in this work we select the most recent node at each level, allowing the VLM to observe the visual, textual, and layout patterns of headings at every level. For comprehensive evaluation, we also introduce the Complex and Long Document Heading Hierarchy Reconstruction Benchmark (CLDoc-HHRBench), comprising 250 documents and 11,212 pages with expert-verified annotations. Experiments on CLDoc-HHRBench and three existing benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

</details>


### [316] [LiFUSE: Frequency-Spatial Unified Self-Supervised Pretraining for Liver Disease Analysis on Non-contrast CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18243)
*Hao Zhang,Yi Huang,Wei Liu,Yuan Gao,Zeju Li,Xu Han,Yu Shi,Ling Zhang,Ke Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LiFUSE，一种面向平扫CT（NCCT）的肝脏频率-空间统一自监督预训练框架，通过频域带阻掩蔽重构与空域混合粒度掩蔽体素重构，并用跨域一致性约束耦合两分支，提升肝脏肿瘤与弥漫性肝病的表征学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球肝肿瘤与弥漫性肝病负担加重，NCCT因低成本、安全性好被用于机会性筛查；但NCCT组织对比度低、缺乏血流动力学增强、解剖背景复杂，导致肿瘤检测与细粒度诊断困难。现有大规模自监督预训练虽能从未标注NCCT学习表征，但传统逐体素重构未充分利用NCCT中的互补信息，低层强度模式在弱对比下对病理识别信息量不足。

Method: 提出LiFUSE统一自监督预训练框架：频率分支采用随机带阻掩蔽与频谱重构，促使模型捕捉病灶与周围组织的细微差异；空间分支执行混合粒度掩蔽体素重构，以适应不同大小和形态的病灶；最后通过跨域一致性方案耦合空间与频率分支，获得对肝脏结构与病灶更具判别力的表征。

Result: 在内部队列的三个临床相关任务以及一个公开目标域迁移设置上进行了大量实验，LiFUSE一致优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 统一的频率-空间学习能够改善NCCT上的肝病分析，展现了其在大规模筛查中的应用潜力。

Abstract: Given the growing global burden of liver tumors and diffuse liver diseases, non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) is increasingly used for opportunistic screening because of its low cost and favorable safety profile. However, downstream tasks such as tumor detection and fine-grained disease diagnosis remain challenging due to NCCT's inherently low tissue contrast, lack of hemodynamic enhancement, and complex anatomical background. These limitations make subtle, heterogeneous, and multifocal hepatic lesions difficult to identify. Although large-scale self-supervised pretraining can learn robust representations from unlabeled NCCT scans, conventional voxel-wise reconstruction does not fully exploit the complementary information available in NCCT. Under weak NCCT contrast, low-level intensity patterns become less informative for pathology recognition, limiting the capture of lesion-specific discriminative features. In this paper, we propose the Liver Frequency-Spatial Unified Self-Supervised Pretraining (LiFUSE). The frequency branch applies random band-stop masking and spectrum reconstruction to encourage the model to capture subtle differences between lesions and surrounding tissues, while the spatial branch performs hybrid-granularity masked volumetric reconstruction to accommodate lesions of diverse sizes and morphologies. Finally, a cross-domain consistency scheme couples the spatial and frequency branches, yielding more discriminative representations for hepatic structures and lesions. Extensive experiments on three clinically relevant tasks across internal cohorts and a public target-domain transfer setting show that LiFUSE consistently outperforms strong baselines. These results suggest that unified frequency-spatial learning can improve liver disease analysis on NCCT, highlighting its potential for large-scale screening.

</details>


### [317] [FALLNEST: Dual-Domain Dataset Condensation of Imbalanced IMU Data for Wearable Fall Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18260)
*Rashi Niyas P,Ritika Jain,Hitika Tiwari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FALLNEST通过归一化梯度与嵌入匹配的合成时频压缩，将大规模不平衡IMU数据集蒸馏为极小的类别均衡合成训练集，在SisFall、KFall、MobiFall上仅用约1%训练窗口即可达到93.5-95.8%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴跌倒检测面临跌倒事件稀少、标注IMU数据匮乏，以及在大规模不平衡数据集上训练深度模型成本高的问题。现有方法要么依赖手工特征与浅层分类器，限制了对原始信号的学习；要么在完整数据集上训练深度网络，需重采样应对类别偏斜，且耗费大量数据与算力。

Method: 提出FALLNEST，一种以数据为中心的框架，基于双域时间序列压缩（CondTSC），将大型不平衡IMU数据集蒸馏为极小且类别均衡的合成训练集。具体引入面向跌倒的7通道输入（包含加速度向量幅值）、类别均衡的K-Means初始化、带梯度裁剪的归一化梯度匹配，并结合基于MMD的嵌入对齐与多视角傅里叶域增强，使类别均衡源自压缩集本身而非重采样。

Result: 在SisFall、KFall和MobiFall上采用严格按受试者划分的数据切分与自然不平衡测试集，报告五个随机种子下的准确率、Macro-F1和PR-AUC。仅用32至146个合成窗口（约为训练窗口的1%）训练的102K参数TinyCNN达到93.5-95.8%的平均准确率和0.89-0.98的PR-AUC，准确率标准差为1.0-1.7%。

Conclusion: 实验表明，FALLNEST通过时频域合成数据压缩有效缓解了跌倒检测中的数据稀缺与类别不平衡问题，在极小训练规模下仍保持高精度与稳定性，验证了该数据为中心方法的有效性。

Abstract: Wearable fall detection is hampered by rare fall events, scarce labeled IMU data, and the cost of training deep models on large, imbalanced corpora. Existing methods either rely on hand-crafted features with shallow classifiers, which limits learning from raw signals, or train deep networks on full datasets that require re-sampling to counter class skew and demand substantial data and compute. To address this, we propose a novel Fall detection framework via Normalized-gradient and Embedding matched Synthetic Time-frequency condensation, dubbed FALLNEST, a data-centric approach that distills large, imbalanced IMU datasets into tiny, class-balanced synthetic training sets. Building on dual-domain time-series condensation (CondTSC), FALLNEST introduces a fall-specific 7-channel input with accelerometer vector magnitude, class-balanced K-Means initialization, and normalized gradient matching with gradient clipping, combined with MMD-based embedding alignment and multi-view Fourier-domain augmentation, so that class balance arises from the condensed set itself rather than from re-sampling. We evaluate on SisFall, KFall, and MobiFall using strict subject-wise splits and naturally imbalanced test sets, reporting accuracy, Macro-F1, and PR-AUC over five seeds. A 102K-parameter TinyCNN trained on only 32 to 146 synthetic windows (about only 1% of the training windows) reaches 93.5-95.8% mean accuracy and 0.89-0.98 PR-AUC, with standard deviations of 1.0-1.7% in accuracy, demonstrating the efficacy of our approach.

</details>


### [318] [Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18276)
*Thierry Bouwmans,Anastasia Zakharova,Belmar Garcia,Marwa Chendeb El Rai,Meghna Kapoor,Badri Narayan Subudhi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对红外小目标检测领域的传统与近期方法进行了全面综述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外小目标检测广泛应用于军民多场景，近三十年尤其是近二十年的低秩稀疏分解与深度学习推动了大量重要成果涌现。然而现有综述缺乏对该领域的整体性回顾，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 按建模方式将文献方法分为数学模型、机器学习模型与信号处理模型三类，并围绕其宣称可应对的关键情境进行讨论；同时梳理可用资源、数据集与库。综述分为两部分：第一部分聚焦传统及低秩稀疏分解（模型驱动）方法，第二部分聚焦深度学习（数据驱动）方法。

Result: 提供了传统与近期红外小目标检测方法的完整分类与系统梳理，并汇总了相关数据集、资源与库。

Conclusion: 本文给出该领域的整体性综述，并指出若干有前景的未来研究方向。

Abstract: Infrared small target detection is often used in different civilian and military applications to detect static or moving targets in scenes like in ground, air and sea surveillance. First valuable research has emerged since 30 years ago and the two last decades witnessed very significant publications in this field following the rise of low-rank and sparse decomposition (model-based methods) and deep learning models (data-based methods). Furthermore, several surveys can be found in the literature but none of them addresses an overall review in this field. In this context, the aim of this paper is to provide a complete survey of the traditional and recent approaches in infrared small target detection. First, we categorize the different approaches found in the literature in terms of the modeling models, i.e mathematical models, machine learning models and signal processing models. Then, we have discussed them in terms of the critical situations that they claim to handle. Furthermore, we present the available resources, datasets and libraries. Then, we conclude with several promising directions for future research. For the sake of reading, this survey is divided into two parts: 1) "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1)" about conventional and low-rank and sparse decomposition (model-based methods), and 2) "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 2)" about deep learning models (data-based methods).

</details>


### [319] [Efficient Scene-Text Refinement via Pixel-Space Grouped Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18284)
*Yaoli Liu,Guo-Hua Wang,Yiyang Chen,Qing-Guo Chen,Zhao Xu,Weihua Luo,Yao-Xiang Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixText将局部文本精修定义为像素空间的分组图像生成，仅生成目标区域并保留未编辑内容，采用四步MeanFlow生成，并提出Text Refinement Bench评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成图像布局和视觉内容连贯，但小文本和复杂字符的局部错误限制其可读性与实用性；场景文本精修需兼顾准确性、保留性与效率，而现有VAE方法重建时丢失细笔画，全图编辑会改变背景颜色。

Method: 提出PixText，将局部文本精修建模为像素空间中的分组图像生成，以原图为条件仅生成目标区域、保留未编辑内容，并使用MeanFlow实现四步生成；同时构建Text Refinement Bench基准，评估文本纠错与图像保留。

Result: 在该基准上，PixText达到83.06%字形通过率与94.66%精确目标字符OCR准确率，最强基线分别为36.77%和52.31%；其四步MeanFlow变体保持81.84%通过率，单图摊销生成成本低于1 GPU秒。

Conclusion: PixText在准确性、保留性和效率上均优于现有基线，验证了像素空间分组生成与MeanFlow少步采样的有效性，为生成图像局部文本精修提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Generated images often have coherent layouts and visual content, yet local errors in small text and complex characters still limit their readability and practical use. Scene-text refinement requires accuracy, preservation, and efficiency. Existing methods based on variational autoencoders (VAEs) can lose fine strokes during reconstruction, while full-image editing can shift background colors. In this work, we introduce PixText, a model that formulates local text refinement as grouped image generation in pixel space. Conditioned on the original image, PixText generates only the target regions, preserves unedited content, and uses MeanFlow for four-step generation. We further introduce Text Refinement Bench to evaluate text correction and image preservation in generated images. On this benchmark, PixText achieves 83.06% glyph pass and 94.66% exact target-character OCR accuracy, versus 36.77% and 52.31% for the strongest baseline. Its four-step MeanFlow variant retains an 81.84% pass rate with less than one GPU-second of amortized generation cost per image.

</details>


### [320] [LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18289)
*Ziyu Zhu,Zhaoxu Sun,Fan Jiang,Mengchao Wang,Junfeng Ni,Ting-Bing Xu,Zhicheng Liu,Mu Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LongForcing，通过将蒸馏监督扩展到长时间学生自回归轨迹，缓解长时域世界模型中的渐进漂移问题，在文生视频和交互式世界建模任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型在超出训练窗口后会遭遇渐进漂移：画质下降、运动不一致、物体身份逐渐崩塌，原因是生成帧被递归作为上下文复用。作者指出存在“监督时域鸿沟”——短时域蒸馏使后续rollout状态缺乏直接监督。研究表明匹配短窗口边缘分布并不能决定长时域行为，而更长的on-policy轨迹能暴露延迟出现的失败，因此需要在规模上进行时间流形匹配。

Method: LongForcing保留短时域的teacher-forcing与因果ODE蒸馏阶段，在最后的分布匹配阶段用扩展时域的双向教师替代realscore教师。该长时域教师以标准分布匹配公式监督扩展的学生自回归rollout，不修改学生架构也不增加推理开销。

Result: 在文生视频生成上达到VBench Quality得分85.52；在交互式动作条件世界模型中，第一人称消融实验将WorldRoamBench 60秒动作得分提升23.9分。定性压力测试中可采样长达24小时的交互rollout，远超训练时域。

Conclusion: 结果表明，沿时间轴扩展监督是迈向长时域世界模型的实用步骤。项目网站与代码见https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models.
