We propose Radar Geometric-Semantic Occupancy Prediction (RadarGSOcc), an efficient framework that directly processes 4D radar tensors by separately extracting geometric and semantic features, including Doppler information, with a deformable attention-based geometric refinement module as its key component. We also introduce the K-Radar 3DSemOcc benchmark, the first large-scale benchmark for 3D semantic occupancy prediction using 4D radar tensors, built on the K-Radar dataset with refined LiDAR-based annotations. RadarGSOcc predicts 15 classes within a 51.2m range and achieves 38.2% IoU, 7.6% mIoU, and 25.5% weighted mIoU, outperforming RadarOcc by 17% relative (25.5 vs. 21.9) in weighted mIoU while using fewer parameters and lower computation. It substantially improves truck prediction while trading off car accuracy, outperforms camera-based approaches, and narrows the gap with LiDAR-based methods. To assess robustness without per-frame ground truth in adverse weather, we further propose a novel proxy metric, Environment-Based KL Divergence (EBKL), under which 4D radar proves a reliable and efficient modality for 3D semantic occupancy prediction. The dataset and code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [356] [RSIgen: Reciprocal Self-Improvement for Agentic Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18688)
*Yidi Liu,Haozhe Wang,Jie Xiao,Kai Zhu,Xueyang Fu,Zheng-Jun Zha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RSIgen，一个以任务为中心的多模态自我改进框架，通过动态责任路由、监督刷新与递归课程构建来协调统一多模态骨干中智能体（理解）与生成角色的学习分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体式视觉生成能提升统一多模态骨干的理解（智能体）与生成能力，但仅凭任务成功无法判断应由哪个角色学习；且生成器更新会使智能体的动作监督变得过时，因此需要新的学习分配与监督刷新机制。

Method: RSIgen包含三部分：动态责任路由（DRR）通过对证据、输入和支持动作的匹配干预来选择学习接受方并构建兼容训练目标；生成器学习后，固定分支输入重新评估各动作的相对效用以刷新智能体监督；被保留的角色据此构建下一轮课程。

Result: 在BAGEL、Qwen-Image和Wan-Image-7B上，相比三周期SearchGen适配，RSIgen在AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9上提升3.2–3.3分；Wan实验证明在相同角色级训练暴露下带来分配收益、在相同适配预算下带来刷新收益，并受益于更新的课程来源；200个真实用户请求盲评中，任务完成和视觉质量的平局校正偏好得分分别达70.0%和64.9%。

Conclusion: RSIgen通过将学习分配、监督刷新与递归课程构建联动，实现了统一多模态骨干中智能体与生成角色的互惠自我改进，在多项基准和真实用户盲评中均优于基线。

Abstract: Agentic visual generation produces experience that can improve the native understanding (agent) and generation roles of a unified multimodal backbone, but task success alone does not determine which role should learn. Generator updates can also make the agent's action supervision stale. We introduce RSIgen, a task-centric reciprocal self-improvement framework linking learning allocation, supervision refresh, and recursive curriculum construction. Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) uses matched interventions on evidence, inputs, and supported actions to select learning recipients and construct compatible training targets. After generator learning, RSIgen re-evaluates the relative utility of tested actions with branch inputs held fixed to refresh agent supervision; the retained roles then construct the next curriculum. Across BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, RSIgen improves AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 by 3.2--3.3 points over a three-cycle SearchGen adaptation with action costs. Wan controls support allocation gains at matched role-level training exposure, refresh gains at a matched adaptation budget, and benefits from updated curriculum sources while recipients continue learning. In blind evaluation on 200 real-user requests, pooled tie-adjusted preference scores against the same baseline reach 70.0% for task completion and 64.9% for visual quality.

</details>


### [357] [Just Respect the Semantics: Image-Token Compression via Pre-LLM Semantic Variable-Resolution Tokenization and In-LLM Relevance Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18690)
*Tianhao Fu,Austin Wang,Charles Chen,Roby Aldave-Garza,Victor Xie,Xiyue Jiao,Yucheng Chen,Martin Tin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Varest 提出一种图像 token 压缩方法，基于语义可换性，在语义区域粗粒度合并、在物体边界与文字处保留细粒度，并结合 [REL] 寄存器剪枝，仅用约 5.56% 图像 token 即可保留 86.10-92.33% 全量性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像 token 压缩需在减少计算的同时不损害语义。不同语义区域对分辨率需求不同：连贯语义区域可粗粒度概括，而物体边界与文字需要更细区分。

Method: 利用物体与文字定位器引导变分辨率合并，保持空间覆盖并在边界与文字处保留更细细节；随后使用学习到的 [REL] 寄存器在解码器早期处理后剪枝视觉 token；跨预算训练使每个骨干网络只需一个 checkpoint。

Result: 在 3 个骨干网络和 13 个基准上，Varest 在每个评估预算下的平均性能保留率均优于 15 个基线；仅用原始逐层平均图像 token 数的 5.56%，保留全量 token 性能的 86.10-92.33%。

Conclusion: Varest 通过语义引导的变分辨率合并与寄存器剪枝，有效实现高压缩率下的语义保持，并具备跨骨干、跨基准和跨预算的通用性与效率优势。

Abstract: Image-token compression must reduce computation without hurting the semantics. We introduce Varest, guided by semantic fungibility: tokens within a coherent semantic region can be summarized coarsely, while object boundaries and literal text require finer distinctions. Object and text localizers guide variable-resolution merging, preserving spatial coverage and finer detail at boundaries and text. Learned [REL] registers then prune visual tokens after early decoder processing. Training across budgets enables one checkpoint per backbone. Across three backbones and 13 benchmarks, Varest outperforms 15 baselines in mean performance retention at every evaluated budget, retaining 86.10-92.33% of full-token performance with only 5.56% of the original layer-averaged image-token count.

</details>


### [358] [Orientation Estimation of Cryo-EM Images for Molecules with Arbitrary Symmetry by Semidefinite Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18691)
*Yunpeng Shi,Amit Singer,Jinxin Wang,Ruiyi Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将非唯一博弈框架扩展到对称结构，提出统一的计算框架处理所有点群对称性，并用半定规划松弛与ADMM求解，应用于cryo-EM取向估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常针对特定对称群定制，缺乏处理各种点群对称性的统一框架，因此需要一种通用方法来解决带对称结构的优化问题，如cryo-EM中带点群对称分子的共线取向估计。

Method: 考虑在紧群G上最小化关于对称子群S的目标函数，采用半定规划松弛将问题转化为凸规划，并通过交替方向乘子法（ADMM）求解。

Result: 在模拟和实验数据集的cryo-EM取向估计问题上验证了算法，能够仅从少量实验图像类平均中生成高质量的从头模型。

Conclusion: 该方法为所有点群对称性提供了统一计算框架，并在cryo-EM取向估计中展现出有效性。

Abstract: This paper extends the non-unique games framework introduced in Bandeira et al. (2020) to address symmetric structures. Precisely, we consider the problem \[ \begin{aligned}
  \underset{g_1,\ldots,g_n\in \mathcal{G}}{\operatorname{min}}\,\, \frac{1}{|S|}\sum_{i,j=1}^n \sum_{s\in S} f_{ij}(g_i s g_j^{-1}), \end{aligned} \] where $\mathcal{G}$ is a compact group, $S\subset \mathcal{G}$ is a finite subgroup of symmetry elements, and $f_{ij}:\mathcal{G}\rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ is a loss function. A notable example is common lines based orientation estimation of cryo-EM images for molecules with point group symmetry $S$, where $\mathcal{G}$ is the rotation group $\operatorname{SO}(3)$. With a semidefinite programming relaxation, we turn the problem into a convex program that is solved with the alternating direction method of multipliers. Unlike existing approaches which are tailored to specific symmetry groups, ours provides a unified computational framework for addressing all point group symmetries. We demonstrate the applicability of the proposed algorithm on the cryo-EM orientation estimation problem on both simulated and experimental datasets. In particular, our algorithm is effective in generating high-quality ab initio models from only a few class averages computed from experimental images.

</details>


### [359] [GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18694)
*Rong Li,Shijie Li,Jiangyong Huang,Lingdong Kong,Jiaming Zhou,Dongyue Lu,Zeying Gong,Baoxiong Jia,Junwei Liang,Siyuan Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GeoReader 框架：先训练轻量几何读取器生成连续输入 token，使其以冻结 VLM 可读的形式表达几何，再冻结读取器微调 VLM 做空间问答；几何描述仅作训练目标，推理时不生成几何思维链。Qwen3-VL-4B 在 MindCube-Tiny 上达 94.3，Qwen3.5-9B 六项空间基准平均 72.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 难以处理 RGB 观测中隐含的度量与多视角关系，而几何基础模型能从 RGB 恢复此类结构。但现有做法要么把几何特征与视觉 token 融合、仅靠问答任务学习如何使用，要么让 VLM 隐层与几何特征对齐。问题在于：捕获几何并不等于会使用几何——实验发现，将某已发布特征对齐模型的已对齐隐层置零后，其准确率竟无变化，说明几何信息实际未被利用。

Method: 1) 训练轻量几何读取器（Geometric Readers），输出连续输入 token；2) 用冻结 VLM 解码出的几何描述作为监督信号，使读取器输出的几何表达符合目标模型已能读取的形式；3) 冻结读取器以保持该接口，在空间 QA 上微调 VLM，且几何注入以问题为条件；4) 几何描述仅作训练目标，推理时 VLM 直接从连续几何 token 作答，不生成几何思维链；5) 几何由 RGB 图像预测得到。

Result: 在 MindCube-Tiny 上，Qwen3-VL-4B 达到 94.3；搭配多源 QA 混合数据时，Qwen3.5-9B 在另外六个空间基准上平均达 72.5。

Conclusion: 有用的几何表示应是接收模型能够直接使用的表示，而不仅仅是能从中重建出几何的表示。作者强调"可用性"而非"可重建性"作为几何表示设计的核心标准。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that learns geometric representations for the VLM that reads them. First, we train lightweight Geometric Readers to produce continuous input tokens, supervising them with geometry descriptions decoded by a frozen VLM, so that the Readers express geometry in a form the target model can already read. We then freeze the Readers to preserve this interface while fine-tuning the VLM on spatial QA, with geometry injection conditioned on the question. Geometry descriptions serve only as training targets: at inference, the VLM answers directly from the continuous geometric tokens without generating a geometry chain of thought. With geometry predicted from RGB images, our approach reaches 94.3 on MindCube-Tiny with Qwen3-VL-4B and, with a multi-source QA mixture, an average of 72.5 across six additional spatial benchmarks with Qwen3.5-9B. These results suggest that a useful geometric representation is one the receiving model can use, not merely one from which geometry can be reconstructed.

</details>


### [360] [CryoTracer: A Synthetic-to-Real System for Filament Instance Tracing in Cryo-EM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18696)
*Radosław Kuczbański,Wojciech Kozłowski,Mateusz Grzesiuk,Konrad Karanowski,Lukas Frey,Andrzej Rzepiela,Maciej Zięba*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CryoTracer 提出合成到真实的端到端折线预测框架，将冷冻电镜丝状体识别建模为有序中心线折线预测，克服传统检测加连接的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冷冻电镜颗粒拾取通常被建模为边界框目标检测，适合球形颗粒，却不适合可横跨整张显微图的丝状体。现有方法需在后期将局部预测连接成轨迹，使检测与实例形成脱节，在间隙和交叉处产生歧义，且难以保持多态样本中同一条丝状体片段的身份一致性。然而，专家中心线标注稀缺且昂贵，直接学习实例级表示困难。

Method: 提出 CryoTracer 的合成到真实框架，包含三部分：程序化显微图生成、基于 transformer 的折线预测、以及针对样本的微调。先用程序化预训练让模型接触多样化的丝状体几何、交叉和成像条件，再用少量完整标注的实验显微图进行适配。模型将丝状体表示为有序中心线折线，并使用方向不变离散 Fréchet 目标优化其几何，使不同追踪方向下的学习保持一致。

Result: 在已有数据集和新构建的专家标注数据集上评估，CryoTracer 在实例级丝状体恢复方面优于现有颗粒检测方法。

Conclusion: 结果表明，端到端折线预测可作为检测加连接流程的实用替代方案，在有限显微图标注预算下恢复完整丝状体实例。代码和数据已公开。

Abstract: Particle picking in cryo-electron microscopy is commonly formulated as an object-detection problem in which individual particles are represented by bounding boxes, a natural representation for globular particles but a poor match for filaments that can extend across an entire micrograph. Existing methods reconstruct filament trajectories by linking local predictions in a separate post-processing stage, decoupling detection from instance formation and creating potential ambiguities at gaps and crossings. Directly preserving filament identity is particularly useful for polymorphic specimens, where segments originating from the same filament should remain associated. However, learning such instance-level representations is challenging because expert centerline annotations are scarce and costly to obtain. We introduce CryoTracer, a synthetic-to-real framework that addresses this limitation through procedural micrograph generation, transformer-based polyline prediction, and specimen-specific fine-tuning. Procedural pretraining exposes the model to diverse filament geometries, intersections, and imaging conditions before adaptation using a limited number of fully annotated experimental micrographs. CryoTracer represents filaments as ordered centerline polylines and optimizes their geometry using an orientation-invariant discrete Fréchet objective, enabling consistent learning regardless of tracing direction. Evaluation on established and newly expert-annotated datasets shows that CryoTracer improves instance-level filament recovery over existing particle-detection approaches. These results establish end-to-end polyline prediction as a practical alternative to detection-and-linking pipelines for recovering complete filament instances with limited micrograph annotation budgets. Code and data are available at https://github.com/cryotracer/cryotracer

</details>


### [361] [AIRRI: Towards a Human-Readable, Machine-Resistant Reading Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18724)
*Emory Salaun,Syed Ayon,Kaleel Mahmood,Shaun Wallace*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AIRRI框架，通过图像变换和对抗攻击技术生成"反AI"教育内容，显著降低图像转文本系统的识别准确率，从而增加AI辅助完成作业的难度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像转文本系统与大语言模型的快速发展使作业材料易于被转录和解答，对教育评估构成新挑战。为应对这一问题，需要一种能生成机器难以识别、但人类仍可阅读的教育内容的方法。

Method: AIRRI采用两类机器抗性技术：一是图像变换，包括字符间距、词间距、行间距、字符透明度变化、条纹叠加和图像噪声；二是基于决策的对抗攻击，包括RayS、SurFree和ADBA。评估对象为三种图像转文本系统：Tesseract、EasyOCR和基于Transformer的GOT-OCR2模型，并附带高等教育作业数据集及人类可读性的初步评估。

Result: AIRRI大幅降低了自动化文本提取性能。字符错误率：EasyOCR从6.9%升至55.9%，Tesseract从2.3%升至100.0%，GOT-OCR2从30.7%升至48.1%。词错误率：EasyOCR从24.9%升至96.7%，Tesseract从10.7%升至100.0%。在所有决策型攻击中，ADBA的降级效果最强，RayS和SurFree效果较温和。EasyOCR和Tesseract比基于Transformer的GOT-OCR2更易受图像扰动和对抗扰动影响。

Conclusion: AIRRI能显著降低图像转文本再到大语言模型工作流的可靠性，提高AI辅助完成作业所需的成本，为保护教育评估的有效性提供了可行路径。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of image-to-text extraction systems and large language models (LLMs) poses new challenges for educational assessment by making assignment materials easy to transcribe and solve with minimal human effort. To address this problem, we present AIRRI (Artificial Intelligence Resilient Reading Interface), a framework for generating machine-resistant educational content, a dataset of higher-education assignments for evaluation, and an initial evaluation of the human readability of AIRRI machine-resistant text designs. AIRRI employs two categories of machine-resistance techniques. First, AIRRI applies image transformations including character spacing, word spacing, line spacing, character opacity variation, stripe overlays, and image noise. Second, AIRRI applies decision-based adversarial attacks: RayS, SurFree, and ADBA. We evaluate AIRRI against three image-to-text systems: Tesseract, EasyOCR, and the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. Our results show that AIRRI substantially degrades automated text extraction performance. AIRRI increased character error rates for EasyOCR (6.9% to 55.9%), Tesseract (2.3% to 100.0%), and GOT-OCR2 (30.7% to 48.1%). Word error rates increased for EasyOCR (24.9% to 96.7%) and Tesseract (10.7% to 100.0%). Among the evaluated decision-based attacks, ADBA consistently produced the largest degradation in image-to-text performance, while RayS and SurFree produced more moderate reductions. EasyOCR and Tesseract were generally more susceptible to both image-based and adversarial perturbations than the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. Our findings suggest that AIRRI can significantly reduce the reliability of image-to-text-to-LLM workflows, increasing the effort required for AI-assisted assignment completion.

</details>


### [362] [Segment Where You Look: Attention as the Interface Between Language Models and Segmenters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18729)
*Eslam Abdelrahman,Hamza Omar Alkaf,Yuheng Li,Siddharth Srinivasan Iyer,Nanxuan Zhao,Eli Shechtman,Krishna Kumar Singh,Mohamed Elhoseiny*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现分割VLM中[SEG] token对图像token的注意力比其隐藏状态包含更好的空间信息，据此提出AttnSeg，用注意力作为解码器提示，在多个基准上显著提升分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言引导分割的VLM通常将指代物位置压缩为单个[SEG] token的d维隐藏状态向量，该向量没有空间索引，且解码器看不到语言表达，只能自行恢复指代物范围，导致信息损失和定位能力受限。

Method: 首先通过探测冻结的分割VLM证明[SEG] token对图像token的注意力本身具有空间结构优势；然后提出AttnSeg，用该注意力替代[SEG]嵌入作为解码器提示，通过可学习的有符号注意力头组合形成密集空间提示，并用注意力引导目标直接监督；采用两阶段训练：先训练VLM在不使用解码器的情况下定位，再训练解码器进行细化。

Result: 注意力在相同探针下比[SEG]隐藏状态高出18–22 gIoU，且不依赖图像信息增益，集中于后层。应用于Sa2VA时，4B模型ReasonSeg提升6.4 gIoU、GS-Eval提升10.2（相比同数据微调的同模型为4.2和9.6），14B模型提升8.8和11.3；在物体部件、多物体和单物体任务上提升13–18 gIoU，而在stuff区域提升可忽略。

Conclusion: 将[SEG] token的注意力作为解码器提示比传统隐藏状态更有效，AttnSeg以标准微调预算显著提升语言引导分割性能，尤其在需要精确定位指代物的场景中，代码与模型已公开。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) that segment from language must pass the location of the referent to a pixel decoder. The dominant interface compresses it into the hidden state of a single [SEG] token, a d-dimensional vector with no spatial index, and leaves the decoder, which never sees the expression, to recover the referent's extent. We show that the VLM already computes a better signal: the [SEG] token's attention over the image tokens, which is defined on the patch grid by construction. Probing a frozen segmentation VLM, we find that this attention yields 18 to 22 more gIoU than the [SEG] hidden state when read by the same probe, that it gains nothing from the image where the hidden state does, and that it is concentrated in the late layers. Building on these findings, we introduce AttnSeg, which replaces the [SEG] embedding with this attention as the decoder's prompt. A learned, signed combination of the attention heads forms a dense spatial prompt, and an attention-guidance objective supervises it directly. A two-stage recipe first trains the VLM to localize without the decoder, then trains the decoder to refine, within the budget of standard fine-tuning. Applied to Sa2VA, AttnSeg improves ReasonSeg by 6.4 gIoU and GS-Eval by 10.2 at 4B (4.2 and 9.6 over the same model fine-tuned on the same data), and by 8.8 and 11.3 at 14B. The gains reach 13 to 18 gIoU on object parts, multiple objects, and single objects, where the referent must be singled out, and are negligible on stuff regions, which the decoder already recovers unaided. Code and models are available at https://eslambakr.github.io/attseg_project_page/

</details>


### [363] [Neural Block-wise Auto-exposure for Single-Shot High Dynamic Range Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18733)
*Zhengguo Li,Chaobing Zheng,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经分块自动曝光算法，通过将临时图像及其曝光时间映射到各16×16非重叠块的曝光时间，解决了分块变曝光HDR成像中的亮度顺序反转、块效应及高光/阴影细节丢失问题，并验证了使用raw图像作为临时图像相比sRGB图像能更准确地学习块曝光时间、捕获更多HDR细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分块变曝光能以单次拍摄捕获真实世界HDR场景的外观，但存在亮度顺序反转（BOR）伪影、块效应以及高光/阴影区域细节丢失等问题。现有算法多采用sRGB图像，而其辐射测量能力有限，导致高光和阴影区域的块曝光时间难以被准确学习。

Method: 提出神经分块自动曝光算法，将一张临时图像及其曝光时间映射为所有非重叠16×16块的曝光时间。临时图像可为sRGB图像或raw图像，并对比探索使用raw图像作为临时图像的可行性。

Result: 由于raw图像具有更好的辐射测量能力，各块曝光时间被学习得更准确，所得HDR成像系统能够捕获真实世界HDR场景中高光/阴影区域更多的细节。实验结果验证了所提神经分块自动曝光算法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该神经分块自动曝光算法可有效缓解BOR伪影、块效应和细节丢失问题，且采用raw图像作为临时图像优于sRGB图像，为单次拍摄HDR成像提供了更优方案。

Abstract: Block-wise varying exposures are effective for cap- turing appearance of a real-world high dynamic range (HDR) scene via a single-shot. However, brightness order reversal (BOR) artifacts, blocking artifacts and loss of details in highlight/shadow regions are possible issues for block-wise varying exposures. In this paper, a novel neural block-wise auto-exposure algorithm is proposed to address the issues. The proposed algorithm maps a temporary image and its exposure time to the exposure times of all non-overlapping 16 X 16 blocks. The temporary image can be either an sRGB or a raw image. Although the sRGB image is widely adopted in existing auto-exposure algorithms, exposure times of blocks in the highlight and shadow regions might not be accurately learned due to the limited radiance measurement capability of the sRGB image. This paper thus also explores the feasibility of temporary image as a raw image. Due to the better radiance measurement capability of the raw image, the exposure times of blocks are learned more accurately, and more details in the highlight/shadow regions of the real-world HDR scene are captured by the resultant HDR imaging system. Experiment results validate the proposed neural block-wise auto-exposure algorithm.

</details>


### [364] [Concealed Handgun Detection using WiFi Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18736)
*Erik Persson,David Gustafsson,Tomas Wilkinson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出利用WiFi信道状态信息(CSI)检测隐蔽手枪，构建了WiFire数据集并设计WiFireNet深度学习模型，验证了WiFi作为互补模态进行隐蔽武器检测的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统摄像头监控系统无法检测被遮挡或隐藏的威胁，金属探测器要求人员逐一通过狭窄通道，导致拥堵，难以应用于大规模人群场景。WiFi信号具有穿透遮挡、不受严格空间布局限制的潜力，可作为补充检测手段。

Method: 提出从WiFi信号中估计信道状态信息(CSI)来检测隐蔽手枪；采集了对齐的WiFi信号与RGB图像数据集WiFire；设计了基于视觉监督信号的深度学习模型WiFireNet用于检测WiFi信号中的隐蔽手枪。

Result: 实验结果表明，在WiFi信号中检测隐蔽手枪是可行的，具有作为监控摄像头和金属探测器互补模态的潜力。

Conclusion: WiFi可作为一种有效的互补模态用于隐蔽手枪检测，作者公开了数据集、模型和代码以促进后续研究。

Abstract: While conventional camera-based surveillance systems and metal detectors can provide a sufficient level of security when used appropriately, they have fundamental limitations that reduce their applicability. Camera-based systems are unable to detect occluded or concealed threats and metal detectors require each person to enter through a narrow opening one at a time, leading to congestion issues and limited use in large crowds. A WiFi-based security system has the potential to be a complementary modality that is able to handle occlusions or concealment and is not hindered by strict spatial configurations. In this paper, we propose use Channel State Information estimated from WiFi-signals to detect concealed handguns. To this end we collect a dataset of aligned WiFi signals and RGB images that we call the WiFire dataset. We also propose a deep learning model called WiFireNet tailored to detect concealed handguns in WiFi signals using vision-based supervision signals. Our results show that concealed handgun detection is possible in WiFi and has promise as a complementary modality to surveillance cameras and metal detectors. We release the dataset, model and code to facilitate the further research into WiFi-based handgun detection.

</details>


### [365] [Context-aware Bayesian Fusion for Multimodal Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18741)
*Arunachalam Venkatachalam,Mhafuzul Islam,Marwan Yusuf,David Van Hamme,Ben Stoffelen,James Foresi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种上下文感知的多模态后期融合方法，通过轻量门控网络与概率校准框架，在无需重新训练检测器的情况下动态调整检测输出，提升雾天行人检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶安全依赖可靠的行人与道路使用者检测，但在恶劣天气与低光照条件下，预训练目标检测器与车载传感器性能下降，可靠性受限；而为每种工况重新训练模型又面临数据、算力与时间的高成本约束。

Method: 提出上下文感知的多模态后期融合方法，在概率校准框架内嵌入轻量门控网络；该网络提取环境上下文，并据此动态调制预训练目标检测器的检测输出，无需重新训练检测器。基于修改的KITTI数据集，对相机图像与激光雷达点云进行不同雾浓度增强后进行评估。

Result: 相较非自适应后期融合基线，方法取得约14%的相对提升，在不同雾浓度下保持约56%的一致平均精度（AP）。

Conclusion: 所提方法能在不重新训练检测器的前提下，借助上下文感知的门控调制有效缓解恶劣天气带来的性能退化，并在不同雾浓度下保持稳定检测精度。

Abstract: Reliable detection of pedestrians and road users is essential for the safe operation of autonomous vehicles. However, this task becomes increasingly challenging under adverse environmental conditions, such as poor weather and low lighting, where the performance of state-of-the-art pre-trained object detectors and on-board sensors tends to degrade, which limits their effectiveness and reliability. Moreover, retraining models for each operating context imposes significant constraints due to high data requirements, computational resources, and time. Considering this, we propose a novel context-aware multimodal late fusion approach that integrates a lightweight gating network within our probabilistic calibration framework. The gating network extracts environmental context and dynamically modulates the detection outputs of pre-trained object detectors based on the inferred context, without retraining of the detectors. Our methodology is evaluated on a modified KITTI dataset, in which the camera images and lidar pointclouds are augmented for varying fog levels. Experimental results show that our approach yields an approximately 14% relative improvement over non-adaptive late fusion baselines, achieving a consistent average precision of 56% across different fog levels.

</details>


### [366] [LayerCanvas: Infographic Generation in AI Learning Assistants via Hybrid Layer-Set Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18763)
*Keshav Gupta,Jeremy Owen,Christopher Lloyd,Shaunak Mishra,Manav Sharma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LayerCanvas 提出一种混合方法，保留 SVG 作为语义、结构与排版程序，同时用扩散模型美化非文本内容；通过将 SVG 元素划分为 z 序、互不重叠的集合，并用并行 RGB 生成流处理，实现图层独立可编辑、确定性重组以及来自矢量元数据的文本渲染，在文本保真度和整体美学质量上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线学习平台日益部署 AI 助手提供个性化辅导，并利用信息图传达复杂信息。然而自动生成有效信息图仍然困难，需要兼顾视觉丰富性、精确排版、结构化布局和持续可编辑性。现有表示方法只能部分满足：SVG 保留几何、层级和文本但美学灵活性有限；栅格扩散模型虽外观更丰富，却把内容和布局压平为单张图像。将扩散模型条件化于栅格化 SVG 也无法解决冲突，因为栅格只保留大致位置，却丢失元素归属、遮挡关系和修改重组所需的结构。

Method: LayerCanvas 保留 SVG 作为语义、结构和排版程序，使用扩散模型对非文本内容进行美学化。它不生成单张扁平栅格，而是将 SVG 元素划分为按 z 排序、彼此互不重叠的元素集合，并通过相互通信的并行 RGB 生成流进行处理。生成的图层可独立编辑并确定性重组，文本则从保留的矢量元数据渲染。

Result: LayerCanvas 在文本保真度上显著优于最先进的栅格图像生成器，同时取得最高的整体美学质量。作者还展示了非破坏性内容编辑、本地化、资产复用和动画等能力。

Conclusion: LayerCanvas 将丰富视觉合成与精确排版及局部编辑结合起来，为自动信息图生成提供了一种兼顾结构、可编辑性与视觉质量的混合方案。

Abstract: Online learning platforms are increasingly deploying AI assistants to provide personalized, on-demand tutoring. These can leverage infographics to communicate complex information and improve the learning experience. However, automating effective infographic generation remains a challenging task, requiring a combination of visual richness with precise typography, structured layouts, and continued editability. Existing representation methods satisfy these goals only in part: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) representations preserve geometry, hierarchy, and text but provide limited aesthetic flexibility, while raster diffusion models produce richer appearances by flattening content and layout into a single image. Conditioning a diffusion model on a rasterized SVG does not resolve this conflict because the raster preserves approximate placement but discards element ownership, occlusion relationships, and the structure needed to modify and recompose the result. We introduce LayerCanvas, a hybrid approach that retains SVG as the semantic, structural, and typographic program while using diffusion to aestheticize non-text content. Rather than generating one flattened raster, LayerCanvas partitions SVG elements into z-ordered sets of mutually non-overlapping elements and processes them through communicating parallel RGB generation streams. The resulting layers are independently editable and deterministically recomposed, while text is rendered from preserved vector metadata. Our approach combines rich visual synthesis with accurate typography and localized editing. LayerCanvas substantially improves text fidelity over state-of-the-art raster image generators while achieving the highest overall aesthetic quality. We further demonstrate non-destructive content editing, localization, asset reuse, and animation.

</details>


### [367] [MIST: Multi-Scale Spatial Context for Gene Expression Prediction from Histology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18769)
*Koushik Howlader,Tirtho Roy,Md Tauhidul Islam,Wei Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MIST是一种多上下文空间Transformer，通过在每个注意力层中加入局部邻域路径和全切片路径，从H&E图像预测空间基因表达，在多个器官队列中显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从标准H&E图像预测空间基因表达可将分子分析扩展到缺乏空间转录组测量的组织。然而，标准Transformer仅在spot上应用自注意力，忽略了spot在组织中的空间位置，而spot的分子状态依赖于多空间尺度的组织上下文。

Method: 提出MIST（多上下文空间Transformer），在自注意力主干上于每一层引入两条上下文路径：一是坐标不变的局部路径，在空间k近邻spot上做注意力；二是切片路径，将全切片摘要广播到每个spot。模型单次前向即可预测所有spot。由于坐标仅通过成对距离引入，当图像特征固定时局部路径对平移、旋转和反射保持不变。

Result: 在HEST-1k的六个器官队列内评估中，MIST相较最强基线在10、50、100基因面板上平均Pearson相关分别提升9.7%、11.6%、11.4%，且平均MSE与MAE最低；留一器官迁移提升6.0%；取得最佳表达衍生域恢复（各聚类分辨率下平均ARI与NMI最高，在84%留出切片上NMI高于最接近基线），并复现了特定癌症标志基因的空间表达模式。

Conclusion: 在普通Transformer主干上加入局部与切片上下文，是从组织学图像预测空间基因表达的有效方法。

Abstract: Predicting spatial gene expression from standard H&E images could extend molecular analysis to tissues without spatial transcriptomic measurements. A standard Transformer applies self-attention over spots but ignores where each spot sits in the tissue, whereas a spot's molecular state depends on tissue context at multiple spatial scales. Building on this insight, we introduce MIST, a Multi-context Spatial Transformer that augments the self-attention backbone with two context pathways applied in every layer: a coordinate-invariant local pathway that attends over spatial k-nearest-neighbor spots, and a slide pathway that broadcasts a whole-slide summary to every spot; the model predicts all spots in a single forward pass. Because coordinates enter only through pairwise distances, the local pathway is invariant to translations, rotations, and reflections when image features are fixed. In intra-cohort evaluation across six human organ cohorts from HEST-1k, MIST improves mean Pearson correlation over the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.7%, 11.6%, and 11.4% for 10-, 50-, and 100-gene panels, respectively, with the lowest average MSE and MAE. MIST further improves leave-one-organ-out transfer by 6.0% over the next strongest baseline, attains the best expression-derived domain recovery (highest mean ARI and NMI at every clustering resolution, and higher NMI than the closest baseline on 84% of held-out slides), and reproduces spatial expression patterns of selected cancer-marker genes. Together, these results show that adding local and slide context to a vanilla Transformer backbone is an effective approach to spatial gene expression prediction from histology.

</details>


### [368] [The Federated Tumor Segmentation and Classification (FeTS++) Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18771)
*Wenyi Tang,Carla Pitarch-Abaigar,Siddhesh Thakur,Verena Chung,Konstantinos Koukoutegos,Alexandros Karargyris,Holger R. Roth,Spyridon Bakas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FeTS++ 2027 是一个聚焦联邦学习的医学影像挑战赛，基于跨机构多参数 MRI 数据，新增分类任务并迁移至 NVFlare 平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机构数据协作是医学影像方法开发与评测的标准，但数据集中化面临隐私与合规问题。联邦学习可在数据不出本地的前提下进行跨机构训练，亟需真实场景下对多种方法论进行验证与排名。

Method: 该挑战延续 FeTS 系列，采用来自北美、欧洲、亚洲和非洲机构的临床多参数 MRI 数据，覆盖胶质瘤与脑膜瘤；任务一考察各机构分割模型的知识聚合策略，任务二在同一联邦协议下进行胶质瘤与脑膜瘤的分类判别。

Result: 挑战赛依据模型效用与效率感知评分对提交方法进行排名；相较以往版本，队列规模更大、多样性更强，并首次纳入官方分类任务。

Conclusion: FeTS++ 2027 将联邦学习在医学影像中的评测推进到更大规模、更多样化和更贴近真实部署的场景，为分割与分类任务提供统一的联邦方法基准。

Abstract: International challenges have become the standard for developing and benchmarking biomedical image analysis methods using centralized multi-institutional data. Federated learning (FL) describes a paradigm-shift on multi-institutional collaborations, where models are trained across institutions while their data are always retained locally. The Federated Tumor Segmentation (FeTS) challenge, first held in 2021, was the first challenge dedicated to FL in medical imaging and editions in 2022 and 2024 pushed the frontiers of real-world method validation. FeTS++ 2027 returns after a two-year gap with a substantially larger and more diverse cohort, and with the two "pluses" that name the challenge: an official classification task alongside segmentation, and a move of the infrastructure to NVIDIA FLARE (NVFlare). Built on the clinically acquired, multi-institutional multi-parametric MRI data of the BraTS 2025 Lighthouse challenge, FeTS++ spans gliomas and meningiomas across patient cohorts from institutions in North America, Europe, Asia, and Africa, and focuses on ranking submitted methodological approaches according to their model utility and an efficiency-aware score. Task 1 asks participants to find the best strategy for aggregating knowledge from per-institution segmentation models, while Task 2 asks them to distinguish glioma from meningioma under the same federated protocol, in which the entity label is heavily confounded with the site of origin.

</details>


### [369] [GAD: Geometry Attention Distillation for Consistent Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18779)
*Junfeng Ni,Ziyu Zhu,Fan Jiang,Yu Liu,Chiyu Wang,Jiawei Zhang,Zhaoxu Sun,Mu Xu,Siyuan Huang,Yixin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出几何注意力蒸馏（GAD），将冻结几何模型的注意力对应关系迁移到视频注意力中，从而提升视频扩散模型的长程场景一致性与动态时序一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型虽能生成视觉上吸引人的短视频，但难以在时间维度上保持场景几何与物体结构。作者发现当前视频注意力无法识别可靠的跨帧对应关系，即使场景结构已显现，其响应仍分散在多个区域，而可靠的跨帧关联对生成过程中场景结构形成时的信息交换至关重要。

Method: 提出几何注意力蒸馏（GAD），将冻结几何模型的注意力对应关系迁移到视频注意力。这些对应关系从干净视频中提取，连接跨帧的同一静态表面或运动物体。考虑到结构形成在高噪声时始于较深层、低噪声时始于较浅层，作者根据噪声时间步选择学生层进行注意力蒸馏。

Result: 训练后视频注意力更一致地聚焦于对应位置。在三个视频骨干网络上均提升了长程场景一致性与动态时序一致性，几何性能随生成长度提升。在Wan2.2 5B上，GAD在两个长程基准上使跨帧匹配准确率较Wan基线至少提升30%，且无需额外推理模块。

Conclusion: GAD在不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升视频生成的几何与时序一致性，为高效且一致的视频世界模拟提供了有前景的途径。

Abstract: Video diffusion models generate visually compelling short-term sequences but often struggle to preserve scene geometry and object structure over time. In this paper, we first demonstrate that current video attention cannot identify reliable correspondences across frames, with responses dispersed across multiple regions even after recognizable scene structure has emerged. We argue that reliable cross-frame associations are essential for information exchange as scene structure forms in video generation. Thus, we introduce Geometry Attention Distillation (GAD), which transfers correspondences from a frozen geometry model's attention to video attention. Extracted from clean videos, these correspondences link the same static surface or moving object across frames. Since structure formation begins in deeper layers at higher noise and shallower layers at lower noise, we apply attention distillation at a student layer selected according to the noise timestep. After training, video attention focuses more consistently on corresponding locations. Experiments across all three video backbones demonstrate improved long-range scene consistency and dynamic temporal consistency, with geometric gains across generation lengths. On Wan2.2 5B, GAD improves cross-frame matching accuracy by at least 30% over the Wan baseline on both long-range benchmarks. Notably, GAD achieves these gains without additional inference modules, offering a promising approach to efficient and consistent video-based world simulation. Project page: https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/.

</details>


### [370] [Trust Before Autonomy: Rethinking Agentic Remote Sensing for Crisis Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18789)
*Georgios Angelidis,Aggelos Psiris,Spyridon Evangelatos,Thomas Lagkas,Panagiotis Sarigiannidis,Iraklis Varlamis,Georgios Th. Papadopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文主张EO代理的自主性应"挣得"而非默认赋予，依据12项代理式遥感基准研究的证据元分析指出当前评测无法支撑危机响应场景中的高自主性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代理式遥感评测以"能答多少题"为标准，而危机响应的真正需求是答案是否可信、决策可安全委托多少。当前基准普遍缺乏重复运行、可答性界定与校准度量，导致评测结果与可靠性脱节。

Method: 对来自同行评审会议的12项代理式RS/EO/GIS基准研究进行证据性元分析，考察重复运行、不可答任务设置与校准度量等维度，并重新解读其原始结果表。

Result: 仅1项研究重复运行，3项包含不可答任务，0项测量校准；相同查询下任务成功率比工具调用正确率高出至多54个百分点；与专家轨迹的差距随轨迹长度整体扩大（7至56个百分点）；能力与拒答无显著相关（Spearman r为-0.25至0.50，均不显著）。

Conclusion: 作者提出三项EO专属信任性质、危机EO任务的自主性阶梯，以及在上线前回放历史应急响应的就绪协议；就现有证据而言，仅足以支持辅助型角色。

Abstract: Agentic remote sensing is evaluated on how many questions it can answer, whereas crisis response depends on whether its answers can be relied on and how much of the decision can safely be handed to the agent. This paper argues that \emph{autonomy should be earned, not assumed}: An Earth-Observation (EO) agent should be granted autonomy in proportion to demonstrated reliability, epistemic honesty and verifiability. The position is supported by an evidential meta-analysis of twelve agentic RS/EO/GIS benchmark studies from peer-reviewed venues. Only one repeats runs, three contain unanswerable tasks and none measures calibration. Their own tables show that completed workflows are often not correct (task success exceeds tool-call correctness by up to 54pp on identical queries), that the gap to an expert trajectory widens overall with trajectory length (from 7 to 56pp), and that capability does not predict abstention (Spearman r from -0.25 to 0.50, all n.s.). The paper then contributes three EO-specific trust properties, an autonomy ladder for crisis EO tasks, and a readiness protocol that replays archived emergency activations before any live use. In this context, current evidence justifies assistive roles only.

</details>


### [371] [Registration is a Representation Problem: Solving Whole-Body PET/CT Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18804)
*Neel Dey,Adrian V. Dalca*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出利用互补解剖表征（anatomix基础模型逐体素语义特征+分割标签）驱动GPU加速迭代配准求解器FireANTs的混合多阶段框架，用于全身PET/CT纵向配准，并引入病灶体积保持策略，在Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg挑战赛中无需任务特定训练即获第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配准问题中原始图像强度作为相似性度量效果不佳；虽然辅助分割标签能提供语义身份并改进匹配，但其只能赋予细粒度解剖粗粒度身份，且往往仅覆盖部分结构（尤其在全身场景下），因此需要互补的解剖表征来建立更准确的对应关系。

Method: 使用3D基础模型anatomix导出跨体数据一致的细粒度逐体素语义表征，并结合现成分割模型获得粗粒度解剖身份；二者共同驱动GPU加速迭代配准求解器FireANTs构成混合多阶段框架：第一阶段由密集多通道特征估计对齐，第二阶段利用anatomix与分割损失进一步精化形变；此外设计病灶特异的分量式体积保持机制，避免配准引入非生物学肿瘤体积变化。全流程无需任务特定训练。

Result: 在Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg挑战赛排行榜上取得第一名。

Conclusion: 互补的解剖表征（基础模型语义特征与分割身份）结合多阶段混合配准与体积保持约束，可在无任务特定训练条件下有效解决全身纵向PET/CT配准问题，代码与交互式可视化已公开。

Abstract: Raw image intensities are a poor surrogate for similarity across images in correspondence problems. Further, while auxiliary segmentation labels can provide semantic identification and improve matching, they can assign only coarse identities to fine-grained anatomy and often cover only a subset of structures, particularly in whole-body settings. We present an approach that instead establishes correspondence using complementary representations of anatomy and demonstrate its utility for longitudinal whole-body PET/CT registration in the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg Challenge. Our 3D foundation model, anatomix, is used to derive fine-grained, per-voxel semantic representations that are consistent across volumes, and we further employ off-the-shelf segmentation models to obtain coarse anatomical identities. Together, these representations drive a GPU-accelerated iterative registration solver (FireANTs) in a hybrid multistage framework: the first stage estimates alignment from dense multi-channel features, after which a second refines the deformation using both anatomix- and segmentation-based losses. Lastly, because registration should not introduce non-biological tumor volume changes across time, we develop lesion-specific component-wise volume preservation schemes. Without any task-specific training, our system won first place in the PSMAReg Challenge leaderboard. Code and interactive visualizations are available at http://www.neeldey.com/reps-for-reg.

</details>


### [372] [DuplexBridge: Coordinating Understanding and Generation for Unified Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18819)
*Yidi Liu,Jie Xiao,Chaojie Mao,Jingfeng Zhang,Xueyang Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 DuplexBridge，利用统一模型自身的理解能力来增强其生成能力，无需外部理解模块，并通过 CE-Bench 基准验证其在复杂图像编辑任务中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂图像编辑需要忠实的任务理解与准确执行，但编辑失败时难以判断究竟是理解还是生成环节出了问题，因此需要一种能让理解与生成各司其职、又互相促进的联合框架。

Method: 采用统一模型，通过一个基于源图像的桥接（source-grounded bridge）明确目标、最终状态变化与保持约束；理解部分在不观察生成图像的情况下监督其对原始请求的忠实度，生成部分监督其实际接收条件的执行；并引入双向信任检查（reciprocal trust checks），有选择地将全局任务反馈分配给各角色，同时保留各自独立有效的局部监督。

Result: 在三种模型配置下，完整系统相比直接编辑器的完全合规率提升 21.75–25.75 个百分点，并在 KRIS-Bench、RISEBench、ImgEdit 和 GEdit-Bench 上也有提升；从相同的 Wan-Image 监督初始化出发，带门控的联合训练达到 77.08% 完全合规率，而无门控为 70.92%，若生成局部监督改为检查原始任务（保留两个门控）则为 75.00%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，为理解与生成设定各自独立的局部职责、并采用有选择的共享反馈，对于联合理解-生成适配是有效的。

Abstract: Complex image editing requires faithful task interpretation and accurate execution, but a failed edit does not reveal which responsibility failed. We present DuplexBridge, which uses a unified model's own understanding capability to enhance prompts for its own generation capability, without an external understanding module. A source-grounded bridge specifies targets, final-state changes, and preservation constraints. Understanding is supervised on fidelity to the original request without observing the generated image; generation is supervised on execution of the condition it actually receives. Reciprocal trust checks selectively admit global task feedback to each role while retaining independently valid local supervision. We introduce CE-Bench, a 1,200-task benchmark measuring joint satisfaction of task-derived change and preservation requirements. Across three model configurations, the full system improves complete compliance over direct editors by 21.75-25.75 percentage points, with gains also observed on KRIS-Bench, RISEBench, ImgEdit, and GEdit-Bench. Abstract: Repetition counting requires identifying and enumerating action cycles over time. While state-of-the-art video language models describe actions fluently, they fail to reliably count how many times an action repeats. To investigate this limitation, we introduce RepProbe, a benchmark of 42K real and synthetic video clips containing exactly k in [1, 20] complete repetitions, with controls for clip position, temporal coverage, and duration. These controls allow us to study the counting failure directly and locate where in the model it arises. Counting accuracy collapses at high counts across the video language models we evaluate, and controlled experiments show this collapse is not explained by frame sampling alone. We compare model outputs with linear probes trained on the final-layer representations used to generate those outputs. We find a consistent representation-to-output dissociation: substantial count information remains linearly decodable even when models fail to report the correct count. Further analysis shows this failure arises primarily at the output stage, where answers concentrate on a small set of preferred numbers rather than the available count information. The dissociation holds on both real and synthetic videos and is not explained by clip duration, position, or scene content. Abstract: Pixel-space diffusion models provide an appealing alternative to latent-space diffusion models by directly modeling raw images without relying on a learned tokenizer. Specifically, PixelMoE combines standard Token-Choice (TC) routing with fine-grained routed experts for input-adaptive sparse computation, a shared expert for capturing common representations, and a bias-based load-balancing strategy. To complement sparse capacity scaling, PixelMoE further introduces Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching, which varies spatial resolution along the denoising trajectory from global structure formation to fine-grained detail refinement. At comparable active parameter counts, PixelMoE consistently outperforms its dense counterparts across model scales, demonstrating effective sparse capacity scaling in pixel space. Abstract: Multimodal large language models have advanced rapidly, but most remain optimized for single-image inputs. Multi-image reasoning is costly because each image adds many visual tokens, increasing encoding and attention demands. Existing techniques that address the above issue, including visual token pruning, token merging, visual token compression, learned resampling, hierarchical compression, retrieval-augmented visual reasoning, and memory-based architectures, have largely been designed for single-image scenarios, where redundancy is primarily spatial and local. Multi-image reasoning introduces additional challenges: redundancy may occur across images, task-relevant evidence may be sparse or distributed, and aggressive per-image compression can remove details needed for comparison, counting, temporal reasoning, retrieval, or evidence grounding. Moreover, existing token-reduction methods are often either (i) training-free but inference-inefficient, typically relying on accessing attention matrices to get token-importance that may be impractical to access with memory-efficient attention implementations such as FlashAttention, or (ii) training-dependent, requiring the base MLLM to be retrained or adapted to a new compressed-token paradigm. In this work, we study scalable multi-image reasoning and understanding without retraining the base model and without accessing attention matrices at inference time. To this end, we propose mmVB, a lightweight plug-and-play module that assigns query-conditioned per-image token budgets via cross-image context, adding only 1.6M trainable parameters while reducing visual input tokens by 9x. This reduction yields 5x faster time-to-first-token and 7x fewer prefill FLOPs, while maintaining 94.4% of full-resolution accuracy across eight multi-image reasoning benchmarks.

</details>

Abstract: Generating editable graphic designs requires arranging visual and textual elements into a coherent composition while preserving their content and editability. Although recent MLLM-based approaches employ iterative generation and visual refinement to reflect the real-world design workflows, their high-level plans are predetermined prior to execution, limiting their adaptability as the design evolves. Given an initial set of unordered elements, the Structure-Aware Retriever initially infers a coarse layout structure to retrieve structurally similar reference designs. Abstract: Sparse-to-dense motion completion recovers dense mesh motion from sparse vertex displacements. Residual priors trained on one geometry family frequently fail to beat parameter-free harmonic extension off-family. Moreover, cross-family training meets a scaling barrier: residual amplitude varies by more than an order of magnitude across geometry families and collapses as observations become denser. Since this scale depends on unknown target motion, it cannot be measured directly at test time. We decouple residual structure from physical scale by learning a dimensionless prior, estimating amplitude from observables and a lightweight correction fitted only on training sources. Our unified model surpasses harmonic extension across all evaluated families, including unseen cloth and legged bodies, without skeletons, registration, or cross-mesh correspondence. The same prior applies without retraining to point-tracked animal video and a robot grasping a soft body. Project page: https://su-terry.github.io/cepheid-website/

### [382] [PsyBer-Agent: A Psychology-Driven User Agent for Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13989)
*Chong Zhang,Qijie Shen,Haichao Zhang,Can Wang,Xiaobo Jin,Jia Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出心理学启发的推荐系统模拟器 PsyBer-Agent，用潜状态引擎建模用户动态，借助非平衡 Gromov-Wasserstein 最优传输进行校准，并配套 WebSim 平台与基准，实现更真实的长周期闭环仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的模拟器多为表层模仿者，能生成短期逼真回应，却难以刻画疲劳、情感与偏好漂移等底层用户动态，导致长闭环交互中仿真真实性不足，影响部署前的推荐系统评测。

Method: 提出 PsyBer-Agent，其 Psy-Engine 为每个用户建模三个演化中的模型定义潜状态；通过非平衡 Gromov-Wasserstein 最优传输，将日志条件参考轨迹与模拟器生成的潜状态轨迹对齐，为轻量策略提供结构化监督，避免微调骨干 LLM 的高算力开销；同时构建多模态场景的 WebSim 与 PsyBer Benchmark，覆盖七种推荐骨干。

Result: 在测试时域上，PsyBer-Agent 的行为偏差低于纯提示词模拟器；在受限并发下可稳定支持最多 500 万排队仿真任务的大规模并发模拟。评估涵盖行为保真度、潜状态一致性、鲁棒性及对社会线索扰动的响应。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，引入心理学启发的潜状态建模与最优传输校准，可在不微调大模型的前提下提升推荐系统仿真的长周期真实性与可扩展性，并提供配套平台与基准供后续研究使用。

Abstract: Evaluating recommender systems before deployment requires simulators that remain realistic over long, closed-loop interaction cycles. Current LLM-based agents generally function as surface imitators that generate realistic short-term responses but fail to capture the underlying user dynamics such as fatigue, affect, and shifting preferences. We propose PsyBer-Agent, a psychology-inspired simulator that models these dynamics through its Psy-Engine. This engine represents each user with three evolving, model-defined latent states. To calibrate simulated behavior against real interaction logs, we align log-conditioned reference trajectories with simulator-generated latent-state trajectories via Unbalanced Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport. This approach provides structured supervision for a lightweight policy without the computational burden of fine-tuning the backbone LLM. We also introduce WebSim and the PsyBer Benchmark, which encompass multimodal scenarios and seven recommender backbones. Our framework evaluates behavioral fidelity, latent-state consistency, robustness, and responses to social-cue perturbations. On the tested horizons, PsyBer-Agent shows lower behavioral discrepancy than the prompt-only simulators while maintaining stable performance under large-scale concurrent simulation for up to 5M queued simulation tasks under bounded concurrency. Code is available in the supplementary material and at: PsyBer-Agent: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CC66F/, WebSim Platform: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/D8EAX/.

</details>


### [383] [Loose Lips: Understanding Privacy Leakage in Agentic Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14071)
*Soumya Sharma,Ayana Hussain,Heber Hwang Arcolezi,Ulrich Aïvodji,Spandana Gella,Adriana Romero-Soriano,Golnoosh Farnadi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE 基准（4,410 个双智能体对话实例），基于上下文完整性理论评估 LLM 智能体的隐私泄露，发现任务能力与隐私泄露存在结构性耦合：能力越强越易泄露，且无模型能解耦，思考模型泄露更多，泄露随对话轮次增长最高达 3 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 智能体在高风险企业场景中广泛部署，其在智能体对话中如何处理敏感信息变得至关重要。此类场景下的隐私泄露需从信息流是否遵循其原始语境规范的角度来推理，因此需要一个基于理论、系统化的评估基准。

Method: 将 CIMemories 扩展为 CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE，构建包含 4,410 个双智能体对话实例的基准，理论基础为上下文完整性（Contextual Integrity）理论。在此基准上系统评估 Qwen3 与 Llama 3.1 系列共 7 个开放权重模型，覆盖 1 轮与 6 轮对话长度以及三种提示条件。

Result: 任务能力与隐私泄露本质上相互耦合：能力越强的模型系统性地更易泄露，所评估模型中无一能解耦二者。思考（reasoning）模型始终比非思考版本泄露更多，作者将其归因于链式思维带来的更长推理暴露面。泄露随对话长度累积，从 1 轮到 6 轮最高上升约 3 倍。

Conclusion: 任务能力与隐私泄露之间的耦合并非配置失误的产物，而是当前智能体系统的一项结构性特征，需在系统设计层面而非仅靠提示或配置加以应对。

Abstract: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes enterprise settings, understanding how they handle sensitive information in agentic dialogue has become critical. Privacy leakage in such settings requires reasoning about whether information flows respect the contextual norms under which they originated. We extend CIMemories to CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE, a benchmark of 4,410 two-agent dialogue instances grounded in Contextual Integrity theory. Using this benchmark, we systematically evaluate 7 open-weight models from the Qwen3 and Llama 3.1 families across conversation lengths of 1 and 6 turns under three prompting conditions. We find that task capability and privacy leakage are fundamentally coupled: more capable models are systematically leakier, with no model in our evaluation able to decouple the two. Thinking models consistently leak more than their non-thinking counterparts, a pattern we attribute to the extended reasoning surface created by chain-of-thought. Leakage compounds with conversation length, rising up to 3x from 1 to 6 turns. Our results suggest that the coupling between task capability and privacy leakage is not an artifact of misconfiguration but a structural feature of current agentic systems.

</details>


### [384] [Is the Future Predictable? Modeling Future Predictability for Reliable Temporal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14073)
*Yongyi Huang,Huaping Zhang,Wenyao Cui,Qiuchi Li,Lei Li,Baohua Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出面向未来的时间推理任务ChronoRegime及CTR框架，通过评估未来可预测性来调控作答承诺，提升准确率并降低幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在未来推理上仍不可靠，常忽视未来状态之间的差异，即使所查询事实本身具有高度不确定性，也会给出确定答案。

Method: 提出ChronoRegime任务，要求模型判断历史时间证据是否足以支撑对某个未来答案的承诺；并提出置信感知时间推理框架CTR，利用时间动态估计未来可预测性，并据此调控答案承诺，仅在重构证据支持目标未来状态时才作答，而非无条件预测。

Result: 在多个大语言模型上，CTR相比普通问答基线平均将严格整体准确率提升6.7个百分点，并将幻觉率降低18.4个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式的可预测性评估是在未来不确定性下实现更安全、更可靠时间推理的有效机制。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable when reasoning about the future. Existing models often overlook the difference among future states, committing to specific answers even when the queried facts are inherently volatile. To capture this challenge, we introduce ChronoRegime, a future-oriented temporal reasoning task that requires models to determine whether historical temporal evidence justifies commitment to a future answer. Furthermore, we propose Confidence-Aware Temporal Reasoning (CTR), a framework that estimates future predictability from temporal dynamics and regulates answer commitment accordingly. Rather than performing unconditional forecasting, CTR commits only when the reconstructed evidence supports the target future state. Across multiple LLMs, CTR improves strict overall accuracy by 6.7 percentage points and reduces hallucination rates by 18.4 percentage points on average over the plain QA baseline. These results demonstrate that explicit predictability assessment is an effective mechanism for safer and more reliable temporal reasoning under future uncertainty.

</details>


### [385] [Fin_Agent at FinEval 2026: Task-Aware Methods for Multilingual Financial NLP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14101)
*Mohotarema Rashid,Tanzina Hossain,Xiaoying Song,Lingzi Hong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 Fin_Agent 系统，参与 FinEval 2026 多语言金融语言理解共享任务，涵盖希腊语金融命名实体识别、日语隐含沟通识别和多语言金融问答三个子任务，并报告了各任务的性能指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参与 FinEval 2026 共享任务，解决多语言金融语言理解中的命名实体识别、隐含沟通识别与问答问题。

Method: 希腊语 NER 结合标注感知数值规则与零样本 Qwen2.5-32B 分类；日语隐含沟通采用可解释的基于线索的序数评分器；多语言金融 QA 使用 BGE-M3 检索配合 Qwen3-32B 生成。

Result: 希腊语 NER 取得 0.9521 公开 F1 与 0.8884 私有 F1；日语隐含沟通测试准确率 98.0%；多语言金融 QA 在公开与私有划分上 ROUGE-1 F1 分别为 0.3023 与 0.3419。

Conclusion: 系统在多个子任务上表现良好，但受限于数据集特定规则、手工线索和有限监督。

Abstract: We present Fin_Agent, our submission to the FinEval 2026 shared task on multilingual fi nancial language understanding. Our sys tems address Greek financial named-entity recognition, Japanese implicit communication recognition, and multilingual financial ques tion answering. For Greek NER, we com bine annotation-aware numeric rules with zero shot Qwen2.5-32B classification, achieving 0.9521 public F1 and 0.8884 private F1. For Japanese implicit communication, an inter pretable cue-based ordinal scorer achieves 98.0% test accuracy. For multilingual financial QA, BGE-M3retrieval with Qwen3-32B gen eration achieves 0.3023 and 0.3419 ROUGE-1 F1 on the public and private splits. Key limita tions include dataset-specific rules, handcrafted cues, and limited supervision. Implementa tion code is available https://github.com/ Rashidnira/finagent-fineval-2026.

</details>


### [386] [Does System One Transfer? Calibrated Typed-Decision Models, Label Budgets, and Translation for Indonesian Regional Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14112)
*Romi Fadli,Rusdah,Wahyu Ramadani Putri Utami,Zulfa Malika Amana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 对商业Jev与开源Laya多语模型在印尼地方语言上进行预注册评估，发现其准确率受语言与印尼语接近程度影响、校准误差稳定但错误排序能力下降，并提出置信度门控级联方案以低成本达到更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 校准型类型决策（System One）模型以极低成本单次前向返回标签与概率，但其评估几乎完全局限于英语；本文旨在填补对印尼地方语言多语评估的空白。

Method: 在NusaX情感（12语言）与NusaTranslation情感和情绪（7语言）平行测试集上，对Jev与Laya-multilingual进行预注册评估；比较词汇接近度、人工印尼语翻译提升、校准误差、错误排序；对比重训练分类器所需标签量；设计置信度门控级联路由至本地IndoBERT或LLM；并与六个商业LLM比较。

Result: 词汇更接近印尼语的句子Jev更常正确，提供人工印尼语翻译可提升最多37.2个百分点（语言越远提升越大）；预期校准误差未在地方语言上升，但错误排序能力在三个数据集均下降；重训练分类器需每语言超500标签才能在10个NusaX地方语言中的9个匹配零样本Jev；置信度门控级联（将10-30%最不确信决策路由至IndoBERT或LLM）可匹配或超过较优系统，路由至LLM时API成本低24-77%；六个LLM中五个比Jev高4-14点，但成本高数百倍，最小的Claude Haiku更差。

Conclusion: 低成本校准型模型在印尼地方语言上仍有价值，但依赖语言接近度且错误排序退化；置信度门控级联可在成本与性能间取得更好权衡。作者公开预注册、代码与全部预测。

Abstract: Calibrated typed-decision ("System One") models return a label and a probability in a single forward pass at a small fraction of the cost of large language models (LLMs), yet their evaluation has been almost entirely English. We report a pre-registered evaluation of the commercial Jev model and the open Laya-multilingual model on Indonesian regional languages, using the parallel NusaX sentiment (12 languages) and NusaTranslation sentiment and emotion (7 languages) test sets. Jev is more often correct on sentences that are lexically closer to Indonesian in all three datasets, and presenting the human Indonesian translation instead raises its accuracy by up to 37.2 points, most in languages distant from Indonesian. Its expected calibration error does not grow on regional languages, but its ability to rank its own errors degrades in all three datasets. Retrained classifiers need more than 500 labels per language to match zero-shot Jev in 9 of 10 NusaX regional languages. A confidence-gated cascade that sends Jev's 10-30% least confident decisions to a local IndoBERT classifier matches or exceeds the better of the two systems, and routing to an LLM instead matches that LLM at 24-77% lower API cost. Of six further commercial LLMs (three Claude and three GPT models), five are 4-14 points more accurate than Jev, at several hundred times the API cost where it is reported, while the smallest (Claude Haiku) is less accurate. We release the pre-registration, code and all predictions.

</details>


### [387] [Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14162)
*Hermann Kumbong,Ishan S. Khare,Iddah Mlauzi,Andrew Woen,Charles Ding,E. Kelly Buchanan,Simran Arora,Azalia Mirhoseini,Christopher Ré*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: NCM 是一个两阶段由粗到细的扩散式文本生成框架，通过多尺度残差 VQ-VAE 将文本编码为层级离散码，并用 Transformer 逐层并行生成，实现更快且质量更优的生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型虽支持并行采样、生成速度快，但随着采样步数减少质量迅速下降，每步都要处理完整序列，且需多次遍历数据集才能达到较好质量，这些限制了其推理效率与实际应用。

Method: 提出 Next-Concept Modeling（NCM）两阶段由粗到细框架：第一阶段用多尺度残差 VQ-VAE 将文本编码为离散码层级结构；第二阶段用 Transformer 一次生成一个层级，并在该层级内并行预测所有码。

Result: 在相同参数规模下，NCM 在 LM1B 上生成困惑度优于最强 DLM 基线且快 21 倍；在 OpenWebText 上具竞争力且快 10 倍；在 XSum 上 ROUGE-L 与最强 DLM 相当且快 31 倍；在数独推理任务上，NCM 在所有难度级别均优于自回归与扩散基线，且函数评估次数更少。

Conclusion: NCM 通过层级离散表示与逐层并行生成，在保持或提升生成质量的同时显著加速，并在推理任务上展现优势，为扩散式语言建模提供了更高效的方向。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running $21\times$ faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running $10\times$ faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being $31\times$ faster. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations.

</details>


### [388] [Modeling the Arrival Time of Information-Bearing Events in Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14212)
*Leyi Lao,Yulin Ou,Yang Xu,Hao An*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出用神经时序点过程（TPP）建模文本序列中的关键信息事件，以可学习的事件强度函数刻画新词事件与高意外度词事件的生成过程，从而揭示人类与大语言模型在信息分布时序上的生成机制差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于语言信息随时间分布的研究多依赖对意外度等信息论指标的事后分析，缺乏对表层之下生成过程的刻画。论文希望弥补这一空白，深入理解信息事件在时间维度上的生成机制，并据此比较人类与大语言模型的差异。

Method: 论文引入神经时序点过程（TPP），将文本序列中的关键信息承载事件（新词事件与高意外度词事件）用可学习的强度函数建模。模型以事件间隔历史和来自LLM的上下文语义表示为输入，预测两类事件的未来到达时间。

Result: 实验发现事件强度存在有趣差异：LLM产生新词的速率显著高于人类，而高意外度词事件则未表现出这种差异；新词事件强度随时间呈衰减模式（人类与LLM皆然），而高意外度词事件没有该模式。

Conclusion: 研究以更精细的建模范式重新审视并拓展了以往使用较简单方法的结论，为人类语言产生中上下文表征受限的相关理论提供了补充证据，并为考察人类与LLM生成差异提供了新视角。

Abstract: Understanding how information is distributed over time is fundamental to modeling natural language. While existing empirical studies primarily rely on post-hoc analysis of information-theoretic metrics, such as surprisal, little is known about the generation processes under the surface. We propose a novel approach for addressing this gap using the tool of neural temporal point processes (TPPs) by modeling the key information-bearing events in text sequences with learnable event intensity functions. Our model takes the history of event intervals and the contextual semantic representations from LLMs as input, and predicts the future arrival times for two types of events: new-word and high-surprisal-token. The experimental results reveal an interesting distinction in event intensities: LLMs tend to produce new words at significantly higher rates than humans, while high-surprisal tokens do not exhibit the difference. A decaying pattern of intensity over time is found in new-word events for both humans and LLMs, but not in high-surprisal-token events. Our findings revisit and extend previous studies that use simpler methods; provide supplementary evidence for theories about constrained context representation inherent in human language production; and find a new angle to view human and LLM generation differences.

</details>


### [389] [Agentic Data Engineering for LLMs: System Design and a Controlled Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14238)
*Ruomeng Ding,Qianli Shen,Zhaoyang Han,Meixin Chen,Daoyuan Chen,Yaliang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Agentic Data Engineering (ADE)框架，让智能体借助实验反馈迭代改进数据工程策略，在四项任务（数学/代码数据选择、数学奖励设计、数学课程学习）上取得显著增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM数据工程需要反复实验来确定数据选择、奖励与课程如何影响模型学习，是AI-for-AI研究的自然场景。核心问题是：智能体能否利用实验反馈逐步改进策略，且这些策略能否提升目标模型在留出数据上的表现。

Method: 在固定的训练与评测协议下，构建ADE框架，使智能体基于累积发现来推进、修订或组合研究方向；策略先由循环内分数筛选，再在留出基准上评估，并对比不同研究组织方式与反馈获取方式。

Result: 在四个任务上，所选策略相对通用基线最高取得AIME25 Pass@32上13.34%的绝对提升，以及在四个留出基准上平均5.85%的提升（固定训练条件）。循环内分数随实验推进而提升，但留出轨迹显示后期循环收益并不总能带来更好泛化。

Conclusion: 智能体能通过实验反馈有效发展数据工程策略并提升目标模型表现；研究组织与反馈方式的对比支持将证据分析与累积发现相结合；研究轨迹表明早期发现会影响跨方向的策略修订与组合，同时提示循环内分数与泛化能力之间存在差距。

Abstract: LLM data engineering requires iterative experimentation to determine how data selection, rewards, and curricula affect model learning, making it a natural setting for AI-for-AI (AI4AI) research. Can agents use experimental feedback to progressively improve strategies, and do the resulting strategies improve target-model performance on held-out data? We study how agents use experimental feedback to develop data-engineering strategies under fixed training and evaluation protocols. Our Agentic Data Engineering (ADE) framework lets agents pursue, revise, or combine research directions using cumulative findings. Strategies are selected by in-loop scores and evaluated on held-out benchmarks. Across four tasks-math and code data selection, math reward design, and math curriculum learning-selected strategies achieve absolute gains over generic baselines of up to 13.34% on AIME25 Pass@32 and 5.85% averaged across four held-out benchmarks under fixed training conditions. In-loop scores improve over successive experiments, while held-out trajectories show that later in-loop gains do not always improve generalization. Comparisons of research organization and feedback access favor combining evidence analysis with cumulative findings. Research trajectories show how earlier findings inform strategy revisions and combinations across research directions.

</details>


### [390] [The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14270)
*Wenxuan Zhu,Shuming Liu,Bang An,Aznaur Aliev,Bing Li,Yibo Yang,Bernard Ghanem*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"思维泄漏"（thinking leakage）现象：在 NO-THINK 模式下用 GRPO 强化学习所获得的推理性能提升，很大程度上并非习得新能力，而是对原模型 THINK 模式既有推理能力的部分重新激活。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合推理模型（如 Qwen3 系列）可通过少量模板 token 在 THINK 与 NO-THINK 模式间切换。已有流行做法是在 NO-THINK 模式下用强化学习训练这类模型，并报告推理性能提升。作者质疑这种提升的真实来源，希望厘清该增益究竟来自"学会更强的推理"还是"重新激活了原本就存在的推理能力"。

Method: 对 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 在 NO-THINK 模式下用 GRPO 训练；从多个层面进行剖析：(1) 行为层面观察准确率、回答长度与"反思性"、原模型对其是否像"思考"的判断、内部激活是否向 THINK 模式漂移；(2) 权重、激活与注意力头层面，进一步放大 RL 更新、并交换与 THINK 相关的低维激活子空间；(3) 分析 GRPO 训练信号机制，检验优势加权更新偏好的回答是否更具 THINK 特征，以及该梯度是否推动模型向 THINK 状态移动。

Result: 随准确率提升，回答变长、更具反思性，被原模型判定为更像其自身思考，内部激活向 THINK 模式偏移；继续放大 RL 更新会诱发出 THINK 模式行为并接近但不超过 THINK 模式的准确率；在 Qwen3-8B 中，将 RL 训练模型的低维 THINK 相关激活子空间替换为原模型取值可消除大部分 RL 增益，反向替换则可将相当一部分增益转移到原模型；RL 引起的偏移经由读取空 think 块的注意力头传递；GRPO 中优势加权更新偏好的回答更 THINK 化，由该信号计算的梯度步会把模型推向其 THINK 状态。

Conclusion: NO-THINK 模式下的 RL 增益在很大程度上反映的是对原模型已有推理能力的重新激活，而非学习到增强的推理行为。这提示对此类训练效果的解释需谨慎，并为评估混合推理模型的强化学习收益来源提供了新的分析视角。

Abstract: Hybrid reasoning models such as the Qwen3 series switch between a THINK mode and a NO-THINK mode through a few chat-template tokens. A popular recipe trains such models with reinforcement learning in NO-THINK mode and reports improved reasoning performance. We provide evidence that much of this gain can be explained by thinking leakage: the gain comes largely from partially reactivating the reasoning abilities of the original model's THINK mode instead of learning enhanced reasoning behavior. We train Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B with GRPO in NO-THINK mode. As accuracy improves, responses become longer and more reflective, are increasingly judged by the original model to resemble its own thinking, and the model's internal activations shift toward its THINK mode. We then investigate at the level of weights, activations, and attention heads: scaling the RL update further elicits THINK-mode behavior and approaches THINK-mode accuracy but does not exceed it; in Qwen3-8B, replacing a low-dimensional THINK-related activation subspace of the RL-trained model with its original-model value removes most of the RL gain, and the reverse exchange transfers a considerable fraction of the gain to the original model; and the RL-induced shift passes through the attention heads that read the empty think block. We further identify a possible mechanism in the GRPO training signal: responses favored by the advantage-weighted update are more THINK-like, and a gradient step computed from this signal moves the model toward its THINK state. Thus, gains in NO-THINK mode can largely reflect reactivation of reasoning abilities already present in the original model.

</details>


### [391] [ASSET: Adaptive Speech Segmentation via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14309)
*Cihan Xiao,Yuan Tseng,Matthew Wiesner,Desh Raj,Leibny Paola Garcia Perera,Sanjeev Khudanpur,David Harwath*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Speech LLMs 通常用声学编码器产生比文本长得多的序列，而 LLM 对输入长度扩展性差，因此需要压缩。本文提出 ASSET，用强化学习框架学习自适应压缩编码器输出：先将输出划分为变长片段，再将每个片段池化为一个连续音频 token，并用 GRPO 以任务表现反馈和 token 率惩罚训练分段器。在 ASR 实验中，ASSET 在英文 LibriSpeech 上以约少 25% 音频 token 达到与转录辅助的字符边界 oracle 相当的性能，并在中文 AISHELL 上在相近 token 率下优于音素边界 oracle。非 ASR 任务上的探索性实验显示，任务不同会使学到的分段方式发生变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音大语言模型常以预训练声学编码器作为音频接口连接 LLM 解码器，但 LLM 对输入序列长度的扩展性较差，而声学编码器输出的序列通常远长于典型文本输入。这促使研究者在保留任务相关信息的同时，学习压缩编码器输出。

Method: 提出 ASSET，一个基于强化学习的框架，用于自适应压缩编码器输出。它先将编码器输出划分为可变时长片段，再将每个片段池化为一个连续音频 token。使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）训练分段器，训练信号包括任务性能反馈和 token 率惩罚。

Result: 在自动语音识别（ASR）实验中，ASSET 在英文 LibriSpeech 上以约少 25% 的音频 token 达到与转录辅助的字符边界 oracle 相当的性能；在中文 AISHELL 上，在相近 token 率下优于音素边界 oracle。在非 ASR 任务上的探索性实验表明，当框架被适配到转录之外的任务时，学习到的分段方式会发生变化。

Conclusion: ASSET 表明，通过强化学习训练自适应分段与池化，可以在保持任务性能的同时有效压缩语音 LLM 的音频 token 数量，并且该框架可扩展到非 ASR 任务，学到的分段策略会随任务而变化。

Abstract: Speech large language models (LLMs) are often built using pretrained acoustic encoders as an audio interface to an LLM decoder. However, LLMs scale poorly with input sequence length, while acoustic encoders tend to produce substantially longer sequences than typical textual inputs. This motivates learning to compress encoder outputs while preserving task-oriented information. To this end, we introduce ASSET, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based framework that learns to adaptively compress encoder outputs by first partitioning them into variable-duration segments and then pooling each segment into a continuous audio token. We use group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to train a segmenter with task performance feedback and a token-rate penalty. In automatic speech recognition (ASR) experiments, ASSET achieves performance comparable to a transcript-assisted character-boundary oracle with approximately 25% fewer audio tokens on English LibriSpeech, while improving on a phone-boundary oracle at a similar token rate on Mandarin AISHELL. Exploratory experiments on non-ASR tasks further illustrate how learned segmentation changes when the framework is adapted to tasks beyond transcription.

</details>


### [392] [Evaluating LLMs as Agentic Workflow Executors in Real-World Customer Support Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14346)
*Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar,Gundeep Singh,Xue-Yong Fu,Karol Chang,Kevin Sanders,Shi Zong,Tania Habib,Julien Bouvier Tremblay,Shayna Gardiner,Harsh Saini,Matthias Lee,Elena Khasanova,Quinten McNamara,Shashi Bhushan TN*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"Skill LLM"基准构建流水线，从真实客服对话中挖掘工作流并生成多轮工具调用评测集，对17个模型进行零样本评测，发现模型排名稳定但评审员间一致性有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业客服智能体越来越多依赖大语言模型执行有界的工具调用工作流，但缺乏针对"技能执行"这一受限、有状态场景的系统评测，且现有评测对评审可靠性关注不足。

Method: 构建基准流水线：从真实对话记录中挖掘高频工作流→转为结构化技能描述→映射工具需求→用MCP兼容mock模拟环境状态→生成多轮工具调用对话。对17个模型（闭源家族与1.7B–14B开源权重模型）做零样本评测，每个样本由5个强LLM评审独立打分，并配确定性规则评估器检查工具覆盖、幻觉工具调用与无依据陈述。

Result: 排名在不同评审下保持一致：GPT-5.4大幅领先，QWEN3.5-9B为20B以下最强开源模型，超过多个闭源基线。同时发现评审选择不可忽视：10组评审对的通过/失败判定平均Kappa仅0.524。

Conclusion: 技能执行的全面零样本评测中，评审可靠性需与模型能力同等重视，评审方法是不可忽略的方法学变量。

Abstract: Enterprise customer-support agents increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) to execute bounded, tool-using workflows. We study this problem through the lens of Skill LLMs: specialized executors that operate within a selected skill context and must complete a narrow, stateful workflow under policy and tool constraints. We present a benchmark construction pipeline that mines recurrent workflows from real-world transcripts, converts them into structured skill descriptions, maps them to tool requirements, simulates environment state with Model Context Protocol (MCP)-compatible mocks, and generates multi-turn tool-using dialogues. Using this benchmark, we conduct a large-scale zero-shot evaluation of 17 language models spanning closed model families and deployment-oriented open-weight models from 1.7B to 14B parameters, each judged independently by five strong LLM judges, plus a deterministic rule-based evaluator that checks tool coverage, hallucinated tool use, and unsupported claims. We find a consistent ranking in which GPT-5.4 leads by a wide margin and QWEN3.5-9B is the strongest open-weight model (below 20B), outperforming several closed baselines under every judge. We also find that judge choice is not a negligible methodological detail: pairwise judge agreement on the pass/fail verdict averages Kappa=0.524 across 10 judge pairs. These results suggest that comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of skill execution requires judge reliability as carefully as model capability.

</details>


### [393] [Multimodal Co-Generation With Continuous Bitstream Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14349)
*Georgios Batzolis,Georgios Kontos,Bruno Trentini,Pranam Chatterjee,Micha Livne,Mark Girolami,Luca Ambrogioni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出连续比特流扩散（CoBit）作为统一的多模态生成框架，用同一套训练与采样协议处理图文、语音-文本和蛋白质序列-结构建模，并验证其在联合与条件生成上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态生成通常需要针对不同模态设计专门的分词器、目标和采样流程，框架不统一、依赖复杂。作者希望验证一种源自语言建模的连续比特流扩散方法，能否在不引入领域特定目标或采样程序的条件下，统一处理差异很大的模态及其跨模态依赖关系，并支持联合生成与多方向条件生成共用一个模型检查点。

Method: CoBit 将各模态表示为连续比特流，各模态任务分别从零训练，但共享单一输入投影、Transformer 主干、逐比特预测头和二元分数匹配目标。训练时通过改变比特流中被观测的部分，使同一检查点即可支持联合生成以及训练中涵盖的各条件生成方向。作者先在受控的 MNIST-Sum 图文任务（原始二值图像配方程文本）上验证，再在更大规模上应用于语音-文本和蛋白质序列-结构建模，全程不依赖学习到的分词器。

Result: 在 MNIST-Sum 上取得近乎完美的条件准确率和较高的联合一致性；在语音-文本任务中，单一模型在无文本预训练情况下完成语音合成、识别、续写和无条件协同生成，联合生成的语音与文本之间词错误率为 3.5%；在蛋白质任务中，单一检查点支持正向折叠、反向折叠和联合序列-结构生成，对 100-500 残基的联合生成蛋白，计算重折叠结构与生成骨架的平均自洽 TM-score 达 0.911。

Conclusion: CoBit 提供了一个适用于差异显著模态和多种跨模态依赖形式的通用生成框架，同一训练与采样协议即可覆盖联合生成与多方向条件生成，无需领域特定目标或采样流程，表明连续比特流扩散可作为统一多模态生成的可行基础。

Abstract: We show that continuous bitstream diffusion (CoBit), originally developed for language modeling, provides a unified framework for joint and conditional multimodal generation using the same training and sampling protocol. Across image-text, speech-text and protein sequence-structure modeling, models are trained separately from scratch, but each uses a single input projection, transformer backbone, bitwise prediction head and binary score-matching objective shared across its modalities. Within each setting, a single checkpoint supports joint generation and the conditional directions included in training by changing which parts of the bitstream are observed. We first validate the approach on MNIST-Sum, a controlled image-text task pairing raw binary images with equations encoded as text, achieving near-perfect conditional accuracy and high joint consistency without learned tokenizers. We then apply the same protocol at larger scale to speech-text and protein sequence-structure modeling. Trained without text pretraining, a single speech-text model performs speech synthesis, recognition, continuation, and unconditional co-generation. Jointly generated speech and text achieve 3.5% word error rate between the generated text and automatic transcriptions of the generated speech. In protein modeling, a single CoBit checkpoint supports forward folding, inverse folding, and joint sequence-structure generation. For jointly generated proteins spanning 100-500 residues, computational refolding of CoBit's sequences yields structures that agree with the generated backbones at a mean self-consistency TM-score of 0.911. Together, these results show that CoBit provides a common generative framework for substantially different modalities and forms of cross-modal dependence, without introducing a domain-specific objective or sampling procedure.

</details>


### [394] [SciCurateBench: Curating Experimental Data from Heterogeneous Scientific Literature with Verbal-Action Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14393)
*Minuk Ma,Kaiyun Guo,Jiarui Ding*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 SciCurateBench 基准（200 篇专家标注论文），评估系统能否从原始文献中验证多条件生物学实验标准，并推出 LangPoli 系统，在分类与检索任务上显著优于基础 LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科研愈发依赖从文献中整理实验数据，需跨长且异构的文件核实具体实验条件（如特定测定、临床结果、数据可用性），过程极耗时。现有基准仅用短查询评估宽泛相关性，无法反映这一复杂任务。

Method: 构建 SciCurateBench：来自主要生命科学期刊的 200 篇专家标注论文，要求系统从原始未处理文献中验证联合（conjunctive）生物学实验标准。提出 LangPoli 集成系统：策略代理（policy agent）生成自然语言行动指南，由执行代理（actor agents）转化为可执行工具；并探索 curriculum transfer，从已解任务中蒸馏可泛化策略以加速相关问题求解。

Result: 普通 LLM 及主流推理、工具使用与反馈型 agent 在该任务上均表现不佳。LangPoli 在论文分类上达到 83.16% F1（其基础 LLM 为 58.22%），在结构化信息检索上表现强劲，并在 LitSearch、BEIR、TREC 公开基准上提升重排序效果。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了真实科研数据整理任务的难度，LangPoli 与 curriculum transfer 为实用型科学 AI 助手研究提供了方向，预发布版本已匿名公开。

Abstract: Scientific research increasingly depends on curating experimental data from literature. Scientific data curation requires verifying exact experimental conditions (e.g., specific assays, clinical outcomes, and data availability) across long, heterogeneous files, which is a highly time-consuming process. Existing benchmarks evaluate only broad relevance on short queries, failing to capture this complexity. We introduce SciCurateBench, a benchmark of 200 expert-annotated papers from major life-science journals that challenges systems to verify conjunctive biological experimental criteria from raw, unprocessed scientific literature. We show that plain LLMs and popular reasoning, tool-using, and feedback-based agents all struggle with this task. To study what makes the task tractable, we further propose LangPoli, an integrative system in which a policy agent generates natural language action guidelines that actor agents convert into executable tools. LangPoli showed strong performance on both Paper Classification (83.16% F1 vs. 58.22% for its base LLM) and Structured Information Retrieval, and also improves re-ranking on the public benchmarks of LitSearch, BEIR, and TREC. We further explore curriculum transfer, a method that distills generalizable strategies from solved tasks to accelerate the solving of related problems. We hope this work facilitates research in truly practical scientific AI assistance. The anonymized pre-release can be found from https://anonymous.4open. science/r/scicuratebench-D885/.

</details>


### [395] [Scaling Laws for Multimodal Data Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14423)
*Aditi Khandelwal,Ayush K. Tarun,Yixuan Xu,Imanol Schlag,Golnoosh Farnadi,Siva Reddy,Luke Zettlemoyer,Antoine Bosselut*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过268组MoE实验推导文本、视觉、音频三模态的数据混合缩放规律，揭示了模态特异的计算最优、数据重复收益递减及非对称跨模态干扰等关键结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿AI系统正转向原生多模态预训练，但对多模态数据混合（各模态配比及其相互干扰代价）的科学理解严重缺失或被封闭，缺乏指导性理论依据。

Method: 采用Mixture-of-Experts架构（可高效扩展并部分限制跨模态干扰），针对文本、视觉、音频三种模态开展268次实验，模型规模从457M到8.3B参数，训练数据量最高达1500亿token，并据此推导数据混合缩放定律。

Result: 得到三项可操作结论：1）计算最优呈模态特异——音频偏"模型重"，倾向扩参数而非增token，文本与视觉则需模型与数据均衡扩展；2）视觉或音频数据重复超过2倍后收益可忽略；3）跨模态干扰高度不对称——视觉对音频干扰强烈，而音频对文本和视觉学习的干扰可忽略。

Conclusion: 该工作为理解训练前沿多模态大模型所需的数据混合提供了有原则的理论基础与量化指导。

Abstract: Frontier AI systems are increasingly natively multimodal, jointly pretrained on multiple modalities, such as text, vision, and audio. However, the scientific understanding of the multimodal data mixtures used to pretrain these systems --- how much of each modality to mix, and at what potential interference cost to the others --- is largely absent or gatekept. In this work, we derive data mixing scaling laws for three modalities: text, vision, and audio. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly adopt Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, as MoEs scale efficiently and partially limit cross-modal interference. We therefore use MoEs to conduct 268 experiments ranging from 457M to 8.3B parameters, on up to 150 billion tokens. Our work leads to multiple actionable insights into multimodal data mixing for training MLLMs. First, compute optima are modality-specific: audio modality is model-heavy, favoring scaling parameters over tokens, while text and vision require balanced scaling of model size and data. Second, repeating vision or audio data beyond 2x yields negligible benefits. Finally, cross-modal interactions are highly asymmetric: vision strongly interferes with audio, whereas audio's interference with learning text and vision is negligible. Overall, we provide a principled foundation for understanding the multimodal data mixtures needed to train frontier MLLMs.

</details>


### [396] [Neither True nor False: Do LLMs Represent Truth-Value Gaps in Plural Predication?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14438)
*Duaa Nakshbandi,Zhiyu An,Yiping Li,Sachin Giri,Wan Du*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"同质性间隙"（Homogeneity Gap）这一语义现象的研究框架，构建诊断数据集 HomogeneityNLI，发现当前开源权重的LLM普遍存在"二值偏差"：虽掌握了复数定指的真值条件，却未习得其三值逻辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨LLM是否真正理解复数描述的真值条件，还是将所有句子强行判定为真或假。复数定指（如 the kids laughed）及其否定在仅部分孩子笑时既非真也非假，而量化对应形式（all / not all）保持严格二值，二者构成语义对比，为检验LLM语义能力提供了理想切入点。

Method: 构建 HomogeneityNLI 诊断数据集，包含 1,000 个最小对立体，交叉限定词、极性与群体构成，覆盖十种逻辑条件；在零样本设置下评测七个开放权重模型，并测试显式语言规则提示、思维链（CoT）与枚举提示的效果。

Result: 模型为复数定指赋予同质真值条件（the kids 读作"全部"，the kids didn't 读作"全都不"），却将真值间隙坍缩为假。零样本下，无任何模型能在超过15%的场景中同时识别两种极性的间隙；否定式定指在84%的情况下被判为假。显式规则、CoT与枚举提示效果不稳定且因模型而异，往往反而强化偏差。

Conclusion: 当前开放权重LLM已习得复数谓述的真值条件，但尚未掌握其三值逻辑，存在系统性的二值偏差。

Abstract: Do Large Language Models (LLMs) genuinely grasp the truth conditions of plural descriptions, or do they force every sentence into true or false? We investigate the Homogeneity Gap, a semantic phenomenon where a plural definite (e.g., the kids laughed) and its negation (the kids didn't laugh) are both neither true nor false when only some of the kids laughed, whereas their quantified counterparts (all, not all) remain strictly bivalent. We introduce HomogeneityNLI, a diagnostic dataset of 1,000 minimal-pair items crossing determiner, polarity, and group composition across ten logical conditions. Evaluating seven open-weight models, we uncover a pervasive Bivalence Bias: models assign plural definites their homogeneous truth conditions, reading the kids as all of them and the kids didn't as none of them, yet collapse the truth-value gap into falsity. In the zero-shot setting, no model recognizes the gap for both polarities in more than 15% of scenarios, and negated definites are judged False in 84% of cases.
