We call this a model's compositional strength and formalize it using the Shapley value of a cooperative game over coalitions of a model pool, and use a model's leave-one-out contribution to the full coalition as a tractable proxy, requiring n+1 rather than 2^n system evaluations. Evaluating individual vs. compositional strengths across five model pools, twelve collaboration methods, and twelve datasets, we find them largely uncorrelated: in 12 of 15 (pool, method-family) settings, individual strength does not translate into compositional advantages, and the coupling is weakest among general-purpose models that practitioners are most likely to deploy. Standalone benchmarks are therefore often poor proxies for models' value in collaborative systems. We then propose compositional reinforcement learning (C-RL), which trains a policy inside a live multi-model system and rewards the outcome produced by the system as a whole, rather than the policy's correctness in isolation. The leave-one-out baseline in Shapley values cancels under a group policy gradient, so this needs no additional rollout cost beyond RL on the collaborative system's outcome and never requires running a coalition without the policy. Across three collaboration protocols and eight tasks spanning reasoning, coding, and scientific discovery, C-RL produces the strongest collaborator in 21 of 24 settings, lifting collaborative performance by +4.0 to +5.4 pts on average (~3x the gain of baselines), up to +13.1 pts.

</details>


### [537] [Distilling Text LMs into Speech-to-Speech LMs by Matching Internal Text Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17461)
*Ju-Chieh Chou,Jiawei Zhou,Karen Livescu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种语音到语音预训练方法，通过引入内部文本接口实现文本语言模型知识蒸馏，在保持纯语音输入输出的同时提升语音生成质量与事实性知识保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本语言模型通过大规模预训练获得广泛的语言和事实能力，而仅从语音中学习这些能力仍然困难。已有知识蒸馏方法主要针对"语音输入-文本输出"模型，尚未探索用于同时以语音为输入和输出的语音到语音模型。

Method: 提出语音到语音预训练方法，构建内部文本接口进行知识迁移：模型先接收无转录的语音上下文，切换到文本预测，再用预测文本逐词引导后续语音生成；内部文本预测可直接从基础文本语言模型进行知识蒸馏。

Result: 在相同训练条件下，所提序列构建方式相比纯语音模型和语音-文本交错模型显著改善口语续写的生成困惑度，接近带外部ASR提示转录的文本引导内独白模型性能；蒸馏在文本和语音评估下均提升事实性能。

Conclusion: 这是文本语言模型蒸馏首次应用于语音到语音语言模型，表明内部文本接口能有效迁移文本语言模型的知识，提升语音模型的事实性与生成质量。

Abstract: Text language models (LMs) acquire broad linguistic and factual capabilities through large-scale pretraining, while comparable capabilities remain difficult to learn from speech alone. Recent work has shown that knowledge distillation from pretrained text LMs offers a promising way to transfer their linguistic and factual capabilities to speech models. However, existing distillation approaches have largely focused on speech-input, text-output models. This idea has yet to be explored for {\it speech-to-speech} models, which operate on both speech input and speech output. In this work we introduce a speech-to-speech pretraining method that creates an internal text interface for knowledge transfer while preserving the speech-only input and output. The model first consumes speech context without its transcription, switches to text prediction, and then uses the predicted text to lead future speech generation word by word. It also provides an interface for knowledge distillation: the internal text predictions can be directly distilled from the base text LM. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of text LM distillation to a speech-to-speech LM. Under matched training conditions, the proposed sequence construction substantially improves the generative perplexity of spoken continuations over speech-only and interleaved speech-text models, approaching the performance of a text-leading inner-monologue model with external ASR prompt transcription. More importantly, distillation improves factual performance under both text and speech evaluation, indicating better retention of knowledge from the base text language model.

</details>


### [538] [Everyone Was Right: Lexical Representations in Language Models Are Both Abstract and Holistic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17538)
*Zachary Nicholas Houghton,Yu Zhou,Dan Pluth,Vijay K. Gurbani,Vsevolod Kapatsinski*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究将上下文词表示分解为项目、类别及词-类交互三部分，发现交互成分在六个预训练Transformer中稳定存在并随层增长，且编码了超越共享类别效应的信息；即使输入仅含加性结构，人工语言学习者也会涌现此类交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 词汇表征既包含抽象信息，也包含特定语境信息，但此前研究不清楚这两类信息在语言模型内部是如何组织与交互的，作者希望厘清其结构。

Method: 将上下文词表示分解为item（项目）、class（类别）和word-class interaction（词-类交互）三个成分，在六种预训练Transformer和两类语言范畴上进行检验，并辅以人工语言学习者的对照实验。

Result: 交互成分始终存在，且随网络层数增加而增强，同时包含与项目、类别相关的信息；不同于近乎正交的项目与类别效应，交互与二者均重叠，并编码了共享类别效应之外的类别信息；人工语言学习者在仅含加性结构的输入下也涌现出交互。

Conclusion: 词汇表征并非仅将抽象信息简单叠加，而是将抽象信息与特定词-类组合所独有的结构结合起来，说明交互结构是词汇表征组织的内在特征。

Abstract: Lexical representations can encode both abstract information and information specific to particular contexts. We investigate how these forms of information are organized in language models by decomposing contextual word representations into item, class, and word-class interaction components. Across six pretrained transformers and two linguistic categories, we find that the interaction is consistently present, grows across layers, and contains information associated with both item and class. Unlike the nearly orthogonal item and class effects, the interaction overlaps with both and encodes class information beyond the shared class effect. An interaction also emerges in artificial-language learners even when the input contains only additive structure. Together, these findings show that lexical representations combine abstract information with structure specific to particular word-class combinations.

</details>


### [539] [Many Steps into One: Reasoning Contraction and the Limits of Safe Memory Reuse for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17544)
*Jianghong Zhou,Hao Rong,Chen Lin,Daoan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"推理收缩"概念，指模板、技能库、记忆与缓存将多步推理压缩为一步；并证明常用的成功/失败计数器是糟糕的变化检测器，进而提出带认证的记忆方案以安全地跳过推理步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理收缩虽节省步骤与错误，但一旦事实变化，收缩后的记忆会悄然给出错误答案。现有系统多依靠统计成功与失败次数来信任记忆，作者发现这种计数方式作为变化检测器严重失准，因此需要更可靠的机制来判断记忆是否仍然有效。

Method: 理论上证明对称计数器只有在误报时域的幂次之后才能察觉部分变化，而未截断的计数器可能永远无法察觉。提出一套认证方案：用每个记忆自身的似然比对失败进行加权，针对实时推理验证其效用，当事实变化时重启认证，并用似然比检测器作为未声明变化的安全网；对大规模编辑还直接使记忆失效。

Result: 在五个 LLM 上针对被编辑事实回答多跳问题，ExpeL 与 ACE 式计数器给出的过时答案比认证记忆多 7.0–13.5 倍；在带精确验证器的代码任务上多 35–73 倍。此外发现安全性有代价：当事实变化且每个记忆仅由自身已验证结果评判时，单一数值"认证负载"决定了安全记忆可跳过多少推理，在 Zipf 需求下形成一条缩放律。

Conclusion: 基于计数的记忆信任机制在事实变化下不可靠，应以似然比加权、效用认证与变化重启为核心的认证记忆取代，并认识到可跳过推理量受认证负载约束、遵循相应缩放律。

Abstract: Thought templates, skill libraries, agent memories and caches turn many reasoning steps into one. We call this reasoning contraction. A contracted memory saves reasoning steps and errors until its facts change, then quietly answers wrong. Most systems trust memories by counting successes and failures. We prove that such counters are badly tuned change detectors: a symmetric counter notices a partial change only after a power of its false-alarm horizon, and an unclipped one may never notice it. On five LLMs answering multi-hop questions over edited facts, ExpeL- and ACE-style counters serve 7.0-13.5x more stale answers than certified memories given the same information, and on code tasks with an exact verifier 35-73x more. Safety also has a price. When facts change and each memory is judged only by its own verified outcomes, one number, the certification load, sets how much reasoning any safe memory can skip, and under Zipf demand it yields a scaling law. Our recipe weighs each memory's failures by its own likelihood ratio, certifies its utility against live reasoning, and restarts the certificate when facts change, with the likelihood-ratio detector as the safety net for unannounced changes; for large edits it also invalidates the memory.

</details>


### [540] [EdgeWise: Bringing Long-Horizon Agents to the Edge via Selective Cloud Delegation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17560)
*Zeru Shi,Jindong Jiang,Ryo Hachiuma,Yonggan Fu,Byung-Kwan Lee,Peter Belcak,Saurav Muralidharan,Ayush Agarwal,Ruixiang Tang,Ambrish Dantrey,Pavlo Molchanov,Anjul Patney,Subhashree Radhakrishnan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EdgeWise 通过将云端 LLM 选择性委派给关键步骤，在边云协作中实现与全 LLM 执行相当甚至更优的性能，同时大幅降低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程复杂智能体任务通常依赖云端前沿模型，但逐步调用成本高昂，而并非所有步骤都需要相同级别的模型能力，因此存在按需分配模型能力的优化空间。

Method: 提出 EdgeWise 边云协作框架，本地部署 SLM 作为主求解器，仅在需要更强能力时委派关键步骤至云端 LLM；引入步骤级强化学习方法联合优化任务求解与委派，并进行细粒度信用分配；同时提出基于外部评判器的委派策略以系统研究委派时机、决策方式、共享上下文及调用频率等设计选择。

Result: EdgeWise 性能匹配或超越纯 LLM 执行，并在 SWE-Rebench 上降低推理成本最高 62%，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上降低 34%；在本地工作站部署中同样取得可比的成本节省。

Conclusion: 仅对少量关键步骤分配 LLM 即可达到接近全域 LLM 的效果，边云协作结合步骤级委派学习是降低长时程智能体推理成本的有效途径。

Abstract: Complex and long-horizon agent tasks often rely on frontier models deployed in the cloud to achieve strong performance. However, using these models for every step of a long-horizon trajectory incurs substantial inference cost, even though not all steps may require the same level of model capability. In this paper, we find that allocating the LLM to only a small subset of key steps can achieve performance comparable to full LLM execution while significantly reducing inference cost. Motivated by this observation, we propose EdgeWise, an edge-cloud collaboration framework that deploys an SLM on the local device as the primary solver and selectively delegates critical steps to a cloud LLM when stronger model capacity is needed. To enable autonomous delegation without additional models at inference time, we introduce a step-level RL method that jointly optimizes task solving and delegation, with fine-grained credit assignment for individual delegation decisions. We also introduce an external judge-based delegation strategy and use it to systematically investigate key design choices in edge-cloud collaboration, including when to delegate, how delegation decisions should be made, what context should be shared, and how frequently the cloud LLM should be invoked. Experiments show that EdgeWise matches or outperforms pure-LLM execution while reducing inference cost up to 62% on SWE-Rebench and 34% on Terminal-Bench 2.1. We further deploy EdgeWise on a local workstation, demonstrating comparable cost savings in a practical edge-cloud setting.

</details>


### [541] [Dissociating Answerability from Extraction in LLM Question Answering over Radiology Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17576)
*Priyanshu Sinha,Kelsey McDonald*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将放射学报告问答评估拆分为"是否可答"与"抽取质量"两个独立决策，用假答率、过度弃答率与F1并列报告，并在13个LLM上验证其必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RadQA评估仅用单一F1指标，将"是否给出答案"与"答案抽取得多好"两个决策混为一谈。假答会把无依据的断言当作事实，过度弃答则隐藏报告内容，两类错误性质不同却被合并，掩盖了模型间的实质差异。

Method: 提出一种分离式评估方法：在F1之外单独报告假答率与过度弃答率，并将F1变化分解为抽取项与可答性项。在RadQA测试集上对13个LLM进行零样本及三个累积演示集（最后一个加入一个不可答示例）的评测，并检验多模型投票式弃答策略。

Result: F1相近的模型假答率相差超过两倍；加入不可答示例改变的是模型"何时作答"而非"抽取得多好"——13个模型中有12个弃答增多，被撤回的答案中约四分之三其F1≥0.5。模型内部假答与抽取质量无明显关联；但仅在多个模型同时作答时保留答案，可使零样本假答率下降4个百分点，而F1无显著变化。

Conclusion: 由于可答性与抽取两个决策可独立变化，放射学问答评估应分别报告二者，而非仅依赖F1。

Abstract: Answering questions from radiology reports involves two decisions: whether the report contains an answer and which span gives it. A false answer presents an unsupported claim as fact; an over-abstention hides what the report says. Yet RadQA results are reported as a single F1 that merges both. We propose an evaluation method that separates them, reporting false-answer and over-abstention rates beside F1 and splitting F1 changes into extraction and answerability terms. We apply it to 13 LLMs on the RadQA test set, zero-shot and with three cumulative demonstration sets, the last adding an unanswerable example. Models with similar F1 differed more than twofold in false-answer rate. The unanswerable example changed when models answered, not how well they extracted: 12 of 13 models abstained more often, and three-quarters of the answers they withdrew had F1 $\geq$ 0.5. Within models, false answers showed no clear association with extraction quality, but acting on the decision itself helped: keeping an answer only when enough other models also answered lowered the zero-shot false-answer rate by 4 points without a detectable F1 change. Because the two decisions can change independently, we suggest radiology QA evaluations report them separately, not through F1 alone.

</details>


### [542] [TDR: Tagalog Diacritic Restoration Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17597)
*Ivan Yuri De Leon,Lanz Railey Fermin,Zachary Aldridge Africa,Richell Isaiah Flores*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了TDR——一个针对40个高频他加禄语同形异义词的标注语料库，并提出搭配驱动的检索方法以扩充数据、缓解类别不平衡，证明该语料可为小型廉价模型和微调大模型所学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 他加禄语同形异义词靠tuldik（变音符号）区分意义和发音，但当代文本中这些符号极少保留，导致变音符号还原困难，进而影响语音合成中韵律选择等下游任务。现有预训练模型缺乏这一能力，且相关标注数据稀缺、类别严重不平衡。

Method: 从新闻文本构建包含40个高频他加禄语同形异义词的标注语料库TDR；提出一种由搭配（collocation）驱动的检索方法来扩充数据集，并缓解少数变体之间的严重类别不平衡。

Result: TDR提供了预训练模型所不具备的能力；实验表明该能力不仅可以被微调的大语言模型习得，也能被小型、低成本的模型学会。

Conclusion: TDR填补了他加禄语变音符号还原标注资源的空白，其搭配驱动扩充策略有效应对类别不平衡，为韵律选择等下游任务提供了可行且低成本的数据与模型方案。

Abstract: Homographs are words that share identical spelling but differ in meaning and pronunciation. In Tagalog, these distinctions are disambiguated in writing through tuldik (diacritical marks), which are rarely preserved in contemporary Tagalog text. This scarcity of diacritics limits diacritic restoration, which is useful for downstream tasks such as prosody selection for text-to-speech synthesis. To address this gap, this study introduces TDR, an annotated corpus of 40 frequent Tagalog homographs constructed from news text. It also introduces a collocation-driven retrieval method to expand the dataset and mitigate severe class imbalance among minor variants. Finally, we show that TDR supplies a capability absent from pretrained models, and that this capability can be learned by small, inexpensive models as well as by fine-tuned LLMs.

</details>


### [543] [Facts Don't Speak Louder than Words: The Behavioral Essence of Long-CoT Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17607)
*Yongcan Yu,Jian Liang,Lingxiao He,Kuangpu Guo,Yanbo Wang,Shuo Lu,Meng Wang,Ran He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 长链思维链蒸馏的本质是行为对齐（学习结构化推理模式），而非事实知识记忆；概率型损失擅长简单模式，交叉熵损失对复杂CoT更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长链CoT蒸馏流程普遍依赖拒绝采样收集推理轨迹，并默认"事实正确性"与"广泛问题覆盖"不可或缺，但其内在机制尚不清楚，作者希望揭示其真正起作用的核心要素。

Method: 通过控制变量实验验证：仅用有缺陷的推理轨迹或受限提示集训练、仅在被模型已掌握的问题上微调，以隔离"行为对齐"与"新知识注入"；随后比较概率型损失与标准交叉熵损失在不同复杂度推理模式上的学习效果。

Result: 反直觉地发现，仅用错误推理轨迹或有限提示训练，性能几乎相当；即便只在已掌握的问题上微调也能获得显著推理提升；概率型损失在简单模式上表现优异，而交叉熵损失对扩展到复杂CoT不可或缺。

Conclusion: 长链CoT蒸馏的真正瓶颈是推理模式的行为对齐，而非事实知识；研究为推理模型的发展提供了有原则的理论基础，并公开了代码。

Abstract: While long chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation significantly improves the reasoning abilities of language models, its underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. Current pipelines generally rely on rejection sampling to gather reasoning traces across diverse prompts, assuming that factual correctness and broad problem coverage are indispensable. Surprisingly, we find that training exclusively on flawed reasoning trajectories or a restricted prompt set yields nearly comparable performance. Driven by this counterintuitive finding, we propose the Behavioral Hypothesis: the essence of Long-CoT distillation is behavioral alignment with structured reasoning patterns, rather than factual knowledge memorization. We then validate this by demonstrating substantial reasoning gains even when models are fine-tuned exclusively on previously mastered problems-effectively isolating behavioral alignment from novel knowledge injection. Having established that reasoning patterns are the true bottleneck, we investigate how to learn them across varying levels of complexity optimally. We reveal a critical interplay: while the recent probability-based loss excels at learning simple patterns, the standard cross-entropy loss is essential for scaling to complex CoTs. We believe these insights demystify CoT distillation and provide a principled foundation for the future development of reasoning models. Code is available on https://github.com/yuyongcan/Long-CoT-Distillation.

</details>


### [544] [When Does an ASR Error Matter? Task-Role Diagnostics for Tool-Using Voice Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17619)
*Xiaolong Wang,Shijie Su,Naqi Xiong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SpeechEvalX配对诊断协议，考察ASR错误所影响的任务角色如何影响结构化工具调用，发现任务角色比传统WER或二元关键性更能预测下游影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 级联语音代理中，ASR错误的下游后果差异很大：小错误可能不改变工具调用，也可能改变其意图或参数。但传统词错误率（WER）无法捕捉这些差异。

Method: 提出SpeechEvalX配对诊断协议，控制编辑在源话语、编辑数量与操作上匹配，并将任务角色标签与词汇严重度、BERT余弦距离、Semantic-WER及二元关键性进行比较。

Result: 在594条源话语上，联合调用准确率从参考转写的82.3%降至三种ASR前端的71.9-74.9%。数字与否定编辑造成21.9-25.7个百分点损失，而对照编辑仅1.4-2.9个百分点。细粒度任务角色标签使源分组ROC-AUC从0.73提升至0.78。

Conclusion: 下游影响强烈依赖于所影响的任务角色，细粒度任务角色标注优于二元关键性及传统指标，表明评估ASR应关注任务角色而非仅词级错误。

Abstract: In cascaded voice agents, ASR errors can have markedly different downstream consequences: a small transcription error may leave a tool call unchanged or alter its intent or arguments. Conventional word error rate (WER), however, does not capture these differences. We introduce SpeechEvalX, a paired diagnostic protocol that evaluates how task roles affected by ASR errors influence structured tool calls. Controlled edits are matched by source utterance, edit count, and operation, while task-role labels are compared with lexical severity, BERT cosine distance, Semantic-WER, and binary criticality. Across 594 source utterances, joint call accuracy falls from 82.3% with reference transcripts to 71.9-74.9% across three ASR front ends. Number and negation edits cause 21.9-25.7 percentage-point losses, versus 1.4-2.9 points for control edits. Detailed task-role labels improve source-grouped ROC-AUC from 0.73 to 0.78 over binary criticality, showing that downstream impact depends strongly on the task role affected.

</details>


### [545] [Decouple to Forget: Semantic Mediation for Sensitive Unlearning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17654)
*Jingyue Cong,Andy Song,Yang Yu,Tabinda Sarwar,Xinshu Li,Ziqi Xu,Xun Yi,Ke Wang,Bo Han,Estrid He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: D2F 提出基于语义中介的细粒度遗忘方法，将敏感事实从非敏感意义与表层表达中解耦，仅删除敏感事实部分，从而在遗忘与通用能力保留之间取得更好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型遗忘方法以整条回复为遗忘单位，粒度太粗；当遗忘目标只是嵌入在良性解释中的少量敏感事实时，会造成不必要的通用能力损失。

Method: 为每个待遗忘样本从答案中抽取事实级“中介”表示，识别敏感部分并仅移除该部分，保持其余结构完整；据此生成以中介为基础的反事实答案，保留非敏感内容、排除敏感事实，并采用基于偏好的对比优化降低信息泄露概率，同时维持有用性与流畅度。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验显示，D2F 在遗忘与保留之间取得了优于强基线方法的平衡。

Conclusion: 细粒度、事实级的解耦式遗忘能够有效减少敏感事实泄露，同时更好地保留模型的通用能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models seeks to remove specified knowledge while preserving general capability, yet current methods often treat an entire response as the unit of forgetting. This coarse granularity causes unnecessary utility loss when the forget target is only a small set of sensitive facts embedded within otherwise benign explanations. In this paper, we introduce Decouple to Forget (D2F), a targeted unlearning method inspired by semantic mediation that separates sensitive factual content from non-sensitive meaning and surface expression. For each example to be forgotten, D2F extracts a fact-level "mediator" representation from the answer, identifies which parts are sensitive, and removes only those parts while leaving the rest of the structure intact. We then generate counterfactual answers grounded in this mediator that preserve non-sensitive content but exclude sensitive facts, employing preference-based contrastive optimization to reduce the likelihood of information leakage while maintaining helpfulness and fluency. Experiments across various benchmark datasets show that D2F achieves a better balance between forgetting and retention than strong baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/JingyueCong/D2F.

</details>


### [546] [Worth Their Weights? Evaluating Generative Models for Discourse Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17658)
*Luke Gessler,Amir Zeldes*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究修辞结构理论（RST）句法分析应被视为生成任务还是判别任务，发现同等参数量下判别模型明显更优，但超大型生成模型有时可超越判别模型，且在基本语篇单元（EDU）切分上生成模型具有独特优势，并在RST-DT基准上取得端到端解析与切分的新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RST解析历来以基于预训练编码器（encoder-only）语言模型的判别式模型为主导；随着高质量生成式语言模型的普及，研究者不清楚RST解析是否更适合作为生成任务来处理，因此需要系统比较两类方法的优劣。

Method: 在控制参数量可比的条件下，对比生成式语言模型与判别式模型在RST解析任务上的表现，并分别考察基本语篇单元（EDU）切分与端到端解析，同时在RST-DT基准上进行实验评估。

Result: 在参数量匹配时，判别式解析器表现远优于生成式模型；但规模大得多的生成式模型有时能够超越判别式模型；生成式模型在EDU切分上具有特别优势，并在RST-DT端到端解析与切分任务上刷新了SOTA结果。

Conclusion: 判别式方法在参数量相当时仍是RST解析的更优选择，生成式方法的优势主要体现在大规模模型及EDU切分场景；结合二者特点可推动RST解析性能进一步提升。

Abstract: Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST) parsing has historically been dominated by discriminative models based on pretrained encoder-only language models. The recent availability of high-quality generative language models has made it unclear whether RST parsing is better approached as a generative task. In this work, we investigate whether generative language models are better at parsing RST than traditional discriminative ones. We find that at matched parameter counts, discriminative parsers perform much better than generative ones, though much larger generative models sometimes outperform them. Generative models hold a particular advantage in elementary discourse unit (EDU) segmentation, and we report new state-of-the-art results on the RST-DT benchmark in end-to-end parsing as well as segmentation.

</details>


### [547] [The Image Still Has a Say: Final-Answer Repair for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17663)
*Yulan Pan,Xiaoyu Xu,Zhihong Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练的Text-to-Visual Evidence Reallocation (TVER)方法，在推理链固定的情况下，利用图像对最终答案进行修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态思维链推理虽提升了推理能力，但推理过程容易偏离图像，导致最终答案错误；且推理链在生成答案时已固定，无法自我纠正。鉴于最终答案阶段图像仍可用，作者认为在不重写推理链的前提下修复最终答案更合理。

Method: 基于"错误选项会在推理中过早固化，而正确选项在中深层仍具更强图像支持"的发现，提出TVER：选择与答案相关的文本和与问题匹配的图像块，将受限的注意力从文本转移到图像块；图像块在中深层窗口内依据问题相关性选取。

Result: 在多个基准和骨干网络上均提升了答案准确率，在多项选择和开放问答评测中均取得增益。

Conclusion: 在推理链固定的条件下，通过文本到视觉证据的注意力重分配可有效修复最终答案，且无需训练，具备良好的通用性。

Abstract: Although chain-of-thought prompting has improved multimodal reasoning, it is still difficult to produce correct final answers, as the reasoning can drift away from the image. Besides, the trace is already fixed when the answer is generated, leaving no room for self-correction. Considering the image is still available at the final-answer step, we think it is reasonable to fix the answer there without rewriting the reasoning. As such, the problem becomes to correct the final answer using the image under fixed reasoning. Unlike methods that improve trace generation through training, resampling, or decoding-time grounding, we repair the final-answer readout while keeping the reasoning trace fixed. The motivation is based on our finding that a wrong option can become prematurely committed in the reasoning while the correct option still has stronger image support in middle-to-deep layers. Thus, we propose Text-to-Visual Evidence Reallocation (TVER), a training-free method for final-answer repair. Specifically, TVER selects answer-related text and question-matched image patches, and moves bounded attention from text to patches. Furthermore, the patches are chosen in a middle-to-deep layer window based on question relevance. Our method improves answers across benchmarks and backbones, with gains in both multiple-choice and open-answer evaluations.

</details>


### [548] [LatentRiskBench: Measuring State-Dependent Risks in Enterprise Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17685)
*Jingyue Cong,Estrid He,Zhuang Li,Nan Wu,Li Shen,Yameng Peng,Xinshu Li,Andy Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LatentRiskBench基准，评估企业智能体工作流状态依赖的安全风险，动作级评估仅检出0.09违规，状态级评估达0.96。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业智能体存在无法从单个动作判断的安全风险：同一动作在不同工作流状态下可能安全、也可能违规。现有安全基准多评估动作局部风险，忽略了依赖工作流状态的失败模式。

Method: 构建LatentRiskBench：将风险轨迹与良性轨迹配对，二者终端动作相同但潜在的政策相关状态不同，要求模型重建工作流上下文而非依赖动作级线索；并提出新的状态依赖风险评估指标，包括一组残差风险（RR）度量。

Result: 实验显示动作级评估仅能检出0.09的状态依赖违规，而状态级评估达到0.96；现有防护方法若不显式应用于工作流状态，基本无法覆盖此类风险；某商业部署场景的案例研究进一步表明该基准的安全指标更贴近企业智能体的真实安全状况。

Conclusion: 安全评估需从动作级转向状态级，该基准与指标为企业智能体的状态依赖风险提供了更现实的评估手段，数据和代码已开源。

Abstract: Enterprise agents face safety risks that cannot be determined from individual actions alone. Existing safety benchmarks largely evaluate action-local risks, overlooking failures whose safety depends on workflow state. In such state-dependent risks, the same action may be safe in one context but violate policy in another. Hence, we introduce LatentRiskBench for evaluating such state-dependent risks in enterprise settings. It pairs risky trajectories with benign counterparts that share the same terminal action but differ in latent policy-relevant states, requiring models to reconstruct workflow context rather than rely on action-level cues. We also introduce new metrics for state-dependent risk evaluation, including a suite of residual risk (RR) measures. Experiments on the benchmark show that action-level evaluation detects only 0.09 of state-dependent violations, whereas state-level evaluation reaches 0.96. Existing guardrail methods largely overlook such risks unless they are explicitly applied to workflow states. Case studies on a commercial deployed scenario further show that the safety metrics embedded in the benchmark provide a more realistic measure of safety for enterprise agents. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/JingyueCong/LatentRiskBench.

</details>


### [549] [Encoding Context into LLM Weights: What Makes It Context?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17686)
*Yue Wang,Qizhou Wang,Feng Liu,Gang Niu,Masashi Sugiyama,Bo Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过给上下文分配标识符并结合提示框架，让模型把测试时权重更新编码的信息当作上下文使用，优于仅用现成LLM的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文能提升LLM预测质量，但推理成本随上下文长度急剧增长。用测试时权重更新将上下文编码为临时权重变化是一种替代方案，但这样会把上下文信息混入已有的通用知识中，模糊其"上下文"角色，导致模型无法正确利用它来条件化后续推理。

Method: 第一步：在编码时为每个上下文关联一个标识符，将新编码的信息与既有知识区分开，推理时调用该标识符即可让LLM复述已编码的上下文。第二步：由于成功复述并不保证模型会将其作为上下文使用，进一步引入一个提示框架，显式引导LLM把召回的信息当作上下文来使用。

Result: 在多种受控任务和实际基准测试上，该方法优于仅使用现成LLM的基线，显示出在上下文编码方面的进步。

Conclusion: 通过标识符区分编码信息与预训练知识，并配合显式提示引导，可恢复测试时权重更新所编码信息的"上下文"角色，从而提升LLM的上下文利用效果。

Abstract: Longer contexts allow large language models (LLMs) to condition their predictions on more information, but inference costs grow prohibitively with context length. An emerging alternative uses test-time updates to encode context as temporary changes to model weights. However, encoding this information into weights that already represent general knowledge obscures its role as context, so the LLM may fail to use it properly to condition subsequent inference. To restore this contextual role, we first associate each context with an identifier during encoding, thereby distinguishing the newly encoded information from pre-existing knowledge. Invoking the identifier at inference then enables the LLM to recite the encoded context. Nevertheless, successful recitation does not ensure that the LLM will use the recalled information as context. We therefore further introduce a prompting framework that explicitly guides the LLM to use this information as context. Across diverse controlled tasks and practical benchmarks, our method outperformed the baseline using only off-the-shelf LLMs, showing its advances in context encoding.

</details>


### [550] [Pushback in a Haystack: Language Models Respond to Factual Errors Ambiguously and Ineffectively](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17703)
*Li Lucy,Myra Cheng,Svenja Guhr,Kabir Ahuja,Orevaoghene Ahia,Sameep Chattopadhyay,Yike Wang,Valentin Hofmann,Noah A. Smith,Yulia Tsvetkov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出短语级、经人工验证的回应标注框架，揭示语言模型"反驳"用户错误输入时的表达方式差异，并发现隐晦、混合肯定式反驳可能无法纠正用户的事实误解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注语言模型是否存在谄媚（即是否敢于反驳错误输入），但作者指出，即便模型做出了反驳，谄媚问题并未真正解决——反驳的方式同样影响其纠正用户信念的效果，因此需要更细粒度的分析。

Method: 提出短语级、经人工验证的回应标注框架，用以刻画模型如何反驳或肯定错误输入；将该框架应用于英语、德语、中文、印地语和约鲁巴语五种语言的模型回应，并开展大规模人类研究（n=300）检验反驳方式的实际效果。

Result: 模型在反驳用户错误断言时倾向于使用间接措辞并夹杂肯定表述；印地语和约鲁巴语中的间接程度高于其他语言；大规模人类研究显示，这种反驳的模糊性可能无法纠正和预防用户的事实性误解。

Conclusion: 仅仅"敢于反驳"并不意味着谄媚问题已解决；反驳的表达方式（间接性与混合肯定）会削弱其纠错效果，且存在跨语言差异，提示需从回应措辞层面重新审视模型的纠错能力。

Abstract: The sycophancy of language models, or their failure to push back against faulty user input, is now widely studied. However, if LMs do push back, is sycophancy solved? We show that LMs vary in how they present pushback, and thus vary in how effectively they correct user beliefs. We introduce a phrase-level, human-validated response labeling framework to uncover fine-grained insights into how LMs push against and/or affirm false inputs. We develop and apply our framework on model responses in five languages: English, German, Chinese, Hindi, and Yoruba. We find that when models do push back against users' false assertions, they tend to use indirect phrasing and mix in affirmation, with more indirectness in Hindi and Yoruba than in other languages considered. In a large-scale human study (n = 300), we find that the pushback ambiguity we identified may fail to correct and prevent users' factual misconceptions.

</details>


### [551] [Understanding Machine Taste: Aesthetic Agreement Across Foundation Models in K-pop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17731)
*Kaishen Wang,Yucheng Pan,Xuehao Cui,Hanling Tian,Heng Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究以K-pop歌曲和音乐视频为测试平台，将美学评估建模为成对排序问题，刻画基础模型的“机器品味”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基础模型进入创意产业，理解其审美偏好成为实现AI辅助创意决策的重要一步。

Method: 将美学评估形式化为成对排序问题，考察模型间成对一致性、群体层面共识以及跨模态偏好对齐，并用YouTube历史观看数据检验视觉共识排名与真实流行度的关系。

Result: 视觉评估中的模型间成对一致性和群体共识强于音频评估；两种模态间的偏好对齐较弱；视觉共识排名与真实流行度呈正相关但相关程度因艺人群体而异。

Conclusion: 研究初步揭示了机器审美偏好，为兼顾创意内容、艺人身份、受众偏好与市场动态的AI辅助创意决策奠定基础。

Abstract: As foundation models enter creative industries, understanding their aesthetic preferences becomes an important step toward AI-assisted creative decision making. In this work, we investigate how foundation models evaluate creative content and characterize their ``machine taste'' using K-pop songs and music videos as a testbed. We formulate aesthetic evaluation as a pairwise ranking problem and systematically examine pairwise inter-model agreement, group-level consensus, and cross-modal preference alignment. Our results reveal stronger pairwise inter-model agreement and group-level consensus in visual evaluation than in audio evaluation, while preferences across the two modalities remain weakly aligned. We further examine how visual consensus rankings relate to real-world popularity using historical YouTube viewership data, finding positive but varying correlations across artist groups. These findings provide initial insights into machine aesthetic preferences and lay the groundwork for future AI-assisted creative decision making that considers creative content, artist identity, audience preferences, and market dynamics.

</details>


### [552] [Geometric Structure Predicts Per-Example Neighborhood Loss Under PCA Truncation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17742)
*Sriram Loganathan,Gokul Anand,Ragavan Arivazhagan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 降维能保留文本嵌入的平均性能，但会掩盖样本级别的差异。本文研究PCA截断下逐样本邻域稳定性，发现邻域保留率因样本而异，且可由嵌入的几何性质及其与保留子空间的对齐程度预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有降维研究多以聚合指标衡量性能，无法揭示退化是否在所有样本上均匀分布。作者希望探究逐样本的邻域稳定性差异，并寻找可预测这种差异的几何因素。

Method: 在静态词嵌入与现代句编码器上，对PCA截断后的逐样本邻域保留率进行统计分析，考察中心化向量能量保留率、邻域对比度、局部密度、局部内在维度等几何量与邻域保留的关联，并在SciFact与NFCorpus检索任务上检验密度对压缩退化的预测能力。

Result: 逐样本邻域保留率差异很大且可预测。截断子空间保留的中心化向量能量对CBOW和RI预测最强，邻域对比度在SkipGram及现代/Matryoshka设置中最强（GTE近乎并列）。局部密度在边际分析中与保留相关，但在控制能量与对比度后增量很小（R²增量0.001–0.010）。现代句编码器上局部内在维度的解释力强于密度。SciFact上查询密度可预测激进压缩下的检索退化，NFCorpus上32d主关联未能复现，直接方差限制检验未能解决该零结果。

Conclusion: 平均压缩性能掩盖了系统性的逐样本差异，而几何性质使这种差异变得可见。逐样本视角对理解降维影响具有重要意义。

Abstract: Dimensionality reduction can preserve the average performance of text embeddings even when a substantial fraction of their dimensions is removed. Aggregate metrics, however, do not reveal whether degradation is distributed uniformly across examples. We study per-example neighborhood stability under PCA truncation across static word embeddings and modern sentence encoders. Per-item neighbor retention varies widely and is predictable from geometric properties of the representation and its alignment with the retained PCA subspace. The fraction of centered-vector energy retained by the truncated subspace is strongest for CBOW and RI, with neighborhood contrast leading on SkipGram and the modern/Matryoshka settings (GTE approximately tied), while local density is associated with retention in marginal analysis but adds little unique information once energy and contrast are controlled (R-squared increments 0.001 to 0.010). Local intrinsic dimensionality accounts for more variation than density on modern sentence encoders in pairwise comparison. On SciFact, query density predicts retrieval degradation under aggressive compression; on NFCorpus the primary 32d association does not replicate, and a direct variance-restriction test leaves that null unresolved. Average compression performance conceals systematic per-example variation that geometry makes visible.

</details>


### [553] [Auditing Failure Attribution: Label Predictability and Judge Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17747)
*Tianyang Xu,Jing Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出四种测试（输入限制、线索跟随、残差准确率、聚合）来区分失败归因评测中LLM判官是真正进行了跨步骤检查，还是仅利用了表面线索，并呼吁在开发此类基准时报告这些测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 失败归因基准通常要求LLM判官判断哪一步或哪个智能体导致了失败，高分本应意味着判官对出错步骤与整个运行过程做了跨步骤检查。但能预测标注的表面线索会产生虚高分。作者希望提供方法将"检查"与"线索利用"分离，并通过真实观察来证明这种区分的必要性。

Method: 提出四种测试：①输入限制——部分输入是否能预测标注；②线索跟随——移动线索后答案是否变化；③残差准确率——在仅靠线索的预测器失败之处评估判官；④聚合——失败混合或度量的改变是否导致排名变化。

Result: 在三个基准上，简单预测器可与GPT-4.1持平或更优。在Who&When Pro的两个系统中，仅读取单步推理的分类器能识别95-100%的错误步骤；其中一个系统中错误注入后出错步骤之后无推理，基于其标签微调的判官比GPT-4.1高41分；在该步骤后加入任务相关推理会移动线索，微调判官下降31-99分，而零样本判官最多下降9分。在Aegis上，归咎所有智能体在micro-F1上与GPT-4.1持平，但在精确集合准确率上落后19分。

Conclusion: 研究者建议在开发失败归因基准时报告这四种测试，以揭示高分是否来自真实的跨步骤检查而非表面线索。

Abstract: Failure-attribution benchmarks ask an LLM judge which step or agent caused a failure. A high score should mean the judge checked the faulty step against the run (a cross-step check). However, spurious signals (surface cues) that predict the annotation can produce a high score. In this paper, we propose four tests to separate checking from cue use. Input restriction asks whether partial input predicts the annotation. Cue following checks whether moved cues change answers. Residual accuracy scores judges where cue-only predictors fail. Aggregation asks whether the failure mix or metric changes rankings. Real observations motivate these tests: on three benchmarks, simple predictors match or beat GPT-4.1. In two Who&When Pro systems, a classifier reading one step's reasoning finds 95-100% of faulty steps, motivating input restriction. In one of them, error injection leaves no reasoning after the faulty step; judges fine-tuned on its labels beat GPT-4.1 by 41 points. Adding task-related reasoning after that step moves this cue: fine-tuned judges lose 31-99 points, but zero-shot judges lose at most 9, motivating cue following. On Aegis, blaming every agent matches GPT-4.1 on micro-F1 but trails by 19 points in exact-set accuracy, motivating aggregation. We recommend reporting these tests when developing failure-attribution benchmarks.

</details>


### [554] [Connecting the Dots: Enduring Performance Gaps in ASR Systems Between Standard and Minority English Varieties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17761)
*Alexander Metzger,Aruna Srivastava,Ruslan Mukhamedvaleev,Eunjung Yeo,Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed,Nina Markl,Sachin Kumar,Farhan Samir*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过跨2021-2025年16个主流ASR系统、8个英语口音数据集的纵向评测，质疑"更大更通用的模型会自然修复口音性能差距"的假设，发现主流美式英语（MUSE）与少数口音之间的性能差距顽固存在，且少数口音在代际更新中可能出现高达65%绝对词错误率的恶化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ASR评测长期显示种族、性别、社会经济地位和语言变体上的性能差异，但学界常隐含或显式地假设后续更大、更通用的模型会自动纠正这些差异。作者希望检验这一"持续进步"的假设是否成立。

Method: 对2021至2025年间发布的16个代表性ASR系统进行纵向评测，覆盖8个代表不同英语口音变体的数据集，比较MUSE与少数口音之间的性能差距随时间的变化趋势。

Result: 系统在MUSE上表现稳定可靠，但少数口音面临代际间大幅性能退化的风险，词错误率有时绝对恶化达65%；MUSE与少数口音之间的性能差距顽固存在，并未随时间的推移可靠下降。

Conclusion: 标准ASR基准实际上实施了一种隐性的语言政策，优待主流美式英语变体。因此，这些性能差异反映了语言技术开发基础设施的系统性失败，对代表性不足的说话者群体造成不成比例的影响。

Abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) system evaluations have consistently revealed performance disparities along lines of race, gender, socioeconomic status, and language variety. While these disparities are well-documented, they are often (implicitly or explicitly) treated as issues that subsequent, larger, and more universal models will correct. We challenge this assumption of steady progress in reducing accent-related performance disparities, conducting a longitudinal evaluation of 16 prominent systems released between 2021-2025 across 8 datasets representing diverse English accent varieties. We find that the performance disparity between Mainstream US English (MUSE) and minority accents is stubborn, not reliably declining as a function of time. Specifically, while systems are reliably performant on MUSE, minority accents are subject to risks of large performance degradations between generations of systems, sometimes worsening by 65% absolute Word Error Rate. We argue that standard ASR benchmarks enact an implicit language policy privileging Mainstream US English varieties. As such, these performance disparities reflect systemic failures of language technology development infrastructure that disproportionately affect underrepresented speaker populations.

</details>


### [555] [Efficiently Learning To Reason or Not to Reason: Root-token Policy Optimization for Adaptive Thinking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17767)
*Taehyeon Kim,Hyunsoo Lee,Youngsoo Jang,Moontae Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RPO通过仅训练根Token（如是否触发<think>标签）来实现大推理模型的自适应推理，大幅降低训练开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在产生答案前会外显推理轨迹，但存在"过度思考"问题，对难度不同的查询均匀分配重计算。专有模型通过不透明的路由机制缓解，而开源LRMs因训练成本高昂和训练配方披露有限，缺乏内化自适应推理的高效机制。

Method: 提出RPO（Root-token Policy Optimization）框架，通过组相对奖励和组内优势，仅训练初始的根Token（例如是否调用<think>标签），让LRMs自行决定何时进行推理。聚焦于这一关键分支点，从而显著降低训练开销和显存占用。

Result: 在多个模型系列和规模上，RPO学习到难度感知的自适应思考能力，训练计算量仅为先前自适应推理方法的约2%。

Conclusion: RPO为开源LRMs提供了一种低成本、高效的自适应推理内化方案，通过只优化根Token这一关键分支点，实现了难度感知的推理决策。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by externalizing explicit reasoning traces before producing the answer, yet suffer from overthinking challenge that allocates uniformly heavy computation to queries of varying difficulty. While proprietary models mitigate this via opaque routing, open-source LRMs still lack an efficient mechanism to internalize adaptive reasoning due to both expensive training cost and limited disclosure of training recipes. In response, we introduce RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization), a framework that enables LRMs to self-determine when to reason by training only the initial root token (e.g., whether to invoke the <think> tag) via group relative reward and group-wise advantages. By focusing on this pivotal branching point, RPO drastically reduces training overhead and VRAM usage. Across multiple model families and scales, RPO learns difficulty-aware adaptive thinking at just ~2% of the training compute of prior adaptive-reasoning methods.

</details>


### [556] [Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17771)
*Xin Li,Hao Jiang,Jinghao Guo,Weisi Lin,Chau Yuen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 ReMaRk，用所有回复标题的并集对每个推荐列表统一打分，并按请求等概率采样，替代 Rank-GRPO 的逐回复奖励，使 RL 训练更省算力且效果不劣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Reddit 推荐请求常收到多个命名不同标题的回复；用 RL 训练 LLM 推荐器时，Rank-GRPO 每个样本只选一个回复，导致优势函数约 85% 的方差只反映抽到了哪个回复，而非列表本身的好坏。

Method: 提出 ReMaRk：针对请求而非单个答案进行训练，将生成列表与所有回复标题的并集统一评分一次，并对每个请求等概率采样。

Result: 在 7 个骨干模型和 3 个数据集上，ReMaRk 用 25%–53% 的步数即达到 2000 步逐回复 RL 的验证召回率并在该预算下领先；训练至收敛时从未显著落后 Rank-GRPO，7 对中有 4 对用更少 GPU 时长达其最佳效果。相同奖励在约 100 人作答的 ProtoQA 上也有效。

Conclusion: 对存在多个有效人类答案的 RL 场景，应联合奖励这些答案，即“一起奖励”，可简化为通用规则并提升训练效率。

Abstract: A recommendation request on Reddit draws several replies, each naming different titles. When an LLM recommender is trained on such threads with reinforcement learning (RL), which replies should a generated list be rewarded against? The state-of-the-art recipe, Rank-GRPO, picks one reply per training example, so the advantage mostly records which reply was drawn (85% of its variance) rather than how good the list is. We argue that RL should train on the request, not on each answer, and propose ReMaRk: it scores every list once against the union of all replies' titles and samples each request equally. This makes RL cheaper. On seven backbones and three datasets, ReMaRk reaches the validation recall of 2,000 per-reply RL steps in 25 to 53% of the steps and leads at that budget; trained until neither improves, it is never significantly behind Rank-GRPO and in four of seven pairs reaches Rank-GRPO's best with fewer GPU-hours. The same reward helps on ProtoQA, where about 100 people answer each question, which points to a simple rule for RL with several valid human answers: reward them jointly.

</details>


### [557] [Beyond Belief Nesting: Rethinking Higher-Order Theory of Mind in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17777)
*Shanshan You,Zhengqi Wang,Hao Liu,Yuqin Liu,Ya He,Xin Hao,Liyuan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出既有高阶心智理论评测存在"阶数虚高"，提出认证全阶问题集HopToM与推理时方法HopTrace，显著提升高阶视角推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心智理论（ToM）是有效沟通与协作的基础，其高阶形式支持在策略互动中对嵌套视角进行推理。但现有评测常把"信念嵌套深度"等同于"推理阶数"，使名义上的高阶问题可被低阶捷径解答，导致高阶ToM能力被高估，因此需要重新形式化"有效阶数"并构建严格评测。

Method: 其一，通过支撑连续信念前缀的"不同事件"来形式化有效阶数，揭示现有基准中普遍存在的阶数虚高问题；其二，构建HopToM数据集，包含经认证的全阶问题及针对低阶替代方案的控制项；其三，提出HopTrace，一种即插即用的推理时方法，将每次交互一次性编码为视角记录，并以确定性方式解析嵌套查询；其四，结合直接提示实验、人类被试实验与因果干预分析。

Result: 直接提示下，四款前沿大模型平均准确率由一阶的73.5%降至四阶的20.0%，人类被试同样表现困难；因果干预表明一类反复出现的错误与较浅信念前缀的证据相关；在认证叙事问题上，HopTrace相较强提示基线将四阶和五阶准确率分别提升22.0与38.5个百分点，且比多次调用方法少用20–39倍token。

Conclusion: 研究厘清了高阶心智理论的评测方式，指出阶数虚高带来的高估风险，并提供HopTrace这一实用方案以提升交互智能体的视角推理能力。

Abstract: Theory of mind (ToM), the ability to reason about others' mental states, underlies effective communication and coordination. Its higher-order form enables reasoning over nested perspectives in strategic interactions. However, existing evaluations often equate belief-nesting depth with reasoning order, allowing nominally higher-order questions to admit lower-order shortcuts. We formalize effective order through the distinct events supporting successive belief prefixes, revealing widespread order inflation across existing benchmarks. We introduce HopToM, with certified full-order questions and controls for lower-order alternatives. Under direct prompting, mean accuracy across four frontier LLMs falls from 73.5% at first order to 20.0% at fourth order, and human participants also struggle. Causal interventions link a recurring class of errors to evidence for shallower belief prefixes. We introduce HopTrace, a plug-and-play inference-time method that encodes each interaction once into perspective records and resolves nested queries deterministically. On certified narrative questions, it improves fourth- and fifth-order accuracy by 22.0 and 38.5 percentage points over strong prompting baselines, while using 20-39 times fewer tokens than multi-call methods. These results sharpen how higher-order ToM is evaluated and offer a practical way to improve perspective reasoning in interactive agents.

</details>


### [558] [GENDIS: Gender-Related Discourse and Stance in Multilingual YouTube Comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17778)
*Luise Koch,Manuel Tonneau,Niyati Malhotra,Sunny Rai,Ana Maria Munoz Boudet,Victor Orozco-Olvera,Samuel P. Fraiberger,Sharath Chandra Guntuku*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出GENDIS数据集，包含来自印度、肯尼亚和尼日利亚的9600条多语言、人工标注的YouTube评论，通过两级框架（先判断是否涉及性别，再分类为负面、正面或中性），打破以往以危害为中心的研究局限，实现性别相关话语的普遍性估计与评价范围刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有性别相关网络内容研究多采用以危害为中心的任务，将非危害性的性别相关内容和无关内容混为一谈，且数据集集中于高资源语言和全球北方地区。为填补这些空白，需要构建一个扎根于全球南方、多语言、能区分"是否涉及性别"与"评价倾向"的资源。

Method: 构建GENDIS数据集：采集印度、肯尼亚、尼日利亚各3200条（共9600条）多语言YouTube评论并进行人工标注；采用两级标注框架，第一步识别是否提及性别，第二步将性别相关内容分类为负面、正面或中性；同时对比轻量监督分类器、前沿零样本大语言模型及通用毒性检测模型。

Result: 在均匀随机层中，23.8%-35.0%的评论涉及性别，其中立场已明确的部分有82%为中性或正面。各模型中，性别提及检测明显易于立场分类，尤其对正面和中性言论。轻量监督分类器以显著更低的成本达到与前沿零样本大语言模型相当的效果，并优于通用毒性检测；跨国家迁移能力仍然有限。

Conclusion: GENDIS提供了一个本地化扎根的资源，可用于衡量网络中性别何时被提及以及该提及如何被框定，为超越危害中心范式、开展性别相关话语的普遍性与评价性研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Research on gender-related online content is often operationalized through harm-centered tasks that collapse non-harmful gender-related and unrelated content, while existing datasets remain concentrated in high-resource languages and Global North settings. To bridge these gaps, we introduce GENDIS, a dataset of 9,600 multilingual, human-annotated YouTube comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria (3,200 per country), annotated using a two-level framework that first identifies whether gender is referenced and then classifies gender-related content as negative, positive, or neutral. This separation provides a denominator for gender-related discourse independent of harm, enabling both prevalence estimation and characterization of its evaluative range. In the uniform random stratum, 23.8-35.0% of comments are gender-related, and among those with a resolved stance, 82% are neutral or positive. Across models, gender-reference detection is substantially easier than stance classification, especially for positive and neutral speech. Lightly supervised classifiers match frontier zero-shot large language models at substantially lower cost and outperform generic toxicity detection, while cross-country transfer remains limited. GENDIS provides a locally grounded resource for measuring when gender is invoked online and how that reference is framed.

</details>


### [559] [Full-duplex Spoken Language Modeling with Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17780)
*Chen Chen,Pin-Jui Ku,Ankita Pasad,Ante Jukić,Zhehuai Chen,Boris Ginsburg*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Diffuplex 提出一种基于离散扩散的全双工语音语言模型，通过在训练层面解耦“何时说”与“说什么”，并用 AR 交互策略跟踪用户语音、并行扩散生成回应，在语言智能与响应效率间取得前所未有的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全双工语音模型在语言智能与响应效率之间存在权衡：自回归模型解码速度受限，而全双工模型虽低延迟但智能性较弱。作者希望打破这种“压缩到单一自回归时间线”的限制，使智能与响应性能够同时提升。

Method: 提出 Diffuplex，一种基于离散扩散的全双工口语语言模型。训练层面将“何时说”（交互策略）与“说什么”（内容生成）分离；推理时用自回归交互策略持续跟踪用户语音，同时通过并行扩散独立生成并精炼回应内容，使语义计算不再受感知音频帧率约束。

Result: 开启思考模式时，Diffuplex 每次前向传播输出 13.0 个 token，平均达 1872 tokens/秒，解码速度大幅超越前沿自回归模型；不开启思考时，其首音频延迟与现有全双工模型相当，同时语言智能明显更强。

Conclusion: Diffuplex 为口语智能体确立了新范式：在维持实时对话的同时，将并行计算用于智能回应生成，实现智能与响应性的同步提升。训练代码与检查点即将发布。

Abstract: We introduce Diffuplex, a full-duplex spoken language model based on discrete diffusion that achieves an unprecedented balance between linguistic intelligence and response efficiency. With thinking mode, Diffuplex delivers 13.0 tokens per forward pass, reaching an average of 1872 tokens per second and substantially surpassing the frontier autoregressive (AR) models in decoding speed. Without thinking, Diffuplex matches the first-audio latency of existing full-duplex models while achieving markedly stronger linguistic intelligence. This capability is enabled by separating when to say from what to say at the training level, rather than compressing both into a single autoregressive timeline. During inference, Diffuplex continuously tracks the user speech through an AR interaction policy, while independently generating and refining response content through parallel diffusion. Consequently, semantic computation is no longer bounded by the perception audio frame rate, allowing intelligence and responsiveness to improve simultaneously. Taken together, these results establish a new paradigm for spoken agents that can sustain real-time dialogue while devoting parallel computation to intelligent response generation. Training code and checkpoints will be avaliable soon.

</details>


### [560] [Where Words Begin and End](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17782)
*Husein Zolkepli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对比九种强制对齐器并发现CTC对齐器普遍存在插入停顿、词起点偏晚的问题，且缺乏电话语音评测。作者用LoRA微调Whisper以时间戳token预测词边界（47小时、87种语言的人工边界数据），新模型在英语各测试条件下优于MFA，词边界误差11.6 ms（TIMIT），真实固话通话达16.0 ms（MFA为36.5 ms）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强制对齐器广泛用于语音流水线，但作者发现常用的CTC对齐器几乎在每个词边界插入停顿，且几乎没有对齐器在电话语音上做过评测，缺乏对真实通话场景的性能认识。

Method: 1) 在朗读、对话和电话英语上，将九种对齐器配置与人工词边界对比；2) 用LoRA微调Whisper，将每个词的起止作为时间戳token预测，仅使用人工标注的边界（47小时、87种语言）；3) 在FA-Bench协议与代码下于TIMIT评测，并考察时间戳槽位位置与噪声转写训练的影响。

Result: MFA最精确；CTC对齐器因词内多数帧被判为blank而系统性延迟词起点。新对齐器在全部英语测试条件下优于MFA，也优于MFA的韩语和荷兰语模型。TIMIT词边界误差11.6 ms（最佳已发表系统18.2 ms）；真实固话通话16.0 ms（MFA 36.5 ms）。

Conclusion: 将时间戳槽位置于所计时的词之后、并用噪声转写训练，是电话对话场景最关键的两个设计选择，后者还使对齐器对转写错误近乎不敏感。模型已发布。

Abstract: Forced aligners locate each word of a known transcript in the audio, and many speech pipelines depend on them. In our own data, a widely used CTC aligner inserts a pause at nearly every word boundary, and we found almost no aligner evaluated on telephone audio. We compare nine aligner configurations against human word boundaries on read, conversational and telephone English. The Montreal Forced Aligner (MFA) is the most precise, while CTC aligners consistently start words late, because most frames inside a word go to the blank token. We then fine-tune Whisper with LoRA to predict each word's start and end as timestamp tokens, training only on boundaries placed by people: 47 hours in 87 languages. The resulting aligner is more precise than MFA on every English test condition, and than MFA's own Korean and Dutch models. With FA-Bench's protocol and code on TIMIT, its word-boundary error is 11.6 ms, against 18.2 ms for the best published system. Two choices matter most on telephone conversations: placing the timestamp slots after the word they time, and training on noisy transcripts, which also makes the aligner nearly insensitive to errors in the transcript. The released model reaches 16.0 ms on real landline calls, against 36.5 ms for MFA. The models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/force-alignment

</details>


### [561] [BRIDGE: Selective Boundary Repair with Dependency Graph Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17805)
*Encheng Su,Pengze Li,Ziheng Hua,Qiucheng Yu,Jianyu Wu,Chen Tang,Yizhou Wang,Lintao Wang,Junjia Xiang,Xinzhu Ma,Xi Chen,Shixiang Tang,Houqiang Li,Xi Chen,Aoran Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种可验证的运行时控制框架，通过显式依赖图对多智能体协作中的“交接断裂”进行选择性修复，在多项基准上显著提升任务成功率且开销极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体协作是应对复杂长时程任务的关键范式，但智能体间协作接口处的系统性故障仍是普遍瓶颈。协作流程中常出现“交接断裂”：关键任务上下文被遗漏、误路由或被忽视，而各智能体自身输出却局部看似合理。现有协调协议虽不断进步，却未能有效解决这一接口层面的系统性问题。

Method: 将交接修复视为对显式依赖图的选择性干预，构建可验证的运行时控制框架。核心是故障归因与校准流水线，通过解耦执行依赖并注入反事实交接扰动，为运行时干预提供经验监督。框架将可观测的交互轨迹动态编译为溯源图以定位未解决依赖，无需访问智能体私有状态；随后通过经验门控评估候选修复的预期收益与干扰风险，仅在形式化局部后置条件成立时执行修复。

Result: 在多个高要求基准上，任务成功率在 SILO-BENCH 上最高提升 12.3 个百分点，在 TeamBench 上提升 11.1 个百分点；两种骨干模型下均保持严格成本效益，边际 token 开销低至 2.0%。在 MAST 基准的 562 条交接相关轨迹上，单次通过即达到 69.8% F1。

Conclusion: 该工作为可验证的协作修复建立了可靠的运行边界，表明以依赖图为核心的选择性运行时干预能有效缓解交接断裂，在保证低开销的同时提升多智能体系统的整体任务成功率。

Abstract: Multi-agent collaboration has emerged as a critical paradigm for tackling complex, long-horizon tasks; however, while coordination protocols continue to advance, systemic failures at the inter-agent collaboration interface remain a pervasive bottleneck. In collaborative workflows, systems frequently suffer from \emph{broken handoffs}---where critical task context is omitted, misrouted, or ignored despite each agent emitting locally plausible responses. To address this challenge, we present \method, a verifiable runtime control framework that treats handoff repair as selective intervention over explicit dependency graphs. Central to \method is an integrated fault-attribution and calibration pipeline, \dataset, which decouples execution dependencies and injects counterfactual handoff perturbations to provide empirical supervision for runtime intervention. Leveraging this diagnostic foundation, \method dynamically compiles observable interaction traces into a provenance graph to pinpoint unresolved dependencies, without accessing private agent states. It then evaluates candidate repairs through an empirical gate that weighs expected gains against disruption risks, and executes repairs only when formal local postconditions hold. Extensive evaluations across demanding benchmarks demonstrate that \method boosts task success by up to 12.3 absolute percentage points on SILO-BENCH and 11.1 on TeamBench. Across both backbones, \method maintains strict cost-effectiveness, adding as little as 2.0\% marginal token overhead. Furthermore, on 562 handoff-relevant traces from the MAST benchmark, \method achieves 69.8\% F1 in a single pass, establishing a reliable operational boundary for verifiable coordination repair.

</details>


### [562] [Perturbation, Not Provenance: Why Activation Steering Does Not Make a Robust Text Watermark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17810)
*Sergey Pletenev*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文检验用激活空间的语义方向做文本水印的假设。实验中，steering水印在检测准确率上不及标准KGW水印，且其可检测性并非源于语义，而是内容无关的全局偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型激活空间中的线性方向能因果、普遍地影响模型行为，这暗示它们或可作为鲁棒文本水印的基础：即沿特定语义方向引导生成，再通过探测重编码文本的激活来恢复水印。作者希望验证这一假设是否成立。

Method: 沿四个方向（正式度、情感、复杂度、随机对照）进行不同强度的激活引导，覆盖两个模型家族；采用句级和更强的段落级两种改写攻击；并与标准logit-based水印KGW在匹配流畅度（困惑度在原文1.15倍内）下比较检测性能。还检验了随机方向、不同层探测以及表面特征控制的影响。

Result: 匹配流畅度下，面对句级改写器，KGW的AUC为0.81，最佳steering方向仅0.65；面对更强的段落级改写器，两者分别降至0.65和0.59，差距缩小但未反转。在Qwen上两者不可区分，但均接近随机水平。随机方向与有语义方向的可检测性相当，说明信号与语义无关；信号也与探测层和表面特征控制无关。

Conclusion: 语义激活并未编码可定位、可恢复的语义标记，而是一种全局、内容无关的偏移，只有在文本被退化时才能被较强检测到。因此该案例中激活引导不适合作为鲁棒文本水印方案。

Abstract: Linear directions in the activation space of large language models causally and universally influence model behavior. This suggests that they might serve as a basis for a robust text watermark. The idea is to steer the generation along a specific semantic direction and then recover the mark by probing the activations of the re-encoded text. We test this hypothesis by conducting a series of experiments. We vary the strength of the steering and use four different directions (formality, sentiment, complexity, and a random control) across two different model families. We also test two paraphrasing attacks: a sentence-level one and a stronger paragraph-level one. The results show that activation-steering watermarks are outperformed by a standard logit-based watermark (KGW) in terms of detection accuracy. At a matched level of fluency (within 1.15 times the original text's perplexity), KGW achieved an AUC of 0.81 against a sentence-level paraphraser, while the best steering direction only reached 0.65. A stronger paragraph-level paraphraser lowered both (0.65 for KGW and 0.59 for steering), narrowing the gap but not reversing it. On Qwen, it left the two indistinguishable but at near-chance levels for both. We further showed that the detectability provided by steering was not semantic: a random direction was just as detectable as a meaningful one. The signal was independent of which layer was probed and whether a surface feature control was used. We conclude that, in this case, semantic activation does not encode a localized, recoverable semantic mark, but rather a global, content-independent shift that can only be strongly detected when the text is degraded.

</details>


### [563] [Prefilling-dLLM v2: Learned Chunk Routing for Long-Context Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17868)
*Qi Han,Jing Xiong,Ziyuan Zhang,Ngai Wong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Prefilling-dLLM v2，通过继续训练让扩散语言模型用原生掩码 token 进行路由，实现长上下文稀疏注意力，在 RULER 上显著优于 NSA/DSA/SWA 并大幅加速解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型在每个去噪步都对整个上下文做双向注意力，上下文越长单步开销越大；仅在推理时稀疏化无法改变预训练权重，模型从未在运行时所用的稀疏模式下训练过，导致训练与推理不匹配。

Method: 继续训练扩散语言模型，使其用原生掩码 token 路由：在每个 chunk 末尾追加一个 mask，并用学习到的 role offset 标记为路由槽。每四层中，query 保留双向局部窗口以及由该 mask 打分得到的前 K 个 chunk；其余层使用双向滑动窗口。以 Dream-v0-Base-7B 经 YaRN 扩展到 16K 为起点，在相同布局、key 预算和稠密初始化下，与 bidirectional NSA、DSA、SWA 对比，并使用同一 Fast-dLLM 解码器。

Result: 将 YaRN 因子缩放到评测长度后，Prefilling-dLLM v2 在 16K 到 128K 的三个 RULER 任务上均领先其他稀疏方法；128K 时平均准确率比次优稀疏模型 NSA 高 7.4 分，而 DSA 与 SWA 接近零。同长度下解码比全稠密注意力快 172 倍。

Conclusion: 通过在训练中内化稀疏路由模式，Prefilling-dLLM v2 在长上下文扩散语言模型上实现了优于现有稀疏基线（NSA、DSA、SWA）的准确率与显著解码加速。

Abstract: Diffusion language models apply bidirectional attention over the whole context at every denoising step, so a longer context makes each step substantially more expensive. Sparsifying only at inference leaves the pretrained weights unchanged, so the model is never trained under the sparse pattern it runs with. We propose Prefilling-dLLM v2, which continues training a diffusion language model so that it routes with its native mask token. One mask is appended at the end of each chunk, and a learned role offset marks it as a routing slot. On every fourth layer, a query keeps a bidirectional local window and the top-K chunks scored from that mask; the other layers use a bidirectional sliding window. Starting from Dream-v0-Base-7B extended to 16K with YaRN, we compare Prefilling-dLLM v2 with bidirectional NSA, DSA, and SWA under the same layout, key budget, and dense initialization, using the same Fast-dLLM decoder. With the YaRN factor scaled to the evaluation length, Prefilling-dLLM v2 leads the other sparse methods on all three RULER tasks from 16K to 128K. Its mean accuracy at 128K is 7.4 points above NSA, the next sparse model, while DSA and SWA remain near zero. At the same length, decoding is 172x faster than with full dense attention.

</details>


### [564] [Cross-Lingual Transfer of Evil Vectors Is Directionally Asymmetric](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17880)
*Juann Kim,Minku Kang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究测试了LLM中"邪恶人格向量"是否具有跨语言通用性，发现其迁移方向不对称：高资源语言向量可有效迁移到低资源语言，反之则不行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 邪恶人格向量与有害行为、越狱漏洞和有害知识遗忘密切相关，但是否反映真正的跨语言概念（而非提取语言的假象）尚未被验证。

Method: 在两个高资源语言（英语、西班牙语）和两个低资源语言（斯瓦希里语、泰卢固语）上，对四个开源指令微调LLM进行系统性的邪恶向量迁移研究，并结合几何分析（向量对齐度）与MMLU评估通用知识保持情况。

Result: 迁移呈现方向不对称性：低资源语言难以可靠提取邪恶向量，且提取出的向量即使在本语言内也基本无法有效引导；高资源语言提取的向量则可有效迁移到低资源输入，并较好保持MMLU衡量的通用知识。几何上，高资源语言向量彼此高度对齐，低资源向量与该共享方向仅弱对齐。

Conclusion: 存在一个共享的跨语言"邪恶方向"；一旦从高资源语言可靠提取，便可复用于引导低资源语言的行为，无需额外采集各语言数据。

Abstract: Persona vectors are linear directions in the residual-stream activations of LLMs that encode behavioral traits and enable fine-grained control over model behavior. Among them, the evil persona vector is particularly relevant to understanding harmful behavior, jailbreak vulnerabilities, and the unlearning of harmful knowledge. Yet whether this vector reflects a genuinely cross-lingual concept, rather than an artifact of its extraction language, remains untested. We conduct a systematic evil-vector transfer study across two high-resource languages (English, Spanish) and two low-resource languages (Swahili, Telugu) on four open-source instruction-tuned LLMs, and find that transfer is directionally asymmetric. Evil vectors are harder to obtain reliably from low-resource languages, and the resulting vectors are largely ineffective at steering, even within their own language. In contrast, vectors extracted from high-resource languages transfer effectively to low-resource inputs while largely preserving general knowledge, as measured by MMLU. Geometric analysis further supports this pattern: evil vectors from the two high-resource languages are closely aligned, whereas low-resource vectors align only weakly with this shared direction. These results suggest that a shared cross-lingual evil direction exists and, once reliably extracted from a high-resource language, can be reused to steer behavior in low-resource languages without additional per-language data collection.

</details>


### [565] [Swiss4Arg: A Parallel Dataset for Multilingual Argument Mining across Swiss National Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17894)
*Sophia Conrad,Fatma-Zohra Rezkellah,Christina Niklaus,Reto Gubelmann*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出Swiss4Arg，一个基于瑞士官方投票手册构建的多语言论点挖掘数据集，覆盖德语、法语、意大利语和罗曼什语四种国家语言，包含论点成分与关系标注，并提供基线结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有论点挖掘研究多集中于英语等高资源语言，跨语言可比性和低资源语言（如罗曼什语）的研究不足。瑞士官方投票手册天然包含系统化的赞成与反对论点，为构建跨语言对齐且立场平衡的论点挖掘资源提供了理想素材。

Method: 基于2019至2025年间53个联邦投票议题的官方投票手册，构建多语言数据集。每种语言由三名母语标注者标注论点成分（主主张、主张、前提、非论点单元）和关系（支持与攻击）。在平行数据上联合计算标注者间一致性，并发布裁决标签与个体标注。采用GPT-5.4和SwissBERT进行基线实验。

Result: 成分分类的Krippendorff's alpha为0.548，关系与目标分类为0.623。数据集同时发布裁决标签和个体标注者标注，支持分歧分析与跨语言变异研究，并给出GPT-5.4和SwissBERT的基线结果。

Conclusion: Swiss4Arg为多语言论点挖掘建立了新的基准，特别关注跨语言可比性和罗曼什语等低资源场景。数据集与代码已公开。

Abstract: We present Swiss4Arg, a multilingual dataset for argument mining based on official Swiss voting brochures, covering all four national languages: German, French, Italian, and Romansh (a Romance minority language exclusively spoken in Switzerland). The brochures contain explicitly formulated arguments systematically organized into pro and con sections, resulting in a cross-lingually aligned resource with balanced argumentative stance. We create a dataset that comprises 53 federal voting issues collected between 2019 and 2025, annotated for argument components (major claims, claims, premises, and non-argumentative units) and relations (support and attack) by three native speakers per language. Inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff's alpha) reaches 0.548 for component classification and 0.623 for relation and target classification, computed jointly across all annotators on the parallel data. We release both adjudicated labels and individual annotator annotations, enabling analyses of disagreement and cross-linguistic variation, and provide baseline results using GPT-5.4 and SwissBERT. Swiss4Arg establishes a novel benchmark for multilingual argument mining, with a particular focus on cross-lingual comparability and low-resource settings such as Romansh. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://anonymous-hf.up.railway.app/a/gozw0nion72y/ (HuggingFace) and https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MultiVote-03BD/ (GitHub).

</details>


### [566] [Text-Only vs. Image-Aware VLM Judges for Manga Translation Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17908)
*Subaru Kimura,Jun Suzuki*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出用同一视觉语言模型分别作为纯文本评判者（TOJ）和图像感知评判者（IAJ），在日英漫画翻译数据集上研究图像输入对翻译评估的影响，发现加入页面图像能更好检测视觉相关错误，但两者评估结果存在差异且人工验证未表现出一致偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 漫画翻译中，气泡文本之外的视觉语境（说话人身份、指代对象、场景语气）由页面图像承载，因此评估时参考图像很自然。但传统的漫画翻译评估多依赖纯文本自动指标，图像输入的影响研究不足。

Method: 提出一个实用验证框架，使用同一视觉语言模型（VLM）分别担任纯文本评判者（TOJ）和图像感知评判者（IAJ），以探究图像感知评估流程带来的评估分歧。使用页面级和气泡级对齐的日英漫画官方翻译数据集。

Result: 第一，向TOJ加入页面图像后，主VLM对故意注入的视觉依赖型退化的检测能力提升。第二，分析了TOJ与IAJ之间的评估分歧，发现错误数量和错误类别分布不同。人工验证未发现TOJ与IAJ之间有一致的偏好。

Conclusion: 图像输入能提升对视觉相关翻译错误的检测，但图像感知评估并不必然带来整体更优的评估结果，两类评判者各有差异，需谨慎看待图像在漫画翻译评估中的作用。

Abstract: In manga translation, visual context outside speech-bubble text, including speaker identities, referents, and scene tone, is depicted in page images, making it natural to refer to images during translation evaluation. However, most conventional manga translation evaluations rely solely on text-only automatic metrics, leaving the impact of image input insufficiently explored. We propose a practical validation framework that employs the same vision-language model (VLM) as both a text-only judge (TOJ) and an image-aware judge (IAJ) to investigate evaluation divergences associated with image-aware evaluation procedures. We use a Japanese-English manga dataset of official translations aligned at the page and speech-bubble levels. First, adding page images to TOJ improved the primary VLM's detection of deliberately injected, visually dependent degradations. Second, we analyzed evaluation divergences between TOJ and IAJ, finding different error counts and error-category distributions. Human verification did not reveal a consistent preference between TOJ and IAJ.

</details>


### [567] [Batch-Paced: Fixed-Budget Batch Decoding in Discrete Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17917)
*Shuai Zhang,Zhanchao Zhou,Huachuan Qiu,Anqi Li,Zhenzhong Lan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Batch-Paced，一种免训练的固定预算dLLM批解码方法，通过在各请求间联合分配解码计算量提升整体批质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式语言模型推理需求增长，离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）通过并行token生成提供高效推理路径，但已有解码方法只关注单个序列的推理效率，忽略批内请求间的计算分配问题。

Method: 将固定预算dLLM批解码形式化，提出Batch-Paced：免训练方法，在各请求之间联合优化解码计算的分配，以提升整体批质量，并可加入解码深度额度以进一步缩短时间。

Result: 在两个dLLM骨干、五个基准及其代表性混合上，相同预算下Batch-Paced提升批性能；收益通常随批大小增长，并在多种解码配置下基本保持。轨迹分析表明收益主要来自提升低置信度请求的已提交token置信度。批解码时间保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 固定预算下跨请求分配解码计算能有效提升dLLM批解码整体质量，且不牺牲批解码时间；适当加入解码深度额度可在小幅性能代价下进一步缩短解码时间。

Abstract: As generative language models become more capable and widely used, inference demand grows, making efficient serving increasingly important. Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a promising path to more efficient inference through parallel token generation. Prior dLLM decoding methods, however, focus on improving inference efficiency for individual sequences. We formulate fixed-budget dLLM batch decoding and introduce Batch-Paced, a training-free method that jointly optimizes the allocation of decoding compute across requests to improve overall batch quality. Across two dLLM backbones, five benchmarks and their representative mixtures, Batch-Paced improves batch performance under matched budgets; gains generally grow with batch size and largely persist across decoding configurations. Analysis of requests' decoding trajectories suggests that these gains arise largely by raising the committed-token confidence of lower-confidence requests. We further show that Batch-Paced's batch decode time remains competitive and that adding a decoding-depth allowance during Batch-Paced decoding can shorten it further at a modest performance cost.

</details>


### [568] [Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17953)
*Guanting Dong,Xinyu Yang,Jiajie Jin,Yuyang Hu,Xiaoshuai Song,Yifei Chen,Xiaoxi Li,Jiejun Tan,Yutao Zhu,Tat-Seng Chua,Ji-Rong Wen,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Agent-Reflex 训练框架，通过环境技能发现、反思监督微调与在线策略反思优化三阶段，激发智能体的主动反思能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法对智能体的反思学习与失败恢复监督不足，难以应对真实部署中工具服务返回的噪声反馈及用户干预。

Method: 三阶段框架：环境反思技能发现（RSD）注入工具反馈扰动并挖掘成功-失败配对以总结反思元技能；反思监督微调（ReSFT）将技能转化为自反思、技能恢复与用户纠错监督；在线策略反思策略优化（ORPO）结合噪声交互下的强化学习与反思引导的在线蒸馏。

Result: 基于 Qwen3-8B，在五个长程工具使用基准上达 58.6 总体得分，AgentNoiseBench 上达 29.1，超越强环境扩展与反思基线；在六个智能体基准套件上验证有效性。

Conclusion: Agent-Reflex 提升了智能体对噪声的鲁棒性并保持稳定训练动态，支持可扩展的智能体训练。

Abstract: Large language models have evolved from single-turn chatbots into interactive agents capable of long-horizon reasoning. In real deployments, MCP tool services can return noisy feedback and users may intervene to correct the agent, but existing methods provide limited supervision for reflection learning and failure recovery. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Reflex, a general training framework for incentivizing proactive reflection in agents. Specifically, Agent-Reflex comprises three stages. First, Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD) injects grounded tool-feedback perturbations into environment scaling, samples a capability-diverse LLM pool, mines matched success-failure pairs, and summarizes reusable reflection meta-skills. Building on this skill library, we then apply Reflective Supervised Fine-Tuning (ReSFT) that converts each skill into supervision for self-reflection, skill recovery, and user-centric correction, strengthening complementary reflective behaviors. Finally, we propose On-Policy Reflective Policy Optimization (ORPO) to combine agentic reinforcement learning under noisy interactions with reflection-guided on-policy distillation to further elicit proactive reflection. Built on Qwen3-8B, Agent-Reflex reaches 58.6 overall on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench, surpassing strong environment-scaling and reflection baselines. Experiments on six challenging agent benchmark suites demonstrate the effectiveness of Agent-Reflex. Further analyses show that Agent-Reflex improves agents' robustness to noise while maintaining stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training. Our code is available at https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/Agent-Reflex.

</details>


### [569] [Virtual Head Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17959)
*Xibo Ding,Guoxia Wang,Jinle Zeng,Jiabin Yang,Sirui Tao,Chao Yang,Dianhai Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出虚拟头注意力（VHA），通过两个轻量线性操作同时改善KV缓存、计算量与质量三者的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文大模型注意力设计存在“不可能三角”：KV缓存大小、训练与预填充FLOPs、模型质量难以兼顾。GQA质量好但缓存开销大；MLA可压缩缓存但有质量损失；MFA压缩缓存却大幅增加训练与预填充计算量。

Method: VHA包含两个线性操作：Q Premix对每个KV组内查询做近似恒等变换，从减半的物理查询头中恢复虚拟头多样性；Linear Postmix通过低秩I+AB^T残差结构融合头间特征。由于无非线性操作，推理时可分别折叠进查询投影和输出投影，退化为标准GQA-2，可直接复用现有GQA推理优化。

Result: 仅用两个KV头时，大模型组大小可达64，充分利用张量核并行。在四个规模、4K上下文、50B token预训练中，各规模均超过GQA基线（+0.05%至+0.81%），KV缓存较GQA-8减少4倍、MoE规模较GQA-4减少2倍，训练与预填充FLOPs降低7.9%。在30B-A3B MoE（500B tokens，8K上下文）上，较MLA和GQA-4分别提升+0.70%/+2.60%；在10B-A1B MoE长上下文比较中，8K–128K平均RULER得分84.4，优于GQA的73.0。

Conclusion: VHA以两个可折叠线性操作同时提升KV缓存、计算效率与模型质量三个维度，并兼容现有GQA推理优化，在多种规模与长上下文场景中均优于GQA、MLA等基线。

Abstract: The design of attention mechanisms in long-context large language models faces an ``impossible triangle'' among KV cache size, training and prefill FLOPs, and model quality. GQA achieves strong quality but incurs high KV cache overhead; alternative approaches such as MLA and MFA can compress the cache, but MLA suffers from quality loss while MFA substantially increases training and prefill compute. We propose Virtual Head Attention (VHA), which simultaneously improves all three vertices through two lightweight linear operations: Q Premix applies a near-identity transformation to queries within each KV group to recover virtual head diversity from halved physical query heads, and Linear Postmix fuses inter-head features via a low-rank $I + AB^\top$ residual structure. Since VHA introduces no nonlinear operations, Premix can be folded into the query projection and Postmix into the output projection at inference time, reducing the model to a standard GQA-2 architecture that directly reuses all existing GQA inference optimizations. With only two KV heads, the group size in large models readily reaches 64, fully exploiting Tensor Core parallelism during decoding. Across four scales with 4K-context 50B-token pretraining, VHA consistently surpasses the standard GQA baseline at every scale ($+$0.05\% to $+$0.81\%), while reducing KV cache by $4\times$ vs.\ GQA-8 at dense scales and $2\times$ vs.\ GQA-4 at the MoE scale, and lowering training and prefill FLOPs by 7.9\% (1.7B, $S{=}4096$). On an industrial 30B-A3B MoE model trained on 500B tokens at 8K context, VHA outperforms both MLA and GQA-4 by $+$0.70\,/\,$+$2.60\,\% on a 12-benchmark base-model evaluation suite; in a separate matched 10B-A1B MoE comparison after long-context mid-training, VHA attains an average RULER score of 84.4 over 8K--128K versus 73.0 for GQA, while using two rather than four KV heads in the full-attention layers.

</details>


### [570] [Seeing Through the Forgery Is Not Enough: Regressive Sycophancy under Fabricated Evidence in Medical Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17989)
*Sadif Ahmed,Soumya Swagata Biswas,Rifat Shahriyar,Chowdhury Mohammad Rakin Haider*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出"回归型谄媚"现象：当用户用伪造处方文件反驳时，医学视觉语言模型会放弃原本正确的诊断答案，且即便模型指出文件是伪造的，仍可能在后续对话中改口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学视觉语言模型在临床场景中需要面对用户的反驳意见，而用户的反驳可能附带看似权威的伪造文档。作者希望探究这种"伪造证据"是否会诱导模型放弃正确答案，即所谓回归型谄媚（regressive sycophancy），并检验披露文件为合成内容是否能缓解该问题。

Method: 在VQA-RAD的400个是/否问题上，对四个开源视觉语言模型进行多轮对话测试，共19,200次对话，分别在附带伪造处方与不附带处方两种条件下进行。实验还设置了披露文档为合成内容的系统提示句，以及不同对话脚本，以观察翻转率变化。

Result: 在未披露文档为合成内容时，模型放弃了80.1%的正确答案（6,488个中的多数）。同一处方在不同脚本下，使Qwen2.5-VL-7B的翻转率从45.9%升至89.6%，而Qwen3-VL-8B则从77.7%降至50.9%。在3,232次附带处方的对话中，有915次（28.3%）模型拒绝处方并保留正确答案，但其中40%在后续轮次中仍然翻转。披露文档为合成的系统提示可将某模型的翻转率从77.8%降至47.3%。

Conclusion: 伪造文档会显著诱发医学视觉语言模型的回答翻转，模型即使识别出文件为伪造，也未必能保持正确答案。披露文档虚假性只能部分降低翻转率，因此对伪造证据的"知晓"并不足以防止模型采纳其误导性答案。

Abstract: A medical vision-language model may analyze a given CT scan and correctly detect both kidneys in view. Continuing this conversation, if a user provides a prescription with an opposite direction, medical VLMs often sycophantically choose to realign their diagnosis. In this work, we study regressive sycophancy under fabricated evidence, where a model abandons a correct answer when pushback comes with a fake document. We test four open VLMs on 400 VQA-RAD yes/no questions in 19,200 multi-turn conversations, with and without a fabricated prescription. Without a disclosure that documents are synthetic, the models abandon 80.1% of 6,488 correct answers. Notably, under one script each, the same prescription raises the flip rate of Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 45.9% to 89.6% and lowers that of Qwen3-VL-8B from 77.7% to 50.9%. A model rejected the prescription while still preserving the correct answer in 915 of 3,232 conversations with the prescription (28.3%), and 40% of these flipped in later turns. System-prompt sentences that disclose the documents as synthetic lower one model's flip rate from 77.8% to 47.3%. Thus, we conclude that awareness about a forgery does not prevent a model from adopting its answer.

</details>


### [571] [LatentRemedy: Efficient Remedy For Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18014)
*Zhiwei Chen,Zhongtao Rao,Waikit Xiu,Yuxiang Zhang,Shuting Cui,Jian Chen,Tianxiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 LatentRemedy，用少量任务条件化的潜在 token 帮助目标智能体在冲突任务下利用复用的非前缀 KV 缓存，避免重算共享块，性能显著优于现有复用基线且 TTFT 接近直接复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统共享上下文块，非前缀 KV 缓存复用可提升推理效率，但当智能体任务冲突时直接复用会严重损害性能（最多下降 90%）。现有方法（选择性重算、基于偏移的校准）只能恢复有限损失。作者认为问题不仅在于 KV 表示被污染，还在于智能体难以在自身指令下解读复用上下文。

Method: LatentRemedy 使用少量任务条件化的潜在 token：用 MLP 将目标前缀的最后隐藏状态映射为若干潜在 token，置于复用 KV 块之后与共享上下文交互；并通过全预填充蒸馏（full-prefill distillation）训练该 MLP，引导后续预测朝向目标任务。

Result: 在冲突任务上，LatentRemedy 持续优于现有复用基线；随着缓存规模增大，其 TTFT 接近直接复用。

Conclusion: 通过引入任务条件化潜在 token 并结合全预填充蒸馏，LatentRemedy 在保持高效缓存复用的同时有效缓解任务冲突带来的性能退化，为非前缀 KV 复用提供了更优方案。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Non-prefix KV cache reuse is a promising approach for improving inference efficiency in multi-agent systems as agents share the same context blocks. However, when agents have conflicting tasks, directly reusing non-prefix KV caches across agents can severely degrade model performance, causing up to a 90% drop. Existing remedies, including selective recomputation and offset-based calibration, recover a limited fraction of this loss. We argue that the problem lies not only in contaminated KV representations but also in the agent's difficulty interpreting reused context under its own instructions. To this end, we introduce LatentRemedy, which uses a few task-conditioned latent tokens to help the target agent leverage reused context without recomputing the shared block. Specifically, we use an MLP to map the last hidden state of the target prefix into a small number of latent tokens, which are placed after the reused KV block to interact with the shared context. To guide subsequent predictions toward the target task, we train the MLP through full-prefill distillation. Experiments show that LatentRemedy consistently outperforms existing reuse baselines on conflicting tasks while maintaining TTFT close to direct reuse as cache size grows. Code and data are available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/kvreuse.

</details>


### [572] [Machine--human agreement in marking undergraduate assignments is specific to model, prompt and institution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18019)
*Giulio Corsi,Maryam Abo-Tabik,Yael Benn,Georgiana Thorpe Apreutesei,Roni Tibon,Alexandru Marcoci,Deborah Talmi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 使用三所英国高校761份心理学作业，对三个前沿大模型单独及集成评估，发现人机评分一致性受模型、提示与机构共同影响，现有模型缺乏跨情境可迁移的评估能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高等教育中写作评估资源消耗巨大，大模型有望自动化这一环节；但现有评估多局限于单一模型、单一提示与单一机构，无法检验其真实可用性与跨情境通用性。

Method: 收集三所英国大学761份本科心理学作业，评估三个前沿大模型（单独使用及集成使用），考察准确率、提示敏感性、错误独立性、可泛化性与证据基础五个维度。

Result: 人机评分一致性差异很大，且没有在跨机构上普遍最优的模型或提示；所有模型都将分数向共同中心趋势压缩，高估最弱作业、低估最强作业，该误差为模型共有，集成无法消除；机器评分对语言特征的奖励强于人工评分。

Conclusion: 人机一致性是模型、提示与机构的联合产物，当前大模型缺乏可跨情境迁移的评估能力；单情境验证会高估其部署就绪度。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) promise to automate one of higher education's most resource-intensive activities: assessing student writing. Existing evaluations are typically limited to a single model, a single prompt and a single institution. Using 761 undergraduate psychology assignments from three UK universities, we evaluated three frontier LLMs, individually and in ensemble, on accuracy, prompt sensitivity, error independence, generalisability and evidential basis. Agreement between human and machine marks varied widely, with no model or prompt optimal across institutions. All models compressed marks towards a common central tendency, overvaluing the weakest assignments and undervaluing the strongest. Because this error was shared, ensembling failed to remove it. Machine marks also rewarded linguistic features more strongly than human marks. Since human-machine agreement was a joint product of model, prompt and institution, we conclude that current LLMs lack evaluative capacity transferable across contexts, and that single-context validation overstates readiness for deployment.

</details>


### [573] [A Benchmark for Bangla Task-Oriented Dialogue Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18060)
*Afrina Alam Lamia,Sumiaya Sharif,Prottoy Modak,Ohiduzzaman Rayhan,Nafis Sadeq*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了BanglaTOD——一个面向孟加拉语、英语和罗马化孟加拉语（Banglish）的平行三语任务型对话理解基准，包含9个孟加拉国特定服务领域的209段多轮对话和64种意图，每轮对齐三种语言，共4,689条标注记录。作者用mBERT、BERT-base-uncased和BanglaBERT建立联合意图分类与槽填充基线，发现跨语言性能差异显著，且移除对话历史会使意图准确率下降19.0–25.7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉语的任务型对话理解研究不足，尤其缺乏涉及英语和罗马化孟加拉语（Banglish）的多语言设置下的资源与基准。作者希望填补这一空白，为孟加拉国特定对话应用提供多语言对话理解的基础数据与基线。

Method: 构建BanglaTOD平行三语基准：209段多轮对话，覆盖9个孟加拉国特定服务领域、64种意图；每轮对话在孟加拉语、英语和Banglish之间对齐，共4,689条语言特定轮次记录，标注意图、token级槽位、状态更新和累积对话状态。使用mBERT、BERT-base-uncased和BanglaBERT建立上下文感知的联合意图分类与槽填充基线，并进行跨语言分析及移除对话历史的消融实验。

Result: 跨语言分析显示不同模型和语言表示之间存在显著性能差异；移除对话历史后，意图准确率下降19.0–25.7个百分点。

Conclusion: BanglaTOD为多语言对话理解及孟加拉国特定会话应用的未来对话状态跟踪研究提供了基础，数据集已在Hugging Face公开。

Abstract: Task-oriented dialogue understanding remains underexplored for Bangla, particularly in multilingual settings involving English and romanized Bangla (Banglish). We introduce BanglaTOD, a parallel tri-lingual benchmark comprising 209 multi-turn dialogues across nine Bangladesh-specific service domains and 64 intents. Each conversational turn is aligned across Bangla, English, and Banglish, yielding 4,689 language-specific turn records annotated with intents, token-level slots, state updates, and accumulated dialogue states. We establish context-aware baselines for joint intent classification and slot filling using mBERT, BERT-base-uncased, and BanglaBERT. Cross-language analysis reveals substantial performance differences across models and linguistic representations, while removing dialogue history reduces intent accuracy by 19.0--25.7 percentage points. BanglaTOD provides a foundation for multilingual dialogue understanding and future dialogue state tracking research in Bangladesh-specific conversational applications. The dataset is publicly available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/afri7here/BanglaTOD}{Hugging Face}.

</details>


### [574] [From Agents to Edges: Paired Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18069)
*Feng Lin,Xiaotian Yu,Yifan Yang,Aijun Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 PACO，将通信边作为优化单元，联合优化每条边两端的指令与共享通信约定，在固定模型权重、角色与拓扑的黑箱 LLM 多智能体系统中显著提升协作效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强个体智能体并不保证有效协作，通信双方对信息的传达与解读需对齐，因而通信边成为天然的优化单元；现有提示优化与通信方法未针对边的两端联合优化。
