Together, these findings shift the central challenge from whether LLMs possess relevant clinical knowledge to whether they can identify, acquire, and effectively use the right evidence under clinical diagnosis and conduct a more detailed mechanism analysis to identify the exact location of the capability gap.

</details>


### [611] [Jev-ToM: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Typed Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18610)
*Kawai Chung,Chunkit Chan,Yuxuan Liu,Yauwai Yim,Xi Yang,Wenbin Hu,Huihao Jing,Chiu Yeung Tang,Changxuan Fan,Ki Sen Hung,Tsun On Kwok,Haoran Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Jev-ToM，用类型化决策模型替代生成式大模型进行有界心理理论（ToM）选择，在九项基准、11117 个问题上评估五种类型化模型与七种生成式基线，TypeSafe Jev 达到 73.2% 源平衡准确率并在六类能力上均位居前二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话与协作助手需要反复推断伙伴的知识、信念与意图，生成式大模型在有限范围的心理理论选择任务上可能成本高、等待时间长，类型化决策模型成为潜在替代方案，但目前缺乏系统性对比与验证。

Method: 构建 Jev-ToM 评测：在六个能力组、九项 ToM 基准的 11117 个英文文本问题上，比较五种类型化决策模型与七种生成式基线，并考察置信度选择、理由附着方式、候选扩展、相关性问题线索及预测状态的影响。

Result: TypeSafe Jev 达到 73.2% 源平衡准确率（含原生控制项），在全部六类能力上排名第一或第二，在信念、目标/欲望/意图、情绪上领先；其他类型化模型各有优势。资源对比显示 Jev 有望降低重复 ToM 选择的成本与等待时间。置信度选择依赖基准，理由可能修复错误也可能推翻正确答案，候选扩展暴露选择与输出有效性问题，相关性问题线索贡献了大部分下游增益。

Conclusion: 结果支持将 Jev 作为助手中心理理论选择组件进行测试，集成时需优先解决任务特定的置信度校准、候选设计与输出验证问题。

Abstract: Dialogue and collaborative assistants repeatedly judge what a partner knows, believes, or intends. Typed decision models offer a potential alternative to generative large language models for bounded Theory of Mind (ToM) selection. We present Jev-ToM, comparing five typed decision models and seven generative baselines on 11,117 English text questions from nine ToM benchmarks across six capability groups. TypeSafe Jev reaches 73.2% source-balanced accuracy including native controls and ranks first or second across all six capabilities, leading beliefs, goals/desires/intentions, and emotions. Other typed models show distinct strengths across tasks. Separate resource comparisons suggest that Jev could reduce the cost and waiting time of repeated ToM selection. Confidence-based selection remains benchmark-dependent, and supplied reasons can repair errors or overturn correct answers depending on their attachment. Candidate expansion reveals distinct selection and output-validity problems. Related-question cues account for most of Jev's downstream gains, with task-dependent effects from predicted states. The findings motivate testing Jev as a ToM selection component in assistants, with task-specific confidence calibration, candidate design, and output validation as integration priorities.

</details>


### [612] [Legal-R1: Agentic Retrieval for Evidence-Based Legal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18611)
*Huaiwen Pang,Jiale Han,Junying Chen,Wenjun Xiao,Benyou Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Legal-R1，一种面向法律问答的智能体检索框架，通过多智能体工作流分解法律推理，并训练 Lawyer 智能体实现证据检索与推理，在中文法律基准上优于多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律问答要求答案基于合法有效、可引用的证据，而标准检索增强生成依赖一次性语义匹配，无法依据权威性、适用性和来源多样性来筛选异构法律证据。

Method: Legal-R1 将法律推理分解为多智能体工作流：Lawyer 智能体学习何时检索、查询哪个法律来源、寻找何种证据以及证据是否充分；Legal Assistant 智能体从规范性法律来源和判例中进行权威感知与多样性感知的证据选择；Judge 智能体基于完整证据轨迹生成最终答案。仅对 Lawyer 智能体进行掩码监督微调与轨迹感知强化学习后训练。

Result: 在多个中文法律基准上，Legal-R1 优于通用、法律专用以及检索增强的基线方法。

Conclusion: 智能体式、分角色的检索与推理流程，结合对检索决策智能体的针对性后训练，可有效提升法律问答中证据选择与答案生成的质量。

Abstract: Legal question answering requires answers that are not only plausible, but also grounded in legally valid and citable evidence. Standard retrieval-augmented generation often relies on one-shot semantic matching, which is insufficient when legal evidence must be selected according to authority, applicability, and diversity across heterogeneous sources. We introduce Legal-R1, an agentic retrieval framework for evidence-based legal reasoning. Legal-R1 decomposes legal reasoning into a multi-agent workflow, where a Lawyer agent learns when to retrieve, which legal source to query, what evidence to seek, and when the collected evidence is sufficient. A Legal Assistant agent retrieves from normative legal sources and precedent cases with authority-aware and diversity-aware selection, while a Judge agent generates the final answer from the complete evidence trajectory. We post-train only the Lawyer agent with masked supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-aware reinforcement learning. Experiments on multiple Chinese legal benchmarks show that Legal-R1 improves over general-purpose, legal-specific, and retrieval-augmented baselines.

</details>


### [613] [Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18616)
*Yuyang Bai,Yu Wang,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DKGI框架，让语言模型智能体直接在完整节点/边文件之上创建图访问工具，实现工具创建与使用协同演化，在多领域基准上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜索文本丰富的知识图谱需要在检视文本证据的同时沿关系遍历。预定义的图接口限制了智能体可访问的证据范围，即使智能体编写代码来组合工具调用或处理检索到的子图，这种限制依然存在。

Method: DKGI（direct knowledge graph interaction）：智能体直接在完整节点和边文件之上编写Python代码来创建图访问工具，用于沿关系遍历、组合节点集合、选择文本证据，并将代码执行与shell搜索和文件检视交织进行。智能体可批量处理大规模节点集合，同时返回选定文本供模型评估；执行反馈指导工具的创建与修改，演化的工具又决定下一步采集的证据。

Result: 在覆盖三个领域的基准数据集上，无需训练的DKGI在每个图上至少超过最强已发表基线6.7个Hit@1点，即使在最小化harness设置下亦然。受控消融实验表明多轮编程优于仅shell访问和预定义图工具；轨迹显示智能体会修改代码以扩展搜索或处理错误。

Conclusion: 允许工具创建与工具使用在图搜索过程中协同演化具有重要价值。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.

</details>


### [614] [Breakdown of Conversational Involvement: A Joint Multi-Modal Analysis of Conversation Floors and F-formation Detection with Multiple Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18627)
*Zonghuan Li,Chirag Raman,Hayley Hung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究自由站立对话中的对话参与度，指出当前将F-formations视为单一对话的假设不足，并通过三项分析探讨说话状态、空间特征与对话楼层模式对F-formations检测的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 互动在日常生活中普遍且自发发生，研究谁能影响谁具有广泛应用潜力。作者聚焦自由站立对话中的对话参与度，认为现有将F-formations等同于单一对话的假设不充分，需要更细致地刻画对话参与。

Method: 论文研究FCG的两种操作化：F-formations与conversation floors，并进行三项分析：1）提出用说话状态估计conversation floors，并用于分析F-formations内部的楼层；2）在选定基线上应用不同特征集，分析检测结果的空间特征；3）联合分析空间特征与对话中的楼层模式。

Result: 使用头部特征得到的群体更可能被其他特征检测到的群体所包含；某些流程可从上半身特征检测出具有单一楼层的群体，同时保留下半身特征检测到的F-formations。

Conclusion: 需要更详细的理论与框架来整体展示互动中的对话参与度。

Abstract: Interactions happen universally and spontaneously in daily lives. Studying involvement in interactions helps us analyze who can influence who and has a wide potential in applications. Specifically, we consider conversational involvement in free-standing conversations. We study two operationalizations of an FCG: F-formations and conversation floors, and propose that current assumption that F-formations capture single conversations is insufficient. To illustrate how different implementations could impact the detected F-formations, we employ three analyses. First, we propose that speaking status can be used for estimating conversation floors, and leveraged it to analyze floors within F-formations. Second, we analyze spatial characteristics of the detection results by applying different feature sets on chosen baselines, and find that groups resulting from head features are more likely to be subsumed by groups detected using other features. Finally, we do a joint analysis which combines the spatial features and floor patterns in the conversation. We observe that certain pipelines can detect groups with single floors from upper body features, while retaining F-formations with lower body features. We conclude that a more detailed theory and framework is needed to holistically demonstrate conversational involvement within interactions.

</details>


### [615] [Known-Voice Cloning and the Limits of Personality Transfer for Character Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18669)
*Johanna Magdalena Kuch,Maud van Lier,Daksitha Senel Withanage Don,Patrick Gebhard,Tanja Schneeberger,Elisabeth André*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 两项研究检验零样本克隆的熟悉人声是否能将其人格印象系统性迁移到虚拟角色上，结果显示迁移证据有限、效果选择性且无法跨特质与情境泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本语音克隆可从短录音复制可辨识声音并赋予任意虚拟角色。已有研究多关注熟悉度与个性化效应，尚未直接检验克隆的熟悉声音是否会将人格印象系统性地转移到具身虚拟角色上。这种转移可能被用于操纵人们把虚拟角色当作有能力的社交主体，因此需要实证检验。

Method: 两项研究均采用克隆熟悉人声的虚拟角色呈现。研究1在真实大学场景中进行，使用参与者熟悉的讲师克隆声音；研究2在线进行，使用社交媒体内容创作者及其社群成员的克隆声音。理论框架为身份激活、特质转移与人物重构。

Result: 两项研究中人格迁移的证据都有限，观察到的效应具有选择性，未能跨人格特质或研究情境泛化。在线研究中，可辨识的声音身份线索激活了对说话者的预期，但未重构更广泛的人物印象。定性回答显示，判断常受感知到的人造感以及声音与外貌是否匹配的影响。

Conclusion: 研究结果对"克隆声音会直接操纵人们把人工角色视为有能力的社交主体"这一普遍担忧起到缓和作用，表明声音身份线索的作用受限于特质与情境。

Abstract: Recent advances in zero-shot voice cloning systems make it possible to reproduce a recognizable voice from a short recording and attach it to arbitrary virtual characters. Prior work suggests that familiar vocal identity can carry over associated personality impressions to new targets such as robots or virtual characters. However, these works have mainly examined familiarity and personalization effects rather than directly testing whether a cloned familiar voice systematically transfers personality impressions to an embodied virtual character. Such transference raises the concern that cloned voices could be used to manipulate people into engaging with virtual characters as capable social actors. Across two studies, we investigated whether personality impressions transfer when a virtual character speaks with the cloned voice of a familiar person. Study 1 examined this question in a real-world university setting using the cloned voice of a lecturer familiar to the participating students. Study 2 examined the same question online using voices of social media content creators and members of their communities. Drawing on the concepts of identity activation, trait transfer, and person reconstruction, we show that evidence of personality transfer was limited in both studies. Observed effects were selective and did not generalize across traits or study contexts. In the online study in particular, recognizable voice identity cues activated expectations about the speaker but did not reconstruct the broader person impression. Qualitative responses further indicated that judgments were frequently shaped by perceived artificiality and by whether voice and appearance fit together. Our findings moderate common concerns that cloned voices straightforwardly manipulate people into perceiving artificial characters as capable social actors.

</details>


### [616] [SMI: Ontology-Grounded Semantic IDs for Hierarchy-Aware Medical Concept Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18672)
*Ziyang Song,Lia Shen,Yixuan Li,Qincheng Lu,Weihao Li,Haoran Xu,He Zhu,Xinyu Wang,Yue Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练的语义医学标识符（SMI）框架，通过医学本体构建层级感知的概念表示，在多个临床任务上优于层级无关的LM嵌入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学语言模型虽能提供强表示，但常忽略医学概念间的层级结构，尤其在长尾词表中稀有且细粒度的临床编码上，层级无关的表示随概念频率下降而信息量不足。

Method: SMI为每个诊断、操作或药物概念定义由专家本体给出的由粗到细路径作为Semantic ID，并聚合冻结的生物医学LM在各级本体上的嵌入，形成保留粗到细语义的层级感知表示。基础版使用均匀聚合，另设基于验证数据选择全局层级权重的加权变体；并给出理论分析。

Result: 理论上SMI比层级无关嵌入更具信息量，尤其对稀有细粒度概念；实验显示其能捕捉有意义的层级结构并改进临床关系预测。在MIMIC-IV上提升死亡率预测、再入院预测、药物推荐与稀有药物预测；在eICU上跨医院分布偏移下表示更稳健。

Conclusion: SMI是一种无需训练、以本体为依托的框架，可有效增强医学概念表示并提升多种临床预测任务的性能与稳健性。

Abstract: Biomedical language models (LMs) provide strong representations for clinical tasks, but they often fail to capture the hierarchical structure among medical concepts. This limitation is especially pronounced for rare and fine-grained clinical codes in long-tailed vocabularies, where hierarchy-agnostic LM representations become less informative as concept frequency decreases. We introduce Semantic Medical Identifier (SMI), a training-free framework for constructing ontology-grounded Semantic IDs and hierarchy-aware medical concept representations. For each diagnosis, procedure, or medication concept, SMI defines its Semantic ID as the coarse-to-fine path through an expert-defined medical ontology. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings across the corresponding ontology levels to form hierarchy-aware medical concept representations that preserve coarse-to-fine clinical semantics. The base SMI uses uniform aggregation across ontology levels, while a level-weighted variant selects global level weights on validation data. Our theoretical analysis shows that SMI yields more informative medical concept representations than hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings, particularly for rare and fine-grained clinical concepts. Experiments show that SMI captures meaningful hierarchical structure and improves clinical relation prediction. On MIMIC-IV, SMI improves mortality prediction, readmission prediction, drug recommendation, and rare drug prediction. On eICU, SMI yields more robust patient representations under cross-hospital distribution shift.

</details>


### [617] [From Relation-Specific Heads to Shared Interventions: Contextual Entrainment in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18674)
*Jinghan Zheng,Jiajun Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究大模型"语境吸引"（contextual entrainment）机制是否真正按关系隔离，发现许多注意力头是可跨关系复用的全局组件，用异质攻击提示可找到通用干预目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型依赖提示上下文进行上下文学习，但也会在回答后续问题时误用早前上下文中不相关的词元。已有工作识别出语境吸引现象，并通过消融注意力头来减轻该行为，认为这些头大体是任务或关系特异的。本文质疑：语境吸引背后的机制是否真的按关系隔离，还是说按关系搜索也能找到跨关系共享的可复用组件。

Method: 使用事实干扰项的关系补全提示，覆盖19个词汇-语义子类型；识别消融后能降低语境吸引的注意力头；测试所得头集合在精确关系、语义家族、混合关系分布之间的迁移恢复能力；并进行干净补全探针与上下文使用探针来检验干预对正常能力的影响。

Result: 同家族迁移优于跨家族迁移；移除全局共享头后，家族残差变弱；子类型特异的搜索会反复重新发现许多全局头。干净补全与上下文使用探针表明，该共享干预在降低有害复制的同时，能保留正常的关系补全和简单的上下文学习能力。

Conclusion: 有害的上下文跟随不宜通过寻找孤立的关系特异回路来解决，而应使用异质攻击提示来揭示可复用的干预目标，其效果受语义关系结构影响。这为语境吸引及其缓解提供了更精确的视角。

Abstract: Large language models rely on prompt context to perform in-context learning, follow formats, and adapt to local evidence. This ability, however, also raises a robustness concern: models may reuse irrelevant tokens from earlier context when answering a later query. Prior work identifies this behavior as contextual entrainment and finds attention heads whose ablation reduces it, arguing that these heads are largely task- or relation-specific. But are the mechanisms behind contextual entrainment truly isolated by relation, or do relation-conditioned searches recover reusable components shared across relations? Using factual-distractor relation-completion prompts across 19 lexical-semantic subtypes, we identify attention heads whose ablation reduces entrainment and test how the resulting head sets transfer recovery ability across exact relations, semantic families, and mixed relation distributions. Same-family transfer exceeds different-family transfer, family residuals weaken once globally shared heads are removed, and subtype-specific searches repeatedly rediscover many global heads. Clean-completion and context-use probes further suggest that this shared intervention can reduce harmful copying while preserving ordinary relation completion and simple in-context abilities. Our findings provide a more precise perspective on contextual entrainment and its mitigation: harmful context following is not best addressed by searching for isolated relation-specific circuits, but by using heterogeneous attack prompts to reveal reusable intervention targets whose effects are shaped by semantic relation structure.

</details>


### [618] [Code-Switching Detection via Language-Selective Dimensions in Speech Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18726)
*Jie Chi,Zakaria Aldeneh,Masha Fedzechkina,Maureen de Seyssel,Natalie Schluter*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种直接从语音中检测语码转换的轻量方法，利用预训练语音编码器中的帧级语言信息判断一句中是否同时存在两种语言，在 CS-FLEURS 上平均 F1 达 0.798。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语码转换在多语语音中很常见，但在预训练语料中代表性不足。要提高覆盖度，需要在大型语音集合中找出相关话语；而依赖转写再检测文本语言交替的方法受限于多语转写质量，因此希望直接从未转写语音中检测语码转换。

Method: 使用单语录音识别编码器隐藏状态中对语言敏感的维度，并将其帧级激活聚合为语码转换预测；用小型语码转换数据集调节决策规则。对比 Whisper-small 编码器、CNN 以及为单语语言识别训练的 HuBERT 线性基线。

Result: 在 CS-FLEURS 的 14 个语言对上，Whisper-small 编码器平均 F1 为 0.798，CNN 为 0.776，HuBERT 线性基线为 0.751。

Conclusion: 结果表明预训练语音编码器已编码识别语码转换话语所需的信息，并提供了一种构建更具代表性多语语料的轻量工具。

Abstract: Code-switching (CS), the alternation between languages within an utterance, is common in multilingual speech but underrepresented in pretraining corpora. Increasing CS coverage requires finding relevant utterances in large speech collections so that they can be included in training data. One way to find such utterances is to transcribe the speech and detect language alternation in the text, but this depends on obtaining accurate multilingual transcriptions. We propose a lightweight method that detects CS directly from speech. It uses frame-level language information in pretrained speech encoders to determine whether both languages are present within an utterance. Specifically, we identify language-selective hidden-state dimensions using monolingual recordings and aggregate their frame-level activations into a CS prediction. With a small CS set used to tune a decision rule, we show that the Whisper-small encoder achieves a mean F1 of $0.798$ across 14 language pairs in CS-FLEURS, compared with $0.776$ for a CNN and $0.751$ for a HuBERT linear baseline trained for monolingual language identification. Our findings suggest that pretrained speech encoders already encode the information needed to identify CS utterances, and they provide a lightweight tool for building more representative multilingual corpora.

</details>


### [619] [Looking Complete Is Not Being Grounded: Evaluating LLM Sitreps Against Human-Authored Situation Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18762)
*Sachin Kumar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出以人道主义专业需求为导向的危机报告评估框架：用LLM辅助、作者审核的内容分析，从专业情境报告中归纳出15槽位信息模式，并据此评估5类灾害、3种灾害类型下的121份人工报告与261份LLM生成报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动危机报告评估多采用便利的可比指标，而非从业者真正需要的信息维度，导致评估效度不足；作者希望建立以专业情境报告为基准的评估方法，并检验机器报告是否真的达到人类水平，以及常用指标是否有效。

Method: 通过LLM辅助、作者审核的定性内容分析，从专业人道主义情境报告中提炼15槽位信息模式；据此对121份人工报告与261份LLM报告（涵盖5起灾害、3类灾害）进行评分；采用多评审（含4个LLM评审）开展盲评信度检验，使用bootstrap置信区间与置换检验比较人机差距，并进行跨模型复现、同日官方数据比对、原始精确数字匹配与人工审计，以及ROUGE-L、BERTScore和通用LLM评审等指标的有效性检验。

Result: 在Cyclone Idai上，最佳机器组名义上略高于人类经验上限（0.827 vs. 0.821），但差异与零不可区分（95% bootstrap CI [-.049,.059]；置换检验p=.852），且在另一模型下排序不复现。盲评100项Idai样本中，作者与Gemini评审一致率为0.910，未加权Cohen's κ=.799。四个评审均达到原始一致率.7的标准，仅Gemini在机会校正κ上达到.7。三起主要事件中，机器报告复现同日官方数据的5.4–11.0%；原始精确数字匹配将14.3–19.6%的官方数字和85.4–90.1%的机器数字关联到社交信息流；人工审计确认45/50的声明缺失、4/25的官方匹配和24/25的机器匹配在语义上成立。发布来源差距在全部12个事件-评审单元中均为正。ROUGE-L无信息量，BERTScore在多重校正后与完整性负相关，通用LLM评审的方向会改变。

Conclusion: 以专业需求定义的评估显示，机器危机报告在表层内容上接近人类，但尚未在统计意义上超越人类，且结果依赖具体模型；常用自动指标（ROUGE-L、BERTScore、通用LLM评审）不足以衡量报告完整性，发布来源等专业关键信息在所有单元中均缺失，评估应转向面向从业者需求的信息模式与来源溯源。

Abstract: Evaluation for automatic crisis reporting should measure what practitioners need, not what is convenient to compare. Through LLM-assisted, author-approved content analysis, we derive a 15-slot information schema from professional humanitarian situation reports using qualitative content analysis, then evaluate 121 human and 261 LLM-generated reports across five disasters and three hazard types. Under google/gemini-3.7-flash on Cyclone Idai, the best machine arm is nominally above the empirical human ceiling (0.827 vs. 0.821), but the difference is statistically indistinguishable from zero (95\% bootstrap CI $[-.049,.059]$; permutation $p=.852$), and the ordering does not replicate under openai/gpt-5.6-luna. On a blind 100-item Idai sample, the author agrees with the Gemini judge at 0.910 accuracy and unweighted Cohen's $κ=.799$. All four judges clear the plan's raw-agreement criterion of .7; only Gemini reaches .7 on chance-corrected $κ$. Across the three primary events, machine reports reproduce 5.4-11.0% of same-day official figures. Across those same events, raw exact-number matching links 14.3-19.6% of official figures and 85.4-90.1% of machine figures to the social stream; manual audit confirms 45/50 declared absences, 4/25 official matches, and 24/25 machine matches semantically. The issuing-provenance gap is positive in all 12 observed event-judge cells: report date, organisation, series, and authority were not supplied at professional-report coverage in any cell. On the three primary events, ROUGE-L is uninformative, BERTScore is negatively associated with completeness after multiplicity correction, and a generic LLM judge changes sign.

</details>


### [620] [Rubrics from the Task, Verdicts from Evidence: Pointwise Rubric Rewards with Tool-Augmented Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18766)
*Tianci Liu,Haoyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReVeR，一种基于评分细则（rubric）的逐点式奖励模型，仅依据指令推导硬规则与分级原则，并通过工具增强的评判独立评估响应；实验表明其在偏好准确率、测试时扩展与下游策略优化上优于成对式 rubric RM，并揭示 rubric 保真度、偏好准确率与下游效用是三种不同属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 rubric 的奖励模型存在三类问题：1）评分细则常从已观测的候选响应中推导，引入响应诱导偏差，限制 rubric 的泛化性；2）评判器仅靠阅读难以处理机械性约束；3）常用的成对评判只给出相对偏好，难以直接用于策略优化。

Method: 提出 ReVeR——一种逐点式 rubric 奖励模型：仅对指令本身进行推理，推导出硬规则（hard rules）与分级原则（graded principles），并通过工具增强的评判方式独立评估每个响应。两部分均通过"标签盲蒸馏"训练，即偏好标签仅用于筛选教师模型的输出，从而构建出大规模 rubric 推理与评判轨迹数据集 ReVeR-Traces。

Result: ReVeR 在平均偏好准确率上优于成对式 rubric RM，在指令遵循任务上优势最明显，并在测试时扩展（test-time scaling）与下游策略优化中同样表现更优。此外发现：生成器强化学习（generator RL）能提升偏好准确率，但会降低 rubric 保真度；更高的偏好准确率并不必然带来更好的下游策略。

Conclusion: rubric 保真度、偏好准确率与下游效用是三个相互独立的属性，未来奖励模型研究应分别对待与评估这三者，而非将偏好准确率视为唯一或充分的优化目标。

Abstract: Rubric-based reward models (RMs) evaluate responses against explicit criteria. However, existing methods often derive criteria from observed response candidates, introducing response-induced bias that may limit rubric generalizability. Their judges also struggle with mechanical constraints when relying on reading alone, and commonly used pairwise judges provide only relative preferences, complicating their direct use for policy optimization. We propose ReVeR, a pointwise rubric RM that derives hard rules and graded principles by reasoning about the instruction alone and evaluates responses independently through tool-augmented judging. Both components are trained through label-blind distillation, in which preference labels only filter a teacher's outputs, yielding ReVeR-Traces, a large-scale dataset of rubric-reasoning and judging trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that ReVeR outperforms pairwise rubric RMs in average preference accuracy, most clearly on instruction following, as well as in test-time scaling and downstream policy optimization. We further find that generator RL improves preference accuracy while reducing rubric fidelity, and that higher preference accuracy does not necessarily translate into better downstream policies. These findings highlight that rubric fidelity, preference accuracy, and downstream utility are distinct properties, shedding light on future RM research.

</details>


### [621] [Where Do LLM Ensemble Gains Come From? Decomposing Candidate Value, Diversity, and Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18786)
*Donghwan Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM集成中候选增益的测度问题，提出将候选增益(CIV)代数分解为额外候选对比(DSV)与候选上下文对比(CCV)，并证明该分解依赖于所选取的对照条件；实验表明对照条件的选择会显著改变增益归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM集成的增益通常只与单一基线比较，但增益的归因会随所采用的对照条件而变化。作者希望厘清"增益究竟来自额外候选还是候选上下文"，并说明集成评估中明确参考对照的必要性。

Method: 设计四种匹配条件：Direct(无候选)、Single-slot(多槽界面中单一候选)、Duplicate(单一候选重复)、Multi-candidate(分别生成的候选)。在两种非多样化对照下，将总体候选增益CIV代数分解为额外候选对比DSV与候选上下文对比CCV。在MultiHopRAG(k=2)上测量模型多样性下的重复差距Rep，并在FRAMES更强面板扩展(n=200, k=3，聚合器输出上限4096)上进行配对检验，同时观察面板内Rep的符号变化。

Result: MultiHopRAG(k=2)上重复差距Rep=-8.33 pp [-13.25, -3.75]；FRAMES更强面板扩展上配对Delta Rep=+9.67 pp [+6.00, +13.50]；面板内Rep符号改变(原始-6.33，更强+3.33)。FRAMES证据聚合中，两种非多样化对照下候选上下文对比均保持强负值。

Conclusion: CIV的分解(而非CIV本身)取决于所选取的对照条件，因此集成评估在将增益归因于额外候选之前，必须明确说明所使用的参考对照。

Abstract: LLM ensemble gains are often measured against a single baseline, but the value attributed to additional candidates can change with the comparison used. We study an LLM aggregator under four matched conditions: Direct (no candidates), Single-slot (one candidate in a multi-slot interface), Duplicate (one candidate repeated), and Multi-candidate (separately generated candidates). Under either non-diverse control, overall candidate gain (CIV) splits algebraically into an additional-candidate contrast (DSV) and a candidate-context contrast (CCV); the split, but not CIV, depends on the chosen control. On MultiHopRAG model diversity (k=2), the repetition gap Rep=-8.33 pp [-13.25, -3.75] quantifies the difference between gains measured against Duplicate and Single-slot. On a matched FRAMES stronger-panel extension (n=200, k=3, aggregator output limit 4096), paired Delta Rep=+9.67 pp [+6.00, +13.50]; within panels, Rep changes sign (original -6.33; stronger +3.33). In FRAMES evidence aggregation, candidate-context contrasts remain strongly negative under both non-diverse controls. Our results show why ensemble evaluations should state the reference control before attributing gains to additional candidates.

</details>


### [622] [Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18818)
*Divyanshu Bathla,Parag Singla,Jitin Singla*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在低资源语言机器翻译中，若有一定量单语数据，使用回译（BT）比继续预训练更有效，配合少量平行数据可大幅提升翻译质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练大模型在零样本和少样本设置下表现良好，但低资源语言翻译通常只能依赖少样本提示或在少量平行数据上微调。作者探讨：在还能获得中等规模低资源单语数据的情况下，如何最有效地利用这些数据。

Method: 作者主张用前LLM时代的回译技术，而非继续预训练。当前微调的LLM翻译每种语言的单语句子，生成的配对用于反向训练；平行集上的更新被交替插入以稳定学习。此外，从平行数据中检索上下文示例进一步提升BT，并分析了单语文本来源、质量和数量。

Result: 在Odia和Swahili上仅用1K平行对，BT在领域内比继续预训练高出7.7至16.4 XCOMET-XXL分；使用beam解码的中间翻译时，还超过了平行数据多10倍的模型。跨五种低资源语言（以Hindi为高资源对照）和两个3B骨干，BT比仅平行微调提升16%至173% XCOMET-XXL。Odia和Sanskrit的盲人人工评估与自动指标一致。

Conclusion: 回译是低资源语言翻译中利用单语数据的高效方法，优于继续预训练，并能在极少平行数据下取得显著提升，得到人工评估验证。

Abstract: Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLMs) are effective on many tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. For machine translation of low-resource languages, the obvious options are few-shot prompting and fine-tuning on a small parallel set. We ask: what if moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data are also available? We argue that, rather than continued pretraining, a more effective use of this data is the pre-LLM era technique of back-translation (BT). The current fine-tuned LLM translates monolingual sentences in each language, and the resulting pairs train it in the reverse direction. Updates on the parallel set are interleaved for stable learning. With 1K parallel pairs on Odia and Swahili, BT beats continued pretraining into the low-resource language by 7.7 to 16.4 XCOMET-XXL points in domain. With beam-decoded intermediate translations, it also beats a model with 10 time more parallel data. In-context examples retrieved from the parallel data further improve BT. We also analyze the source, quality and amount of monolingual text. Across five low-resource languages, with Hindi as a high-resource control, and two 3B backbones, BT improves translation into the low-resource language by 16 to 173% XCOMET-XXL over parallel-only fine-tuning. Blind human evaluation on Odia and Sanskrit agrees with the automatic metrics.

</details>


### [623] [Hybrid Reasoning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18861)
*Jiaru Zou,Yunzhe Qi,Sirui Chen,Federico Bianchi,Shang Zhu,Pan Lu,Jingrui He,James Zou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 HybridAgents，在统一生成过程中动态切换潜在推理与文本交互，兼顾工具调用能力与推理透明性，性能提升 10.4% 并大幅降低 token 与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 LLM 智能体仍以文本进行推理与交互，效率受限；潜在推理虽高效但缺乏原生工具访问与推理透明性。论文希望融合二者优势，构建既能"超越语言思考"又能"通过语言行动"的智能体。

Method: 设计 HybridAgents 架构：轻量级 HybridLink 实现文本与潜在模式的无缝切换；连续工作记忆在多轮中保持无损混合上下文；并配套 HybridSFT（稳定工具集成式混合生成）与 HybridRL（学习何时潜在思考、何时文本行动）两阶段后训练算法。

Result: 在 3 种模型规模、11 个基准（数学、科学、医学、搜索、智能体推理）上评估，相比前沿文本与潜在方法的智能体框架，性能平均提升 10.4%，token 减少 35.5%-54.7%，推理提速 1.8x-2.6x，成本节省 2.7x-3.7x。

Conclusion: HybridAgents 证明混合推理是统一高效内部推理与可扩展工具化交互的可行路径，同时保持推理可检视性，为智能体推理提供了新范式。

Abstract: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.

</details>


### [624] [DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18862)
*Minghao Luo,Liang Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DoubtLess是一种免训练的解码方法：用一个小型推理模型通过对比"简洁思考者"与"冗长思考者"的logit差异，来引导大型推理模型缩短思维链，在保持准确率的同时显著减少token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型通过长思维链（CoT）取得了强大性能，但往往生成远超所需的token。现有缩短CoT的方法各有缺陷：需要针对每个模型额外训练、在隐藏状态上叠加固定引导向量、或使用早停与禁用"wait"等解码启发式，且这些方法常常会降低准确率。因此需要一种既免训练又不损害准确率的CoT压缩方法。

Method: 提出DoubtLess，一种免训练解码方法，由一个小型推理模型引导大型模型更简洁。小模型两次读取大模型已生成的CoT：一次以"简洁思考者"提示，一次以"冗长思考者"提示；两者logit向量之差经强度缩放后，在CoT每一步加到大型模型的logits上。

Result: 在竞赛数学、研究生级科学与竞技编程的七个基准上，DoubtLess将Qwen3-32B的CoT缩短31%且准确率不变，优于五种推理时基线。在自调试编程代理中，每轮思考token减少20%且任务性能不变。方法可泛化到另外两个模型家族且准确率不变，与基于训练的压缩方法结合时还能进一步缩短已训练为简洁的模型的CoT。

Conclusion: 消融与行为分析表明，DoubtLess主要减少重复检查，且大部分token节省发生在正确答案首次出现在CoT之后。该方法免训练、通用性强，可与其他压缩技术互补。代码已开源。

Abstract: Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model's hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like "wait", which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model's CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model's logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five inference-time baselines. We also show that DoubtLess reduces thinking tokens per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent with unchanged task performance. It also generalizes to two other model families with unchanged accuracy. When combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Ablations and behavioral analysis show that DoubtLess reduces repeated checking, with most token savings coming after the correct answer first appears in the CoT. Our code is available at https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess.

</details>


### [625] [Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18868)
*Wenbo Hu,Shraman Pramanick,Krishna Kumar Singh,Nanyun Peng,Kai-Wei Chang,Yong Jae Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对长时程智能体训练数据与训练方法双重匮乏的问题，提出首个具备可验证、密集、渐进式奖励的长时程训练数据集 Tev-Gym（覆盖7个领域、1170个任务环境），并配套设计进度势能奖励塑形（PPRS）训练配方，训练出 Tev-27B 模型，在 ALE-CM 等长时程基准上达到领先水平并具备良好泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体对自动化发现与递归自我改进（RSI）至关重要，但开源模型在此类任务上表现不佳，主因是既缺乏训练数据也缺乏有效训练方法。困难在于：长而复杂的任务难以策展与验证，且奖励稀疏，导致数据与配方都难以规模化。

Method: 作者从数据与配方两方面入手。数据侧提出 Tev-Gym，采用"潜世界优先"（latent-world-first）方法：先构建任务的完整正确隐藏规范（涵盖任务领域、工作流及每一步后的期望状态），再据此逐步渲染为面向智能体的环境，从而实现复杂度可控并提供天然进度度量。配方侧提出进度势能奖励塑形（PPRS），将上述进度度量转化为密集的逐步奖励，提升训练效率并使原本难以训练的任务变得可训。

Result: Tev-Gym 包含跨7个领域的1170个已验证任务环境，具备可验证、密集、渐进式奖励。用该配方训练的 Tev-27B 在 ALE-CM（计算与数学科学域）上取得显著提升，Pass@5 达到与 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5 相当的水平；尽管仅在 ALE 相关数据上训练，仍能泛化到 Terminal-Bench 3.0 与 4.0 子集，超越 GLM 5.2 与 Gemini 3.7 Flash，并在 TB 2.1 等中等时程任务上达到 Claude Opus 4.8 级别表现。

Conclusion: 通过"潜世界优先"构建可验证密集渐进奖励数据，并结合 PPRS 奖励塑形，可有效解决长时程智能体训练中数据稀缺与奖励稀疏的问题，使开源模型在长时程任务上达到前沿水平，并展现出跨基准、跨时程的泛化能力。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously -- from hours to days -- on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. We address both. First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards -- 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. Training with this recipe yields Tev-27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents' Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1.
